4.4.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo mahīṃ ca kena hetunā ..
ājagāma jagannātho vada vedavidāṃ vara .. 1 ..
4.4.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
केन वा प्रार्थितः कृष्णो महीं च केन हेतुना ॥
आजगाम जगन्नाथो वद वेदविदां वर ॥ 1 ॥
4.4.m:
Nārada said: / By whom was Kṛṣṇa petitioned, and for what reason / did the Lord of the Universe come to the earth? Speak, O best of the knowers of the Veda.
Nārāyaṇa said: / Formerly, in the Vārāha Kalpa, the earth, burdened with weight, / became exceedingly afflicted with grief and went to Brahmā for refuge.
Together with the gods, who were tormented by the demons and exceedingly agitated in mind, / she went to the inaccessible assembly of the Creator.
There she saw the Lord of gods blazing with the splendour of Brahman, / joyfully served by the best of ṛṣis, sages, and siddhas;
gazing with a joyful smile at the dance of the apsaras-host, / and listening to the captivating music of the gandharvas;
chanting the supreme Brahman, the two syllables “Kṛṣ-ṇa”, / filled with tears of joy out of devotion, his body thrilling with horripilation.
Bowing down with devotion together with the gods to the Four-faced One, / she made known everything, beginning with the burden of the Daityas, O sage; / filled with tears and trembling with horripilation, she praised him and wept.
The Sustainer of the World said to her: “Why do you praise [me] and weep? / Why have you come, auspicious one? Speak; all will be well.
Be calm, blessed one; what fear can you have while I am here?” / Having consoled the earth, Brahmā respectfully asked the gods:
“Why have you come into my presence, O gods?” / Hearing Brahmā’s words, the gods said to Prajāpati:
“The earth is weighed down with a burden, and we are beset by robbers, O Lord. / You alone are the creator of the worlds; quickly bring about our deliverance.
You are her refuge, O Brahman; it is proper that you grant relief. / By the burden with which this earth is afflicted, O grandfather,
we too are stricken with sorrow; take away that burden.” / Hearing the words of the gods, the Ordainer of the World asked her:
“Cast aside your fear, my child; abide happily in my presence.”

4.4.s:
.. nārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
purā vārāhakalpe sā bhārākrāṃtā vasuṃdharā ..
bhṛśaṃ babhūva śokārtā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
4.4.d:
॥ नारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा वाराहकल्पे सा भाराक्रांता वसुंधरा ॥
भृशं बभूव शोकार्ता ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययौ ॥ 2 ॥

4.4.s:
suraiścāsurasaṃtaptairbhṛśamudvignamānasaiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ taistāṃ durgamāṃ ca jagāma vedhasaḥ sabhām .. 3 ..
4.4.d:
सुरैश्चासुरसंतप्तैर्भृशमुद्विग्नमानसैः ॥
सार्द्धं तैस्तां दुर्गमां च जगाम वेधसः सभाम् ॥ 3 ॥

4.4.s:
dadarśa tasyāṃ deveśaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā ..
ṛṣīndraiśca munīndraiśca siddheṃdraiḥ sevitaṃ mudā .. 4 ..
4.4.d:
ददर्श तस्यां देवेशं ज्वलंतं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥
ऋषीन्द्रैश्च मुनीन्द्रैश्च सिद्धेंद्रैः सेवितं मुदा ॥ 4 ॥

4.4.s:
apsarogaṇanṛtyaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ..
gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ manoharam .. 5 ..
4.4.d:
अप्सरोगणनृत्यं च पश्यंतं सस्मितं मुदा ॥
गंधर्वाणां च संगीतं श्रुतवंतं मनोहरम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.4.s:
japaṃtaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ..
bhaktyānaṃdāśrupūrṇaṃ taṃ pulakāṃkitavigraham .. 6 ..
4.4.d:
जपंतं परमं ब्रह्म कृष्ण इत्यक्षरद्वयम् ॥
भक्त्यानंदाश्रुपूर्णं तं पुलकांकितविग्रहम् ॥ 6 ॥

4.4.s:
bhaktyā sā tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ praṇamya caturānanam ..
sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakre daityabhārādikaṃ mune ..
sā'śrupūrṇā sapulakā tuṣṭāva ca ruroda ca ..7..
4.4.d:
भक्त्या सा त्रिदशैः सार्द्धं प्रणम्य चतुराननम् ॥
सर्वं निवेदनं चक्रे दैत्यभारादिकं मुने ॥
साऽश्रुपूर्णा सपुलका तुष्टाव च रुरोद च ॥7॥

4.4.s:
tāmuvāca jagaddhātā kathaṃ stauṣi ca rodiṣi ..
kathamāgamanaṃ bhadre vada bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ..8..
4.4.d:
तामुवाच जगद्धाता कथं स्तौषि च रोदिषि ॥
कथमागमनं भद्रे वद भद्रं भविष्यति ॥8॥

4.4.s:
susthirā bhava kalyāṇi bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite..
āśvāsya pṛthivīṃ brahmā devānpapraccha sādaram .. 9 ..
4.4.d:
सुस्थिरा भव कल्याणि भयं किं ते मयि स्थिते॥
आश्वास्य पृथिवीं ब्रह्मा देवान्पप्रच्छ सादरम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.4.s:
kathamāgamanaṃ devā yuṣmākaṃ mama sannidhim ..
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā devā ūcuḥ prajāpatim .. 10 ..
4.4.d:
कथमागमनं देवा युष्माकं मम सन्निधिम् ॥
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा देवा ऊचुः प्रजापतिम् ॥ 10 ॥

4.4.s:
bhārākrāṃtā ca vasudhā dasyugrastā vayaṃ prabho ..
tvameva jagatāṃ sraṣṭā śīghraṃ no niṣkṛtiṃ kuru .. 11 ..
4.4.d:
भाराक्रांता च वसुधा दस्युग्रस्ता वयं प्रभो ॥
त्वमेव जगतां स्रष्टा शीघ्रं नो निष्कृतिं कुरु ॥ 11 ॥

4.4.s:
gatistvamasyā bho brahmannirvṛtiṃ kartumarhasi ..
pīḍitā yena bhāreṇa pṛthivīyaṃ pitāmaha .. 12 ..
4.4.d:
गतिस्त्वमस्या भो ब्रह्मन्निर्वृतिं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
पीडिता येन भारेण पृथिवीयं पितामह ॥ 12 ॥

4.4.s:
vayaṃ tenaiva duḥkhārtāstadbhāraharaṇaṃ kuru ..
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ papraccha jagadvidhiḥ..13..
4.4.d:
वयं तेनैव दुःखार्तास्तद्भारहरणं कुरु ॥
देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा तां पप्रच्छ जगद्विधिः॥13॥

4.4.s:
dūrīkṛtya bhayaṃ vatse sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mamāṃtikam ..
keṣāṃ bhāramaśaktā tvaṃ soḍhuṃ paṃkajalocane .. 14 ..
4.4.d:
दूरीकृत्य भयं वत्से सुखं तिष्ठ ममांतिकम् ॥
केषां भारमशक्ता त्वं सोढुं पंकजलोचने ॥ 14 ॥
4.4.m: "Whose burden are you unable to bear, O lotus-eyed one? / I shall remove it, blessed lady; surely good fortune will be yours." / Hearing his word, she, whose face and eyes had become joyful, / told him of her suffering, by which she was oppressed. / The Earth said: / "Listen, Father, I will tell my mental anguish. / Without a trusted kin, one should not tell another. / The female race is always weak and ought to be protected by its kin— / by fathers, husbands, and sons—and is surely condemned by others. / Asked by you, O Father of the universe, I feel no shame to speak. / Listen, I will tell you of those by whose burdens I am oppressed: / Those who are devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and those who revile his devotees— / I am incapable of carrying the burden of those great sinners. / Those who have abandoned their own duty and conduct, who neglect daily rites, / and who lack faith in the Vedas—I am oppressed by their burden. / Those who do not support father, mother, guru, wife, / son, and dependants—I am not able to bear their burden. / Those who speak untruth, Father, devoid of compassion and truth, / revilers of gurus and gods—I am oppressed by their burden. / The traitor to a friend, the ungrateful, the false witness, / the betrayer of trust, the stealer of a deposit—I am oppressed by their burden. / Those who actually sell auspicious Vedic hymns and Sāman chants, / and the solely auspicious name of Hari—I am oppressed by their burden. / The slayer of living beings, the traitor to a guru, the village priest, the greedy hunter, / the burner of corpses, the one who eats from a śūdra—I am oppressed by their burden. / Those fools who disrupt various vows such as / worship, sacrifice, fasting, and the like—I am oppressed by their burden. / Those wicked people who constantly hate cows, brāhmaṇas, gods, and Vaiṣṇavas, / and Hari, discourse on Hari, and devotion—I am oppressed by their burden. / And as I am oppressed by the burden of Śaṅkha and others, O Creator,

4.4.s:
apaneṣyāmi taṃ bhadre bhadraṃ te bhavitā dhuvam ..
tasya sā vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca svapīḍanam..
pīḍitā yena yenaivaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā .. 15 ..
4.4.d:
अपनेष्यामि तं भद्रे भद्रं ते भविता धुवम् ॥
तस्य सा वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच स्वपीडनम्॥
पीडिता येन येनैवं प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥ 15 ॥

4.4.s:
.. kṣitiruvāca .. ..
śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi svakīyāṃ mānasīṃ vyathām ..
vinā baṃdhuṃ saviśvāsaṃ nānyaṃ kathitumarhati .. 16 ..
4.4.d:
॥ क्षितिरुवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु तात प्रवक्ष्यामि स्वकीयां मानसीं व्यथाम् ॥
विना बंधुं सविश्वासं नान्यं कथितुमर्हति ॥ 16 ॥

4.4.s:
strījātirabalā śaśvadrakṣaṇīyā svabaṃdhubhiḥ ..
janakasvāmiputraiśca garhitā'nyaiśca niścitam .. 17 ..
4.4.d:
स्त्रीजातिरबला शश्वद्रक्षणीया स्वबंधुभिः ॥
जनकस्वामिपुत्रैश्च गर्हिताऽन्यैश्च निश्चितम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.4.s:
tvayā pṛṣṭā jagattāta na lajjā kathituṃ mama ..
yeṣāṃ bhāraiḥ pīḍitā'haṃ śrūyatāṃ kathayāmi te .. 18 ..
4.4.d:
त्वया पृष्टा जगत्तात न लज्जा कथितुं मम ॥
येषां भारैः पीडिताऽहं श्रूयतां कथयामि ते ॥ 18 ॥

4.4.s:
kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnā ye ye ca tadbhaktaniṃdakāḥ ..
teṣāṃ mahāpātakināmaśaktā bhāravāhane .. 19 ..
4.4.d:
कृष्णभक्तिविहीना ये ये च तद्भक्तनिंदकाः ॥
तेषां महापातकिनामशक्ता भारवाहने ॥ 19 ॥

4.4.s:
svadharmācārahīnā ye nityakṛtyavivarjitāḥ ..
śraddhāhīnāśca vedeṣu teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā .. 20 ..
4.4.d:
स्वधर्माचारहीना ये नित्यकृत्यविवर्जिताः ॥
श्रद्धाहीनाश्च वेदेषु तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥ 20 ॥

4.4.s:
pitṛmātṛgurustrīṇāṃ poṣaṇaṃ putrapoṣyayoḥ ..
ye na kurvaṃti teṣāṃ ca na śaktā bhāravāhane .. 21 ..
4.4.d:
पितृमातृगुरुस्त्रीणां पोषणं पुत्रपोष्ययोः ॥
ये न कुर्वंति तेषां च न शक्ता भारवाहने ॥ 21 ॥

4.4.s:
ye mithyāvādinastāta dayāsatya vivarjitāḥ ..
niṃdakā gurudevānāṃ teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ..22..
4.4.d:
ये मिथ्यावादिनस्तात दयासत्य विवर्जिताः ॥
निंदका गुरुदेवानां तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥22॥

4.4.s:
mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ..
viśvāsaghno nyāsahartā teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā .. 23 ..
4.4.d:
मित्रद्रोही कृतघ्नश्च मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदायकः ॥
विश्वासघ्नो न्यासहर्ता तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥ 23 ॥

4.4.s:
kalyāṇasūktasāmāni harernāmaikamaṃgalam ..
kurvaṃti vikrayaṃ ye vai teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā .. 24 ..
4.4.d:
कल्याणसूक्तसामानि हरेर्नामैकमंगलम् ॥
कुर्वंति विक्रयं ये वै तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥ 24 ॥

4.4.s:
jīvaghātī gurudrohī grāmayājī ca lubdhakaḥ ..
śavadāhī śūdrabhojī teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā .. 25 ..
4.4.d:
जीवघाती गुरुद्रोही ग्रामयाजी च लुब्धकः ॥
शवदाही शूद्रभोजी तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥ 25 ॥

4.4.s:
pūjāyajñopavāsādi vratāni vividhāni ca ..
ye ye mūḍhā vihaṃtārasteṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ..26..
4.4.d:
पूजायज्ञोपवासादि व्रतानि विविधानि च ॥
ये ये मूढा विहंतारस्तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥26॥

4.4.s:
sadā dviṣaṃti ye pāpā goviprasuravaiṣṇavān ..
hariṃ harikathāṃ bhaktiṃ teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā .. 27 ..
4.4.d:
सदा द्विषंति ये पापा गोविप्रसुरवैष्णवान् ॥
हरिं हरिकथां भक्तिं तेषां भारेण पीडिता ॥ 27 ॥

4.4.s:
śaṃkhādīnāṃ ca bhāreṇa pīḍitā'haṃ yathā vidhe ..
tato'dhikānāṃ daityānāṃ bhāreṇa paripīḍitā ..28..
4.4.d:
शंखादीनां च भारेण पीडिताऽहं यथा विधे ॥
ततोऽधिकानां दैत्यानां भारेण परिपीडिता ॥28॥

4.4.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ madvyathāyā nivedanam ..
tvayā yadi supālyā'haṃ pratīkāraṃ kuru prabho..29..
4.4.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं मद्व्यथाया निवेदनम् ॥
त्वया यदि सुपाल्याऽहं प्रतीकारं कुरु प्रभो॥29॥

4.4.s:
ityevamuktvā vasudhā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
brahmā tadrodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ .. 30 ..
4.4.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वसुधा रुरोद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
ब्रह्मा तद्रोदनं दृष्ट्वा तामुवाच कृपानिधिः ॥ 30 ॥

4.4.s:
bhāraṃ tavāpaneṣyāmi dasyūnāmapyupāyataḥ ..
upāyato'pi kāryāṇi siddhyaṃtyeva vasundhare ..31..
4.4.d:
भारं तवापनेष्यामि दस्यूनामप्युपायतः ॥
उपायतोऽपि कार्याणि सिद्ध्यंत्येव वसुन्धरे ॥31॥

4.4.s:
kālena bhāraharaṇaṃ kariṣyati madīśvaraḥ ..
mantraṃ maṃgalakumbhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca kuṃkumam .. 32 ..
4.4.d:
कालेन भारहरणं करिष्यति मदीश्वरः ॥
मन्त्रं मंगलकुम्भं च शिवलिंगं च कुंकुमम् ॥ 32 ॥

4.4.s:
madhukāṣṭhaṃ caṃdanaṃ ca kastūrīṃ tīrthamṛttikām ..
khaṅgagaṃḍakakhaṃḍaṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ padmarāgakam ..33..
4.4.d:
मधुकाष्ठं चंदनं च कस्तूरीं तीर्थमृत्तिकाम् ॥
खङ्गगंडकखंडं च स्फाटिकं पद्मरागकम् ॥33॥

4.4.s:
iṃdranīlaṃ sūryamaṇiṃ rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam ..
śālagrāmaśilāṃ śaṃkhaṃ tulasīṃ pratimāṃ jalam ..34..
4.4.d:
इंद्रनीलं सूर्यमणिं रुद्राक्षं कुशमूलकम् ॥
शालग्रामशिलां शंखं तुलसीं प्रतिमां जलम् ॥34॥

4.4.s:
śaṃkhaṃ pradīpamālāṃ ca śilāmarcyāṃ ca ghaṃṭikām..
nirmālyaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ haridvarṇamaṇiṃ tathā..
graṃthiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram ..35..
4.4.d:
शंखं प्रदीपमालां च शिलामर्च्यां च घंटिकाम्॥
निर्माल्यं चैव नैवेद्यं हरिद्वर्णमणिं तथा॥
ग्रंथियुक्तं यज्ञसूत्रं दर्पणं श्वेतचामरम् ॥35॥

4.4.s:
gorocanaṃ ca muktāṃ ca śuktiṃ māṇikyameva ca ..
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vahniṃ karpūraṃ paraśuṃ tathā .. 36 ..
4.4.d:
गोरोचनं च मुक्तां च शुक्तिं माणिक्यमेव च ॥
पुराणसंहितां वह्निं कर्पूरं परशुं तथा ॥ 36 ॥

4.4.s:
rajataṃ kāṃcanaṃ caiva pravālaṃ ratnameva ca ..
kuśabījaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ gavyaṃ gomūtragomayam .. 37 ..
4.4.d:
रजतं कांचनं चैव प्रवालं रत्नमेव च ॥
कुशबीजं तीर्थतोयं गव्यं गोमूत्रगोमयम् ॥ 37 ॥

4.4.s:
tvayi ye sthāpayiṣyaṃti mūḍhāścaitāni sundari ..
pacyante kālasūtreṇa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam ..38..
4.4.d:
त्वयि ये स्थापयिष्यंति मूढाश्चैतानि सुन्दरि ॥
पच्यन्ते कालसूत्रेण वर्षाणामयुतं ध्रुवम् ॥38॥

4.4.s:
brahmā pṛthvīṃ samāśvāsya devatābhistayā saha ..
jagāma jagatāṃ dhātā kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam .. 39 ..
4.4.d:
ब्रह्मा पृथ्वीं समाश्वास्य देवताभिस्तया सह ॥
जगाम जगतां धाता कैलासं शंकरालयम् ॥ 39 ॥

4.4.s:
gatvā tamāśramaṃ ramyaṃ dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ vidhiḥ ..
vasaṃtamakṣayavaṭamūle svaḥsaritastaṭe.. 40 ..
4.4.d:
गत्वा तमाश्रमं रम्यं ददर्श शंकरं विधिः ॥
वसंतमक्षयवटमूले स्वःसरितस्तटे॥ 40 ॥

4.4.s:
vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ dakṣakanyāsthibhūṣaṇam ..
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trilocanam .. 41 ..
4.4.d:
व्याघ्रचर्मपरीधानं दक्षकन्यास्थिभूषणम् ॥
त्रिशूलपट्टिशधरं पंचवक्त्रं त्रिलोचनम् ॥ 41 ॥

4.4.s:
nānāsiddhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ yogīṃdragaṇasevitam..
parito'psarasāṃ nṛtyaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā .. 42 ..
4.4.d:
नानासिद्धैः परिवृतं योगींद्रगणसेवितम्॥
परितोऽप्सरसां नृत्यं पश्यंतं सस्मितं मुदा ॥ 42 ॥
4.4.m:
even more so am I thoroughly oppressed by the burden of the Daityas. / Thus everything, the declaration of my anguish, has been told. / If I am to be well protected by you, O Lord, make a remedy." / Having spoken thus, the Earth wept again and again. / Seeing her weeping, Brahmā, an ocean of mercy, said to her: / "By appropriate means I shall remove your burden, even that of the robbers; / indeed, by appropriate means tasks are accomplished, O Earth. / In time, my Lord will accomplish the removal of the burden. / A mantra, an auspicious water-pot, a Śiva-liṅga, saffron, / madhuka-wood, sandalwood, musk, soil from sacred bathing-places, / a rhinoceros horn, crystal, ruby, / sapphire, sun-stone, rudrākṣa, kuśa-root, / a Śālagrāma stone, a conch, a tulasī plant, an image, water, / a conch, a row of lamps, a stone for worship, a bell, / offerings of flowers, food offerings, an emerald, / a sacred thread with its knot, a mirror, a white fly-whisk, / gorocana, pearl, mother-of-pearl, ruby, / a Purāṇa compendium, fire, camphor, an axe, / silver, gold, coral, and gems, / kuśa seed, water from sacred places, products of the cow, cow urine, and cow dung— / those fools who place these upon you, O beautiful lady, / are roasted by the Kālasūtra for ten thousand years without fail." / Having consoled the Earth, the Creator of the worlds, accompanied by her / and the gods, went to Kailāsa, the abode of Śaṅkara. / Having arrived at that delightful hermitage, the Creator saw Śaṅkara / dwelling at the base of the imperishable banyan tree on the bank of the heavenly river, / wearing a tiger skin, adorned with bones of Dakṣa's daughter, / holding a trident and a spear, five-faced, three-eyed, / surrounded by various Siddhas, served by the hosts of lordly yogins,
watching with a smile and with joy the dance of apsarases all around, / listening with curiosity to the music of the gandharvas, / looking with side-glances at Pārvatī who was gazing [at him] with love, / chanting with his five faces the solely auspicious name of Hari, / with horripilation, with a rosary of lotus seeds from the Mandākinī. / At that moment Brahmā stood before Dhūrjaṭi, / accompanied by the Earth and the hosts of gods, with their necks bowed. / Seeing the Guru of the universe, Śaṅkara swiftly stood up with devotion, / bowed with his head out of love, and then received his blessing. / All the deities bowed to Śaṅkara, whose crest is the moon; / the Earth bowed with devotion, and Hara bestowed a blessing. / Prajāpati related the matter to Pārvatī's lord; / having heard it, Śaṅkara, who is affectionate to his devotees, bowed his head at once. / Having heard of the peril to the devotee, Pārvatī and the Supreme Lord / became afflicted with grief; the Creator comforted them both. / Then Brahmā and Maheśa, having diligently consoled / the hosts of gods and the Earth, sent them home. / Then, having come quickly with the lord of the gods to the abode of Dharma, / and having deliberated with him, they went to the abode of Hari— / to Vaikuṇṭha, the supreme abode, the ultimate remover of old age and death, / sustained by the wind, the supreme realm above the cosmic egg, / ten million leagues above Brahmaloka, eternal, / indescribable by poets, wondrous, fashioned of jewels, / adorned with royal roads made of rubies and sapphires. / Travelling at the speed of thought, they all reached that enchanting [place]; / having gone to the inner chamber of Hari, the gods saw Śrī Hari, / seated on a jewelled throne, adorned with jewelled ornaments, / embellished with jewelled armlets, bracelets, and jewelled anklets, / his cheeks radiant with a pair of jewelled earrings,

4.4.s:
gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ kutūhalāt ..
paśyaṃtīṃ pārvatīṃ prītyā paśyaṃtaṃ vakracakṣuṣā .. 43 ..
4.4.d:
गंधर्वाणां च संगीतं श्रुतवंतं कुतूहलात् ॥
पश्यंतीं पार्वतीं प्रीत्या पश्यंतं वक्रचक्षुषा ॥ 43 ॥

4.4.s:
japaṃtaṃ pañcavaktreṇa harernāmaikamaṅgalam ..
maṃdākinīpadmabījamālayā pulakāṃkitam .. 44..
4.4.d:
जपंतं पञ्चवक्त्रेण हरेर्नामैकमङ्गलम् ॥
मंदाकिनीपद्मबीजमालया पुलकांकितम् ॥ 44॥

4.4.s:
etasminnaṃtare brahmā tasthāvagre sa dhūrjaṭeḥ ..
pṛthivyā surasaṃghaiśca sārddhaṃ praṇatakaṃdharaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा तस्थावग्रे स धूर्जटेः ॥
पृथिव्या सुरसंघैश्च सार्द्धं प्रणतकंधरैः ॥ 45 ॥

4.4.s:
uttasthau śaṃkaraḥ śīghraṃ bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā jagadgurum ..
nanāma mūrdhnā saṃprītyā labdhavānāśiṣaṃ tataḥ .. 46 ..
4.4.d:
उत्तस्थौ शंकरः शीघ्रं भक्त्या दृष्ट्वा जगद्गुरुम् ॥
ननाम मूर्ध्ना संप्रीत्या लब्धवानाशिषं ततः ॥ 46 ॥

4.4.s:
praṇemurdevatāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ caṃdraśekharam ..
praṇanāma dharā bhaktyā cāśiṣaṃ yuyuje haraḥ .. 47 ..
4.4.d:
प्रणेमुर्देवताः सर्वे शंकरं चंद्रशेखरम् ॥
प्रणनाम धरा भक्त्या चाशिषं युयुजे हरः ॥ 47 ॥

4.4.s:
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa pārvatīśaṃ prajāpatiḥ ..
śrutvā natamukhastūrṇaṃ śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ .. 48 ..
4.4.d:
वृत्तांतं कथयामास पार्वतीशं प्रजापतिः ॥
श्रुत्वा नतमुखस्तूर्णं शंकरो भक्तवत्सलः ॥ 48 ॥

4.4.s:
bhaktāpāyaṃ samākarṇya pārvatīparameśvarau ..
babhūvatustau duḥkhārtau bodhayāmāsa tau vidhiḥ .. 49 ..
4.4.d:
भक्तापायं समाकर्ण्य पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ ॥
बभूवतुस्तौ दुःखार्तौ बोधयामास तौ विधिः ॥ 49 ॥

4.4.s:
tato brahmā maheśaśca surasaṃghānvasuṃdharām ..
gṛhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa samāśvāsya prayatnataḥ ..50..
4.4.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा महेशश्च सुरसंघान्वसुंधराम् ॥
गृहं प्रस्थापयामास समाश्वास्य प्रयत्नतः ॥50॥

4.4.s:
tato deveśvaraistūrṇamāgatya dharmamaṃdiram ..
saha tena samālocya prajagmurbhavanaṃ hareḥ .. 51 ..
4.4.d:
ततो देवेश्वरैस्तूर्णमागत्य धर्ममंदिरम् ॥
सह तेन समालोच्य प्रजग्मुर्भवनं हरेः ॥ 51 ॥

4.4.s:
vaikuṃṭhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ..
vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍādūrdhvamuttamam ..
koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca brahmalokātsanātanam 52 ..
4.4.d:
वैकुंठं परमं धाम जरामृत्युहरं परम् ॥
वायुना धार्यमाणं च ब्रह्मांडादूर्ध्वमुत्तमम् ॥
कोटियोजनमूर्ध्वं च ब्रह्मलोकात्सनातनम् 52 ॥

4.4.s:
varṇanīyaṃ na kavibhirvicitraṃ ratnanirmitam ..
padmarāgairiṃdranīlai rājamārgairvibhūṣitam .. 53 ..
4.4.d:
वर्णनीयं न कविभिर्विचित्रं रत्ननिर्मितम् ॥
पद्मरागैरिंद्रनीलै राजमार्गैर्विभूषितम् ॥ 53 ॥

4.4.s:
te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpustaṃ manoharam ..
hareraṃtaḥpuraṃ gatvā dadṛśuḥ śrīhariṃ surāḥ .. 54 ..
4.4.d:
ते मनोयायिनः सर्वे संप्रापुस्तं मनोहरम् ॥
हरेरंतःपुरं गत्वा ददृशुः श्रीहरिं सुराः ॥ 54 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ..
ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpuraśobhitam .. 95 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च रत्नालंकारभूषितम् ॥
रत्नकेयूरवलयरत्ननूपुरशोभितम् ॥ 95 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitam ..
pītavastraparīdhānaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam .. 56 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नकुण्डलयुग्मेन गंडस्थलविराजितम् ॥
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानं वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥ 56 ॥

4.4.s:
śāṃtaṃ sarasvatīkāṃtaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāṃbujam ..
koṭikaṃdarpalīlābhaṃ smitavaktraṃ caturbhujam .. 57 ..
4.4.d:
शांतं सरस्वतीकांतं लक्ष्मीधृतपदांबुजम् ॥
कोटिकंदर्पलीलाभं स्मितवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् ॥ 57 ॥

4.4.s:
sunaṃdanaṃdakumudaiḥ pārṣadairupasevitam ..
caṃdanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ suratnamukuṭojjvalam ..
paramānaṃdarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam .. 58 ..
4.4.d:
सुनंदनंदकुमुदैः पार्षदैरुपसेवितम् ॥
चंदनोक्षितसर्वांगं सुरत्नमुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ॥
परमानंदरूपं च भक्तानुग्रहकारकम् ॥ 58 ॥

4.4.s:
taṃ praṇemuḥ sureṃdrāśca bhaktyā brahmādayo mune ..
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ..
paramānaṃdabhārārtāḥ pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ .. 99 ..
4.4.d:
तं प्रणेमुः सुरेंद्राश्च भक्त्या ब्रह्मादयो मुने ॥
तुष्टुवुः परया भक्त्या भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधराः ॥
परमानंदभारार्ताः पुलकांचितविग्रहाः ॥ 99 ॥

4.4.s:
brahmovāca .. .. namāmi kamalākāṃtaṃ śāṃtaṃ sarveṣṭamacyutam ..
vayaṃ yasya kalābhedāḥ kalāṃśakalayā surāḥ ..60..
4.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥ नमामि कमलाकांतं शांतं सर्वेष्टमच्युतम् ॥
वयं यस्य कलाभेदाः कलांशकलया सुराः ॥60॥

4.4.s:
manavaśca munīṃdrāśca mānuṣāśca carācarāḥ ..
kalākalāṃśakalayā bhūtāstvatto niraṃjana ..61..
4.4.d:
मनवश्च मुनींद्राश्च मानुषाश्च चराचराः ॥
कलाकलांशकलया भूतास्त्वत्तो निरंजन ॥61॥

4.4.s:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
tvāmakṣayamakṣaraṃ vā vyaktamavyaktamīśvaram ..
anādimādimānaṃdarūpiṇaṃ sarvarūpiṇam ..62..
4.4.d:
शंकर उवाच ॥
त्वामक्षयमक्षरं वा व्यक्तमव्यक्तमीश्वरम् ॥
अनादिमादिमानंदरूपिणं सर्वरूपिणम् ॥62॥

4.4.s:
aṇimādikasiddhīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvakāraṇam..
siddhijñaṃ siddhidaṃ siddhirūpaṃ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ..63..
4.4.d:
अणिमादिकसिद्धीनां कारणं सर्वकारणम्॥
सिद्धिज्ञं सिद्धिदं सिद्धिरूपं कः स्तोतुमीश्वरः॥63॥

4.4.s:
.. dharma uvāca .. ..
vede nirūpitaṃ vastu varṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
vede nirvacanīyaṃ yattannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ..
yasya saṃbhāvanīyaṃ yadguṇarūpaṃ niraṃjanam .. 64 ..
4.4.d:
॥ धर्म उवाच ॥ ॥
वेदे निरूपितं वस्तु वर्णनीयं विचक्षणैः ॥
वेदे निर्वचनीयं यत्तन्निर्वक्तुं च कः क्षमः ॥
यस्य संभावनीयं यद्गुणरूपं निरंजनम् ॥ 64 ॥

4.4.s:
tadatiriktaṃ stavanaṃ kimahaṃ staumi nirguṇam ..
brahmādīnāmidaṃ stotraṃ ṣaṭślokoktaṃ mahāmune .. 69 ..
4.4.d:
तदतिरिक्तं स्तवनं किमहं स्तौमि निर्गुणम् ॥
ब्रह्मादीनामिदं स्तोत्रं षट्श्लोकोक्तं महामुने ॥ 69 ॥

4.4.s:
paṭhitvā mucyate durgādvāñchitaṃ ca labhennaraḥ ..
devānāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca hariḥ svayam .. 66 ..
4.4.d:
पठित्वा मुच्यते दुर्गाद्वाञ्छितं च लभेन्नरः ॥
देवानां स्तवनं श्रुत्वा तानुवाच हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 66 ॥

4.4.s:
golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca yāmi paścācchriyā saha ..
naranārāyaṇau tau dvau śvetadvīpanivāsinau .. 67 ..
4.4.d:
गोलोकं यात यूयं च यामि पश्चाच्छ्रिया सह ॥
नरनारायणौ तौ द्वौ श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनौ ॥ 67 ॥

4.4.s:
ete yāsyaṃti goloke tathā devī sarasvatī ..
anaṃtā mama māyā ca kārttikeyo gaṇādhipaḥ ..
sāvitrī vedamātā ca paścādyāsyaṃti niścitam .. 68 ..
4.4.d:
एते यास्यंति गोलोके तथा देवी सरस्वती ॥
अनंता मम माया च कार्त्तिकेयो गणाधिपः ॥
सावित्री वेदमाता च पश्चाद्यास्यंति निश्चितम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.4.m:
Clothed in yellow garments, adorned with a garland of forest flowers,
peaceful, the beloved of Sarasvatī, his lotus feet held by Lakṣmī,
shining with the charm of millions of Kāmadevas, smiling-faced, four-armed,
attended upon by attendants such as Sunanda, Nanda, and Kumuda,
his entire body anointed with sandalwood paste, resplendent with an excellent crown of gems,
of the nature of supreme bliss, and bestowing grace upon his devotees —
to him the chiefs of the gods, Brahmā and the others, bowed down with devotion, O sage;
they praised him with supreme devotion, their necks bent in devotion,
overcome by the weight of supreme bliss, their bodies bristling with hair standing on end.
Brahmā said:
I bow down to the beloved of Kamalā, the peaceful, the desired object of all, Acyuta,
of whom we are distinct parts, while the gods are a fraction of a portion of a part;
and the Manus, the best of sages, human beings, and moving and unmoving creatures,
are produced from you, O immaculate one, as a fraction of a portion of a part of a part.
Śaṅkara said:
You are imperishable or immutable, manifest, unmanifest, the sovereign Lord,
beginningless, the source of all, consisting of bliss, having all forms,
the cause of the yogic powers beginning with atomicity, the cause of all causes,
knower of yogic powers, giver of yogic powers, of the nature of yogic power: who is able to praise you?
Dharma said:
A subject established in the Veda should be described by the wise;
who is capable of describing that which is beyond description in the Veda?
Whatever immaculate form of attributes is to be attributed to him —
beyond that, how can I praise him who is without gunas?
This hymn of praise of Brahmā and the others, uttered in six verses, O great sage,
having recited it, a person is freed from distress and obtains what is desired.
Having heard the hymn of praise of the gods, Hari himself said to them:
"Go you to Goloka, and I will go afterwards along with Śrī.
Those two, Nara and Nārāyaṇa, the dwellers in Śvetadvīpa,
these shall go to Goloka, and likewise goddess Sarasvatī;
Ananta, my Māyā, Kārttikeya, the leader of the Gaṇas,
and Sāvitrī the mother of the Vedas shall surely go afterwards.

4.4.s:
tatrāhaṃ dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo gopībhī rādhayā saha ..
atrāhaṃ kamalāyuktaḥ sunaṃdādibhirāvṛtaḥ .. 69 ..
4.4.d:
तत्राहं द्विभुजः कृष्णो गोपीभी राधया सह ॥
अत्राहं कमलायुक्तः सुनंदादिभिरावृतः ॥ 69 ॥

4.4.s:
nārāyaṇaśca kṛṣṇo'haṃ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ..
mamaivaitāḥ kalāḥ sarve devā brahmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ .. 70 ..
4.4.d:
नारायणश्च कृष्णोऽहं श्वेतद्वीपनिवासकृत् ॥
ममैवैताः कलाः सर्वे देवा ब्रह्मादयः स्मृताः ॥ 70 ॥

4.4.s:
kalākalāṃśakalayā surāsuranarādayaḥ ..
golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati .. 71 ..
4.4.d:
कलाकलांशकलया सुरासुरनरादयः ॥
गोलोकं यात यूयं च कार्यसिद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥ 71 ॥

4.4.s:
vayaṃ paścādgamiṣyāmaḥ sarveṣāmiṣṭasiddhaye ..
ityuktvā vai sabhāmadhye virarāma hariḥ svayam .. 72 ..
4.4.d:
वयं पश्चाद्गमिष्यामः सर्वेषामिष्टसिद्धये ॥
इत्युक्त्वा वै सभामध्ये विरराम हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 72 ॥

4.4.s:
praṇamya devatāḥ sarvā jagmurgolokamadbhutam ..
vicitraṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param .. 73 ..
4.4.d:
प्रणम्य देवताः सर्वा जग्मुर्गोलोकमद्भुतम् ॥
विचित्रं परमं धाम जरामृत्युहरं परम् ॥ 73 ॥

4.4.s:
ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṃṭhato gamyaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam ..
vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca nirmitaṃ svecchayā vibhoḥ .. 74 ..
4.4.d:
ऊर्ध्वं वैकुंठतो गम्यं पंचाशत्कोटियोजनम् ॥
वायुना धार्यमाणं च निर्मितं स्वेच्छया विभोः ॥ 74 ॥

4.4.s:
tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca devāste gamanotsukāḥ ..
te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpurvirajātaṭam .. 75 ..
4.4.d:
तमनिर्वचनीयं च देवास्ते गमनोत्सुकाः ॥
ते मनोयायिनः सर्वे संप्रापुर्विरजातटम् ॥ 75 ॥

4.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarittīraṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ manoharam .. 76 ..
4.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवाः सरित्तीरं विस्मयं परमं ययुः ॥
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं सुविस्तीर्णं मनोहरम् ॥ 76 ॥

4.4.s:
muktāmāṇikyaparamamaṇiratnākarānvitam ..
kṛṣṇaśubhraharidraktamaṇirājivirājitam .. 77 ..
4.4.d:
मुक्तामाणिक्यपरममणिरत्नाकरान्वितम् ॥
कृष्णशुभ्रहरिद्रक्तमणिराजिविराजितम् ॥ 77 ॥

4.4.s:
pravālāṃkuramudbhūtaṃ kutracitsumanoharam ..
paramāmūlyasadratnākararājivibhūṣitam .. 78 ..
4.4.d:
प्रवालांकुरमुद्भूतं कुत्रचित्सुमनोहरम् ॥
परमामूल्यसद्रत्नाकरराजिविभूषितम् ॥ 78 ॥

4.4.s:
vidheradṛśyāmāścarya nidhiśreṣṭhākarānvitam ..
padmarāgeṃdranīlānāmākaraṃ kutracinmune .. 79 ..
4.4.d:
विधेरदृश्यामाश्चर्य निधिश्रेष्ठाकरान्वितम् ॥
पद्मरागेंद्रनीलानामाकरं कुत्रचिन्मुने ॥ 79 ॥

4.4.s:
kutracicca marakatākaraśreṇīsamanvitam ..
syamaṃtakākaraṃ kutra kutracidrucakākaram .. 80 ..
4.4.d:
कुत्रचिच्च मरकताकरश्रेणीसमन्वितम् ॥
स्यमंतकाकरं कुत्र कुत्रचिद्रुचकाकरम् ॥ 80 ॥

4.4.s:
amūlyapītavarṇābhaṃ maṇiśreṇyākarānvitam ..
ratnākaraṃ kutracicca kutracitkaustubhākaram .. 81 ..
4.4.d:
अमूल्यपीतवर्णाभं मणिश्रेण्याकरान्वितम् ॥
रत्नाकरं कुत्रचिच्च कुत्रचित्कौस्तुभाकरम् ॥ 81 ॥

4.4.s:
kutra nirvacanīyānāṃ maṇīnāmākaraṃ param ..
kutracitkutracidramyavihārasthalamuttamam .. 82 ..
4.4.d:
कुत्र निर्वचनीयानां मणीनामाकरं परम् ॥
कुत्रचित्कुत्रचिद्रम्यविहारस्थलमुत्तमम् ॥ 82 ॥

4.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā tu paramāścaryaṃ jagmustatpāramīśvarāḥ ..
dadṛśuḥ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ śataśṛṃgaṃ manoramam .. 83 ..
4.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा तु परमाश्चर्यं जग्मुस्तत्पारमीश्वराः ॥
ददृशुः पर्वतश्रेष्ठं शतशृंगं मनोरमम् ॥ 83 ॥

4.4.s:
pārijātatarūṇāṃ ca vanarājivirājitam ..
kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ veṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ .. 84 ..
4.4.d:
पारिजाततरूणां च वनराजिविराजितम् ॥
कल्पवृक्षैः परिवृतं वेष्टितं कामधेनुभिः ॥ 84 ॥
4.4.m:
adorned with rows of forests of pārijāta trees,
surrounded by wish-fulfilling trees, encircled by kāmadhenus,
a crore of yojanas high, and in length ten times greater,
and measuring fifty crores of yojanas in the mountain's breadth.
Having the shape of a rampart, on its summit was the circular dance-ground,
ten yojanas wide, circular in shape, and sublime,
filled with a thousand flowering, fragrant flower gardens,
crowded with swarms of bees buzzing about;
adorned with chambers of love containing articles for amorous delight,
accompanied by thousands of crores of jeweled pavilions,
endowed with stairways of gems and jars of fine jewels,
beautified by pillars of emeralds,
studded all around with gems of the color of red lead,
and decorated with charming sapphires placed in their center;
resplendent with various gems, provided with ramparts of jewels,
and graced with four gateways equipped with door leaves;
provided with shoots of mango trees tied with ropes,
and surrounded on all sides by clusters of plantain trunks;
supplied with white grain, foliage, fruits, and sprouts of dūrvā grass,
and smeared with the essence of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron;
surrounded, O sage, by crores of groups of cowherd maidens
adorned with gem-ornaments, resplendent with garlands of jewels,
adorned with bracelets, armlets, and anklets made of gems,
with their cheek areas shining with pairs of jeweled earrings,
the fingers of their hands graceful and bright with jeweled rings,
the toes of their feet adorned with clusters of jeweled toe-rings,
adorned with jeweled ornaments, radiant with crowns of fine gems,
shining on the bridge of their noses with ornaments of pearls from noble elephants,
resplendent below their forelocks along with a dot of red lead,
having the lovely hue of campaka flowers, smeared with the fluid of sandalwood,
clothed in yellow garments, their bimba-fruit lips delightful.

4.4.s:
koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairghyaṃ daśaguṇottaram ..
śailaprasthaparimitaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam ..85..
4.4.d:
कोटियोजनमूर्ध्वं च दैर्घ्यं दशगुणोत्तरम् ॥
शैलप्रस्थपरिमितं पंचाशत्कोटियोजनम् ॥85॥

4.4.s:
prākārākāramasyaiva śikhare rāsamaṃḍalam ..
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ vartulākāramuttamam .. 86 ..
4.4.d:
प्राकाराकारमस्यैव शिखरे रासमंडलम् ॥
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं वर्तुलाकारमुत्तमम् ॥ 86 ॥

4.4.s:
puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena sugaṃdhinā ..
saṃkulena madhughrāṇāṃ samūhena samanvitam .. 87 ..
4.4.d:
पुष्पोद्यानसहस्रेण पुष्पितेन सुगंधिना ॥
संकुलेन मधुघ्राणां समूहेन समन्वितम् ॥ 87 ॥

4.4.s:
surata dravyasaṃyuktai rājitaṃ ratimaṃdiraiḥ ..
ratnamaṃḍapakoṭīnāṃ sahasreṇa samanvitam .. 88 ..
4.4.d:
सुरत द्रव्यसंयुक्तै राजितं रतिमंदिरैः ॥
रत्नमंडपकोटीनां सहस्रेण समन्वितम् ॥ 88 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnasopānayuktena sadratnakalaśena ca ..
harinmaṇīnāṃ staṃbhena śobhitena ca śobhitam ..89..
4.4.d:
रत्नसोपानयुक्तेन सद्रत्नकलशेन च ॥
हरिन्मणीनां स्तंभेन शोभितेन च शोभितम् ॥89॥

4.4.s:
siṃdūravarṇamaṇibhiḥ paritaḥ khacitena ca ..
indranīlairmadhyagatairmaṃḍitena manoharaiḥ .. 90 ..
4.4.d:
सिंदूरवर्णमणिभिः परितः खचितेन च ॥
इन्द्रनीलैर्मध्यगतैर्मंडितेन मनोहरैः ॥ 90 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnaprākārasaṃyuktamaṇibhedairvirājitam ..
dvāraiḥ kapāṭasaṃyuktaiścaturbhiśca virājitam .. 91 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नप्राकारसंयुक्तमणिभेदैर्विराजितम् ॥
द्वारैः कपाटसंयुक्तैश्चतुर्भिश्च विराजितम् ॥ 91 ॥

4.4.s:
rajjugraṃthisamāyuktarasālapallavānvitaiḥ .
paritaḥ kadalīstaṃbhasamūhaiśca samanvitam .. 92 ..
4.4.d:
रज्जुग्रंथिसमायुक्तरसालपल्लवान्वितैः ।
परितः कदलीस्तंभसमूहैश्च समन्वितम् ॥ 92 ॥

4.4.s:
śukladhānyaparṇajālaphaladūvāṃrkurānvitam ..
caṃdanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam .. 93 ..
4.4.d:
शुक्लधान्यपर्णजालफलदूवांर्कुरान्वितम् ॥
चंदनागरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवचर्चितम् ॥ 93 ॥

4.4.s:
veṣṭitaṃ gopakanyānāṃ samūhaiḥ koṭiśo mune ..
ratnālaṃkārasaṃyuktai ratnamālāvirājitaiḥ .. 94 ..
4.4.d:
वेष्टितं गोपकन्यानां समूहैः कोटिशो मुने ॥
रत्नालंकारसंयुक्तै रत्नमालाविराजितैः ॥ 94 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūra ratnanūpurabhūṣitaiḥ ..
ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitaiḥ .. 95 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नकंकणकेयूर रत्ननूपुरभूषितैः ॥
रत्नकुण्डलयुग्मेन गंडस्थलविराजितैः ॥ 95 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnāṃgulīyalalitairhastāṃgulivirājitaiḥ ..
ratnapāśakavṛndaiśca virājitapadāṃgulaiḥ .. 96 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नांगुलीयललितैर्हस्तांगुलिविराजितैः ॥
रत्नपाशकवृन्दैश्च विराजितपदांगुलैः ॥ 96 ॥

4.4.s:
bhūṣitai ratnabhūṣābhiḥ sadratnamukuṭojjvalaiḥ ..
gajeṃdramuktālaṃkārairnāsikāmadhyarājitaiḥ .. 97 ..
4.4.d:
भूषितै रत्नभूषाभिः सद्रत्नमुकुटोज्ज्वलैः ॥
गजेंद्रमुक्तालंकारैर्नासिकामध्यराजितैः ॥ 97 ॥

4.4.s:
siṃdūrabiṃdunā sārddhamalakādhaḥsthalojjvalaiḥ ..
cārucampakavarṇābhaiścaṃdanadravacarcitaiḥ .. 98 ..
4.4.d:
सिंदूरबिंदुना सार्द्धमलकाधःस्थलोज्ज्वलैः ॥
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभैश्चंदनद्रवचर्चितैः ॥ 98 ॥

4.4.s:
pītavastraparīdhānairbiṃbādharamanoharaiḥ ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāṇāṃ prabhāṃ muṣṇanmukhojjvalaiḥ .. 99 ..
4.4.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानैर्बिंबाधरमनोहरैः ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्राणां प्रभां मुष्णन्मुखोज्ज्वलैः ॥ 99 ॥
4.4.m: [Guarded] by groups of beautiful women whose faces steal the radiance of full autumn moons, / whose eyes rob the splendor of blossoming autumn lotuses, / adorned with musk leaf-drawings and radiant with lines of collyrium, / their braided hair adorned with garlands of blooming jasmine, / crowded with swarms of bees greedy for nectar, / humiliating elephants and wagtails by their graceful gait alone, / endowed with delicate smiles joined with arched eyebrows, / graced by rows of teeth resembling ripe pomegranate seeds, / decorated with elevated noses possessing the beauty of the bird-king's beak, / bowed as if by the weight of breasts resembling a pair of princely elephants' frontal lobes, / bowed under the heavy burden of plump hips and firm buttocks, / their minds shattered by the assaults of the arrows of love, / eager to gaze upon the beauty of their full-moon-like faces in mirrors, / their desires intent on serving Rādhikā's lotus feet; / guarded by command of Rādhikā, / and surrounded by hundreds of thousands of pleasure lakes, / surrounded and adorned with white and red lotuses, / always resounding with sweetly cooing swarms of bees, / furnished with thousands of blossoming, fragrant flower gardens, / and with crores of bower-cottages provided with flower-beds, / stocked with luxury articles, camphor-scented betel, and fine garments, / surrounded on all sides by jewel-lamps, white fly-whisks, and mirrors, / and adorned, O sage, with charming garlands of manifold flowers. / Having seen that rāsa pavilion, they came out of the mountain. / Then the discerning [gods] beheld a delightful and beautiful forest, / a forest named Vṛndāvana, beloved of Rādhā and Mādhava, / the pleasure-ground of the two, filled with groves of wish-granting trees, / stirred by gentle breezes moist with water from the banks of the Virajā, / made fragrant by cascades of flowers and lotus petals marked with musk,

4.4.s:
śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ śobhāmoṣaṇalocanaiḥ ..
kastūrīpātrikāyuktai rekhāktakajjalojjvalaiḥ .. 100 ..
4.4.d:
शरत्प्रफुल्लपद्मानां शोभामोषणलोचनैः ॥
कस्तूरीपात्रिकायुक्तै रेखाक्तकज्जलोज्ज्वलैः ॥ 100 ॥

4.4.s:
praphullamālatīmālājālaiḥkabaraśobhitaiḥ ..
madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiścāpi saṃkulaiḥ ..
cāruṇā gamanenaiva gajakhaṃjanagaṃjanaiḥ .. 101 ..
4.4.d:
प्रफुल्लमालतीमालाजालैःकबरशोभितैः ॥
मधुलुब्धमधुघ्राणां समूहैश्चापि संकुलैः ॥
चारुणा गमनेनैव गजखंजनगंजनैः ॥ 101 ॥

4.4.s:
vakrabhrūbhaṃgasaṃyogaślakṣṇasmitasamanvitaiḥ ..
pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitaiḥ .. 102 ..
4.4.d:
वक्रभ्रूभंगसंयोगश्लक्ष्णस्मितसमन्वितैः ॥
पक्वदाडिमबीजाभदंतपंक्तिविराजितैः ॥ 102 ॥

4.4.s:
khageṃdracaṃcuśobhāḍhyanāsikonnatabhūṣitaiḥ ..
gajeṃdragaṃḍayugmābhastanabhāranatairiva .. 103 ..
4.4.d:
खगेंद्रचंचुशोभाढ्यनासिकोन्नतभूषितैः ॥
गजेंद्रगंडयुग्माभस्तनभारनतैरिव ॥ 103 ॥

4.4.s:
nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīpīnabhārabharānataiḥ ..
kaṃdarpaśaraceṣṭābhirjarjarībhūtamānasai .. 104 ..
4.4.d:
नितम्बकठिनश्रोणीपीनभारभरानतैः ॥
कंदर्पशरचेष्टाभिर्जर्जरीभूतमानसै ॥ 104 ॥

4.4.s:
darpaṇaiḥ pūrṇacaṃdrāsyasauṃdaryadarśanotsukaiḥ ..
rādhikācaraṇāṃbhojasevāsaktamanorathaiḥ ..105..
4.4.d:
दर्पणैः पूर्णचंद्रास्यसौंदर्यदर्शनोत्सुकैः ॥
राधिकाचरणांभोजसेवासक्तमनोरथैः ॥105॥

4.4.s:
suṃdarīṇāṃ samūhaiśca rakṣitaṃ rādhikājñayā ..
krīḍāsarovarāṇāṃ ca lakṣaiśca pariveṣṭitam .. 106 ..
4.4.d:
सुंदरीणां समूहैश्च रक्षितं राधिकाज्ञया ॥
क्रीडासरोवराणां च लक्षैश्च परिवेष्टितम् ॥ 106 ॥

4.4.s:
śvetaraktairlohitaiśca veṣṭitaiḥ padmarājitaiḥ ..
sukūjadbhirmadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiḥ saṃkulaiḥ sadā .. 107 ..
4.4.d:
श्वेतरक्तैर्लोहितैश्च वेष्टितैः पद्मराजितैः ॥
सुकूजद्भिर्मधुघ्राणां समूहैः संकुलैः सदा ॥ 107 ॥

4.4.s:
puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena samanvitam ..
koṭikuṃjakuṭīraiśca puṣpaśayyāsamanvitaiḥ .. 106 ..
4.4.d:
पुष्पोद्यानसहस्रेण पुष्पितेन समन्वितम् ॥
कोटिकुंजकुटीरैश्च पुष्पशय्यासमन्वितैः ॥ 106 ॥

4.4.s:
bhogadravyasakarpūratāṃbūlavastrasaṃyutaiḥ ..
ratnapradīpaiḥ paritaḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ .. .. 109 ..
4.4.d:
भोगद्रव्यसकर्पूरतांबूलवस्त्रसंयुतैः ॥
रत्नप्रदीपैः परितः श्वेतचामरदर्पणैः ॥ ॥ 109 ॥

4.4.s:
vicitrapuṣpamālābhiḥ śobhitaiḥ śobhitaṃ mune ..
taṃ rāsamaṃḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagmuste parvatādbahiḥ .. 110 ..
4.4.d:
विचित्रपुष्पमालाभिः शोभितैः शोभितं मुने ॥
तं रासमंडपं दृष्ट्वा जग्मुस्ते पर्वताद्बहिः ॥ 110 ॥

4.4.s:
tato vicakṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśuḥ suṃdaraṃ vanam ..
vanaṃ vṛdāvanaṃ nāma rādhāmādhavayoḥ priyam .. 111 ..
4.4.d:
ततो विचक्षणं रम्यं ददृशुः सुंदरं वनम् ॥
वनं वृदावनं नाम राधामाधवयोः प्रियम् ॥ 111 ॥

4.4.s:
krīḍāsthānaṃ tayoreva kalpavṛkṣacayānvitam ..
virajātīranīrāktaiḥ kaṃpitaṃ maṃdavāyubhiḥ .. 112 ..
4.4.d:
क्रीडास्थानं तयोरेव कल्पवृक्षचयान्वितम् ॥
विरजातीरनीराक्तैः कंपितं मंदवायुभिः ॥ 112 ॥

4.4.s:
kastūrīyuktapatrābjaiḥ puṣpaughaiḥ surabhīkṛtam ..
navapallavasaṃsaktaparapuṣṭarutairyutam..113..
4.4.d:
कस्तूरीयुक्तपत्राब्जैः पुष्पौघैः सुरभीकृतम् ॥
नवपल्लवसंसक्तपरपुष्टरुतैर्युतम्॥113॥

4.4.s:
kutra helikadaṃbānāṃ kadaṃbaiḥ kamanīyakam ..
maṃdārāṇāṃ caṃpakānāṃ candanānāṃ tathaiva ca ..114..
4.4.d:
कुत्र हेलिकदंबानां कदंबैः कमनीयकम् ॥
मंदाराणां चंपकानां चन्दनानां तथैव च ॥114॥

4.4.s:
sugaṃdhikusumānāṃ ca gaṃdhena surabhīkṛtam ..
āmrāṇāṃ nāgaraṃgāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 115 ..
4.4.d:
सुगंधिकुसुमानां च गंधेन सुरभीकृतम् ॥
आम्राणां नागरंगाणां पनसानां तथैव च ॥ 115 ॥

4.4.s:
tālānāṃ nārikelānāṃ vṛṃdairvṛṃdārakaṃ vanam ..
jaṃbūnāṃ badarīṇāṃ ca kharjūrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 116 ..
4.4.d:
तालानां नारिकेलानां वृंदैर्वृंदारकं वनम् ॥
जंबूनां बदरीणां च खर्जूराणां विशेषतः ॥ 116 ॥

4.4.s:
gurvākāmrātakānāṃ ca jaṃbīrāṇāṃ ca nārada ..
kadalīnāṃ śrīphalānāṃ dāḍimānāṃ manoharaiḥ .. 117 ..
4.4.d:
गुर्वाकाम्रातकानां च जंबीराणां च नारद ॥
कदलीनां श्रीफलानां दाडिमानां मनोहरैः ॥ 117 ॥

4.4.s:
supakvaphalasaṃyuktaiḥ samūhaiśca virājitam ..
pippalīnāṃ ca śālānāmaśvatthānāṃ tathaiva ca .. 118 ..
4.4.d:
सुपक्वफलसंयुक्तैः समूहैश्च विराजितम् ॥
पिप्पलीनां च शालानामश्वत्थानां तथैव च ॥ 118 ॥

4.4.s:
niṃbānāṃ śālmalīnāṃ ca tittiḍīnāṃ ca śobhanaiḥ ..
anyeṣāṃ tarubhedānāṃ saṃkulaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā .. 119 ..
4.4.d:
निंबानां शाल्मलीनां च तित्तिडीनां च शोभनैः ॥
अन्येषां तरुभेदानां संकुलैः संकुलं सदा ॥ 119 ॥

4.4.s:
paritaḥ kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛndairvṛndairvirājitam ..
mallikāmālatīkuṃdaketakīmādhavī latāḥ .. 120 ..
4.4.d:
परितः कल्पवृक्षाणां वृन्दैर्वृन्दैर्विराजितम् ॥
मल्लिकामालतीकुंदकेतकीमाधवी लताः ॥ 120 ॥

4.4.s:
etāsāṃ ca samūhaiśca yūthikābhiḥ samanvitam ..
cārukuṃjakuṭīraistaiḥ paṃcāśatkoṭibhirmune .. 121 ..
4.4.d:
एतासां च समूहैश्च यूथिकाभिः समन्वितम् ॥
चारुकुंजकुटीरैस्तैः पंचाशत्कोटिभिर्मुने ॥ 121 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnapradīpadīpaiśca dhūpena surabhīkṛtaiḥ ..
śṛṃgāradravyayuktaiśca vāsitairgaṃdhavāyubhiḥ .. 122 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नप्रदीपदीपैश्च धूपेन सुरभीकृतैः ॥
शृंगारद्रव्ययुक्तैश्च वासितैर्गंधवायुभिः ॥ 122 ॥

4.4.s:
caṃdanāktaiḥ puṣpatalpairmālājālasamanvitaiḥ ..
madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ kalaśabdaiśca śabditam .. 123 ..
4.4.d:
चंदनाक्तैः पुष्पतल्पैर्मालाजालसमन्वितैः ॥
मधुलुब्धमधुघ्राणां कलशब्दैश्च शब्दितम् ॥ 123 ॥

4.4.s:
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhayairgopīvṛṃdaiśca veṣṭitam ..
paṃcāśatkoṭigopībhī rakṣitaṃ rādhikājñayā ..124..
4.4.d:
रत्नालंकारशोभाढयैर्गोपीवृंदैश्च वेष्टितम् ॥
पंचाशत्कोटिगोपीभी रक्षितं राधिकाज्ञया ॥124॥
4.4.m: filled with the cries of cuckoos perched upon fresh young sprouts. / Here, made lovely by thickets of yellow kadambas, / mandāras, campakas, and sandal trees as well, / and made fragrant by the scent of sweet-smelling blossoms; / a forest adorned with groves of mangoes, oranges, and jackfruits, / as well as palmyras and coconuts; / especially with clusters of rose apples, jujubes, and dates, / betel nuts, hog plums, and limes, O Nārada, / and enchanting plantains, bilvas, and pomegranates, / filled with clusters bearing fully ripened fruits; / constantly crowded with splendid long peppers, / śāla trees, sacred figs, / nimba trees, silk-cotton trees, tamarind trees, / and various other kinds of trees; / adorned on all sides with cluster upon cluster of wish-granting trees, / with climbing plants—mallikā, mālatī, kunda, ketakī, and mādhavī— / joined with swarms of these and with yūthikā jasmines; / with fifty crores of those lovely bower-cottages, O sage, / glowing with gem-lamps, made fragrant with incense, / furnished with articles of lovemaking, and perfumed by fragrant breezes, / with sandalwood-smeared flower beds provided with strings of garlands, / resounding with the sweet humming of bees greedy for honey, / surrounded by multitudes of cowherd maidens adorned with jewel ornaments, / and guarded by fifty crores of cowherd maidens by command of Rādhikā.

4.4.s:
dvātriṃśatkānanaṃ tatra ramyaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam ..
vṛṃdāvanābhyaṃtaritaṃ nirjanasthānamuttamam .. 129 ..
4.4.d:
द्वात्रिंशत्काननं तत्र रम्यं रम्यं मनोहरम् ॥
वृंदावनाभ्यंतरितं निर्जनस्थानमुत्तमम् ॥ 129 ॥
4.4.m: There were thirty-two delightful, exceedingly charming forests, / situated inside Vṛndāvana, an excellent secluded place,

4.4.s:
supakvamadhurasvāduphalairvṛṃdārakaṃ mune ..
goṣṭhānāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva samūhaiśca samanvitam ..126..
4.4.d:
सुपक्वमधुरस्वादुफलैर्वृंदारकं मुने ॥
गोष्ठानां च गवां चैव समूहैश्च समन्वितम् ॥126॥
4.4.m: adorned with fully ripe, sweet, delicious fruits, O sage, / and filled with herds of cows and cowpens,

4.4.s:
puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena sugaṃdhinā ..
madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ |samūhena samanvitam ..127..
4.4.d:
पुष्पोद्यानसहस्रेण पुष्पितेन सुगंधिना ॥
मधुलुब्धमधुघ्राणां ।समूहेन समन्वितम् ॥127॥
4.4.m: provided with thousands of flowering, fragrant flower gardens, / accompanied by swarms of bees greedy for honey,

4.4.s:
paṃcāśatkoṭigopīnāṃ vilāsaiśca virājitam ..
śrīkṛṣṇatulyarūpāṇāṃ sadratnaguṃṭhitairvaraiḥ ..128..
4.4.d:
पंचाशत्कोटिगोपीनां विलासैश्च विराजितम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णतुल्यरूपाणां सद्रत्नगुंठितैर्वरैः ॥128॥
4.4.m: radiant with the sports of fifty crores of cowherd maidens, / and with noble [youths] of forms equal to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, enveloped in excellent jewels.

4.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā vṛṃdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yayurgolokamīśvarāḥ ..
parito vartulākāraṃ koṭiyojanavistṛtam .. 129 ...
4.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा वृंदावनं रम्यं ययुर्गोलोकमीश्वराः ॥
परितो वर्तुलाकारं कोटियोजनविस्तृतम् ॥ 129 ॥।
4.4.m: Having seen charming Vṛndāvana, the lords went to Goloka, / which was circular all around, extending for a crore of yojanas, / enclosed by a jeweled rampart, endowed with four gates, O sage, / and guarded by gatekeepers along with hosts of cowherds;

4.4.s:
ratnaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ caturddhārānvitaṃ mune..
gopānāṃ ca samūhaiśca dvārapālaiḥ samanvitam .. 130 ..
4.4.d:
रत्नप्राकारसंयुक्तं चतुर्द्धारान्वितं मुने॥
गोपानां च समूहैश्च द्वारपालैः समन्वितम् ॥ 130 ॥

4.4.s:
āśramai ratnakhacitairnānābhogasamanvitaiḥ ..
gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇabhṛtyānāṃ paṃcāśatkoṭibhiryutam ..131..
4.4.d:
आश्रमै रत्नखचितैर्नानाभोगसमन्वितैः ॥
गोपीनां कृष्णभृत्यानां पंचाशत्कोटिभिर्युतम् ॥131॥
4.4.m: furnished with fifty crores of jewel-inlaid hermitages / filled with various enjoyments for the cowherd maidens and Kṛṣṇa's servants;

4.4.s:
bhaktānāṃ gopavṛndānāmāśramaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ ..
tato'dhikasuvistīrṇaiḥ sadratnagrathitairyutam ..132..
4.4.d:
भक्तानां गोपवृन्दानामाश्रमैः शतकोटिभिः ॥
ततोऽधिकसुविस्तीर्णैः सद्रत्नग्रथितैर्युतम् ॥132॥
4.4.m: with a hundred crores of hermitages for the devoted cowherds, / even more extensive than those, fashioned of fine gems;

4.4.s:
āśramaiḥ pārṣadānāṃ ca tato'dhikavilakṣaṇaiḥ ..
amūlyaratnaracitaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ daśakoṭibhiḥ .. 133 .
4.4.d:
आश्रमैः पार्षदानां च ततोऽधिकविलक्षणैः ॥
अमूल्यरत्नरचितैः संयुक्तं दशकोटिभिः ॥ 133 ।
4.4.m: furnished with ten crores of hermitages for the attendants, / even more extraordinary than the former, made of priceless jewels;

4.4.s:
pārṣadapravarāṇāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇarūpadhāriṇām ..
āśramaiḥ koṭibhiryuktaṃ sadratnena vinirmitaiḥ .. 134..
4.4.d:
पार्षदप्रवराणां च श्रीकृष्णरूपधारिणाम् ॥
आश्रमैः कोटिभिर्युक्तं सद्रत्नेन विनिर्मितैः ॥ 134॥
4.4.m: with crores of hermitages built of fine jewels / for the foremost attendants who bear the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa;

4.4.s:
rādhikāśuddhabhaktānāṃ gopīnāmāśramairvaraiḥ ..
sadratnaracitairdravyairdvātriṃśatkoṭibhiryutam..135..
4.4.d:
राधिकाशुद्धभक्तानां गोपीनामाश्रमैर्वरैः ॥
सद्रत्नरचितैर्द्रव्यैर्द्वात्रिंशत्कोटिभिर्युतम्॥135॥
4.4.m: with thirty-two crores of excellent hermitages built of fine jewels / and goods for the cowherd maidens who are pure devotees of Rādhikā; / and adorned with ten crores of exceedingly lovely mansions / made of gems, jewels, and the like for their handmaidens. / Devotees who have been purified by austerities for a hundred births in the land of Bhārata, / who are devoted to the worship of Hari, and who bring about the dissolution of their karma,

4.4.s:
tāsāṃ ca kikarīṇāṃ ca bhavanaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ..
maṇiratnādiracitaiḥ śobhitaṃ daśakoṭibhiḥ..136..
4.4.d:
तासां च किकरीणां च भवनैः सुमनोहरैः॥
मणिरत्नादिरचितैः शोभितं दशकोटिभिः॥136॥

4.4.s:
śatajanmatapaḥpūtā bhaktā ye bhārate bhuvi ..
haribhaktiparā ye ca karmanirvāṇakārakāḥ .. 137 ..
4.4.d:
शतजन्मतपःपूता भक्ता ये भारते भुवि ॥
हरिभक्तिपरा ये च कर्मनिर्वाणकारकाः ॥ 137 ॥

4.4.s:
svapne jñāne harerdhyāne viviṣṭamānasā mune ..
rādhākṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti prajapaṃto divāniśam .. 138 ..
4.4.d:
स्वप्ने ज्ञाने हरेर्ध्याने विविष्टमानसा मुने ॥
राधाकृष्णेति कृष्णेति प्रजपंतो दिवानिशम् ॥ 138 ॥
4.4.m: whose minds are entered into the meditation of Hari in dream and waking knowledge, O sage, / repeating day and night, 'Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa,' 'Kṛṣṇa,'

4.4.s:
teṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ nivāsaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
sadratnamaṇinirmāṇairnānābhogasamanvitaiḥ .. 139 ..
4.4.d:
तेषां श्रीकृष्णभक्तानां निवासैः सुमनोहरैः ॥
सद्रत्नमणिनिर्माणैर्नानाभोगसमन्वितैः ॥ 139 ॥
4.4.m: —for those devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa there were exceedingly enchanting dwellings / fashioned of fine gems and jewels, supplied with manifold enjoyments,

4.4.s:
puṣpaśayyāpuṣpamālāśvetacāmaraśobhitaiḥ..
ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyairharinmaṇisaparpitaiḥ..140..
4.4.d:
पुष्पशय्यापुष्पमालाश्वेतचामरशोभितैः॥
रत्नदर्पणशोभाढ्यैर्हरिन्मणिसपर्पितैः॥140॥
4.4.m: adorned with flower beds, flower garlands, and white fly-whisks, / rich in the beauty of gem-mirrors, set with emeralds, / their crests crowned with clusters of priceless jewel vases, / hung with fine fabrics inside—endowed with a hundred crores [of such dwellings].

4.4.s:
amūlyaratnakalaśasamūhānvitaśekharaiḥ..
sūkṣmavastrābhyaṃtaritaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ .. 14 1 ..
4.4.d:
अमूल्यरत्नकलशसमूहान्वितशेखरैः॥
सूक्ष्मवस्त्राभ्यंतरितैः संयुक्तं शतकोटिभिः ॥ 14 1 ॥

4.4.s:
devāstamadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiyaddūraṃ yayurmudā ..
tatrākṣayavaṭaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśurjagadīśvarāḥ .. |..142..
4.4.d:
देवास्तमद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा कियद्दूरं ययुर्मुदा ॥
तत्राक्षयवटं रम्यं ददृशुर्जगदीश्वराः ॥ ।॥142॥
4.4.m: Having seen that marvel, the gods joyfully proceeded some distance; / there the lords of the universe beheld the charming Imperishable Banyan Tree,

4.4.s:
paṃcayojanavistīrṇamūrdhvaṃ taddviguṇaṃ mune ..
sahasraskaṃdhasaṃyuktaśākhāsaṃsthāsamanvitam .. 143..
4.4.d:
पंचयोजनविस्तीर्णमूर्ध्वं तद्द्विगुणं मुने ॥
सहस्रस्कंधसंयुक्तशाखासंस्थासमन्वितम् ॥ 143॥
4.4.m: five yojanas in breadth, O sage, and twice that in height, / possessed of thousands of trunks and an array of branches.

4.4.s:
raktapakkaphalākīrṇaṃ śobhitaṃ ratnavedibhiḥ ..
kṛṣṇasvarūpāṃstanmūle dadṛśurvallabhāñchiśūn .. 144 ..
4.4.d:
रक्तपक्कफलाकीर्णं शोभितं रत्नवेदिभिः ॥
कृष्णस्वरूपांस्तन्मूले ददृशुर्वल्लभाञ्छिशून् ॥ 144 ॥
4.4.m: covered with ripe red fruits, adorned with jewelled platforms; / at its base, they beheld beloved boys, whose form was Kṛṣṇa's own. // 144

4.4.s:
pītavastraparīdhānānkrīḍāsaktamanoharān ..
candanokṣitasarvāṃgānratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān .. 145 ..
4.4.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानान्क्रीडासक्तमनोहरान् ॥
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वांगान्रत्नभूषणभूषितान् ॥ 145 ॥
4.4.m:
Dressed in yellow garments, captivating in their absorption in play, / all their limbs smeared with sandalwood, adorned with jewelled ornaments, // 145
the lords of the gods beheld there the foremost attendants of Hari. / Not far from there, they saw a charming royal highway, // 146
fashioned all around, O sage, with gems that had the appearance of vermilion, / along with sapphire, ruby, diamond, and rucaka stones, // 147
endowed with raised platforms built all about, and a jewelled pavilion, / besmeared with the liquid of sandalwood, aloe, musk, and saffron, // 148
provided with curds, parched grain, fruits, flowers, and sprouts of dūrvā grass, / furnished with sandalwood sprouts tied with fine threads, // 149
adorned with clusters of plantain pillars anointed with saffron, / with pots resting on rings of excellent gems, accompanied by branches and fruit, // 150
anointed with vermilion and saffron, smeared with fragrant sandalwood, / decorated with flower garlands, and adorned with trees, // 151
and surrounded by groups of cowherd women immersed in play. / Having seen these delightful houses, built with jewelled stairs / out of priceless jewels, // 152
charming with garments cleansed by fire, white cāmaras and mirrors, / wonderful with jewelled couches, and adorned with flower garlands, // 153
endowed with sixteen gateways, guarded by gatekeepers, / surrounded all around with moats, enclosed by walls of gems, // 154
and besmeared with the liquid of sandalwood, aloe, musk, and saffron, / those gods, eager to go on, // 155
quickly walked some distance. Then they saw the beautiful / hermitage of Rādhikā, the mistress of the rāsa dance, O Nārada, // 156
built beautifully for the supreme goddess of goddesses, the foremost of the cowherd women, / who is dearer to Kṛṣṇa than his own life, captivating with delightful objects, // 157
entirely beyond description, not to be defined even by the learned, / circular in a very pleasing shape, six gavyūtis in extent, // 158
endowed with a hundred mansions, blazing with the splendour of gems, / excellent, constructed with masses of the essence of priceless jewels, // 159

4.4.s:
dadṛśustatra deveśāḥ pārṣadapravarānhareḥ ..
tato'vidūre dadṛśū rājamārgaṃ manoharam .. 146 ..
4.4.d:
ददृशुस्तत्र देवेशाः पार्षदप्रवरान्हरेः ॥
ततोऽविदूरे ददृशू राजमार्गं मनोहरम् ॥ 146 ॥

4.4.s:
siṃdūrākāramaṇibhiḥ parito racitaṃ mune ..
iṃdranīlaiḥ padmarāgairhīrakai rucakaistathā .. 147 ..
4.4.d:
सिंदूराकारमणिभिः परितो रचितं मुने ॥
इंद्रनीलैः पद्मरागैर्हीरकै रुचकैस्तथा ॥ 147 ॥

4.4.s:
nirmitairvedibhiryuktaṃ parito ratnamaṃḍapam ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam .. 148 ..
4.4.d:
निर्मितैर्वेदिभिर्युक्तं परितो रत्नमंडपम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवचर्चितम् ॥ 148 ॥

4.4.s:
dadhipūrṇalājaphalapuṣpadūrvāṃkurānvitam ..
sūkṣmasūtragraṃthiyuktaśrīkhaṃḍapallavānvitam .. 149 ..
4.4.d:
दधिपूर्णलाजफलपुष्पदूर्वांकुरान्वितम् ॥
सूक्ष्मसूत्रग्रंथियुक्तश्रीखंडपल्लवान्वितम् ॥ 149 ॥

4.4.s:
raṃbhāstaṃbhasamūhaiśca kuṅkumāktairvirājitam ..
sadratnamaṃḍalaghaṭaiḥ phalaśākhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 150 ..
4.4.d:
रंभास्तंभसमूहैश्च कुङ्कुमाक्तैर्विराजितम् ॥
सद्रत्नमंडलघटैः फलशाखासमन्वितैः ॥ 150 ॥

4.4.s:
siṃdūrakuṃkumāktaiśca gaṃdhacaṃdanacarcitaiḥ ..
bhūṣitaiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ pādapaiḥ paribhūṣitam .. 151 ..
4.4.d:
सिंदूरकुंकुमाक्तैश्च गंधचंदनचर्चितैः ॥
भूषितैः पुष्पमालाभिः पादपैः परिभूषितम् ॥ 151 ॥

4.4.s:
gopikānāṃ samūhaiśca krīḍāsaktaiśca veṣṭitama ..
bahumūlyena ratnena ratnasopānanirmitān .. 152 ..
4.4.d:
गोपिकानां समूहैश्च क्रीडासक्तैश्च वेष्टितम ॥
बहुमूल्येन रत्नेन रत्नसोपाननिर्मितान् ॥ 152 ॥

4.4.s:
vahniśaucāṃśukai ramyaiḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ..
ratnatalpavicitraiśca puṣpamālyairvirājitāna .. 153 ..
4.4.d:
वह्निशौचांशुकै रम्यैः श्वेतचामरदर्पणैः ॥
रत्नतल्पविचित्रैश्च पुष्पमाल्यैर्विराजितान ॥ 153 ॥

4.4.s:
ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktāndvārapālaiśca rakṣitān ..
paritaḥ parikhāyuktānratnaprākāraveṣṭitān .. 154 ..
4.4.d:
षोडशद्वारसंयुक्तान्द्वारपालैश्च रक्षितान् ॥
परितः परिखायुक्तान्रत्नप्राकारवेष्टितान् ॥ 154 ॥

4.4.s:
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitān..
gṛhānmanoramāndṛṣṭvā te devā gamanotsukāḥ .. 155 ..
4.4.d:
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवचर्चितान्॥
गृहान्मनोरमान्दृष्ट्वा ते देवा गमनोत्सुकाः ॥ 155 ॥

4.4.s:
jagmuḥ śīghraṃ kiyaddūraṃ dadṛśuḥ sundaraṃ tataḥ ..
āśramaṃ rādhikāyāśca rāseśvaryāśca nārada .. 156 ..
4.4.d:
जग्मुः शीघ्रं कियद्दूरं ददृशुः सुन्दरं ततः ॥
आश्रमं राधिकायाश्च रासेश्वर्याश्च नारद ॥ 156 ॥

4.4.s:
devādhidevyā gopīnāṃ varāyāścārunirmitam ..
prāṇādhikāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ramyadravyamanoharam .. 157 ..
4.4.d:
देवाधिदेव्या गोपीनां वरायाश्चारुनिर्मितम् ॥
प्राणाधिकायाः कृष्णस्य रम्यद्रव्यमनोहरम् ॥ 157 ॥

4.4.s:
sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca paṃḍitairna nirūpitam ..
sucāruvartulākāraṃ ṣaḍgavyūtipramāṇakam .. 158 ..
4.4.d:
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं च पंडितैर्न निरूपितम् ॥
सुचारुवर्तुलाकारं षड्गव्यूतिप्रमाणकम् ॥ 158 ॥

4.4.s:
śatamaṃdirasaṃyuktaṃ jvalitaṃ ratnatejasā ..
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ cayaurviracitaṃ varam .. 159 ..
4.4.d:
शतमंदिरसंयुक्तं ज्वलितं रत्नतेजसा ॥
अमूल्यरत्नसाराणां चयौर्विरचितं वरम् ॥ 159 ॥

4.4.s:
durlaṃghyābhirgabhīrābhiḥ parikhābhiḥ suśobhitam ..
kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ puṣpodyānaśatāṃtaram .. 160 ..
4.4.d:
दुर्लंघ्याभिर्गभीराभिः परिखाभिः सुशोभितम् ॥
कल्पवृक्षैः परिवृतं पुष्पोद्यानशतांतरम् ॥ 160 ॥
4.4.m:
beautifully adorned with deep moats difficult to cross, / surrounded by wish-granting trees, with intervals of hundreds of flower gardens, // 160
enclosed by walls studded with precious gems, / having excellent jewelled platforms, and provided with seven gates, // 161
joined with colourful jewelled paintings, wondrous and circular, O sage. / Starting from the seven principal gates in succession, in succession, O sage, // 162
it was endowed with sixteen gates on every side as well. / Having seen the rampart, a thousand bows in height, // 163
resplendent with its brilliance, beautiful with clusters of small pots made of excellent jewels, / the gods were filled with the greatest astonishment. // 164
Then, circumambulating it, they walked a short distance in joy. / As they advanced, that hermitage fell behind them. // 165
They saw other hermitages of the cowherds and cowherd women, / fashioned of priceless jewels, a hundred crores in number, O sage. // 166
Looking continually around at every hermitage of the cowherds, / and other charming, fresh, and delightful ones of the cowherd women, // 167
and seeing the entire Goloka, the gods had their limbs thrilled with horripilation. / That same round, charming forest was Vṛndāvana; // 368
they saw the Śataśṛṅga mountain, and outside it the Virajā river. / The gods went to that Virajā, and saw only empty space. // 169
And Goloka rested on the air, wonderful, made of excellent gems, / fashioned by the will of the Lord by virtue of Rādhikā's command, // 170
endowed with thousands of lakes, an abode of pure auspiciousness. / The gods also saw a most charming dance there, // 171
and delightful singing with beautiful melodies, celebrating the virtues of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. / Merely upon hearing the nectar of that song, the gods swooned, O sage. // 172
Regaining consciousness in a moment, their minds fixed on Kṛṣṇa, / those gods beheld the greatest wonder, charming in every place. // 173
They saw all the cowherd women assuming diverse disguises:

4.4.s:
sumūlyaratnakhacitaprākāraiḥ pariveṣṭitam ..
sadratnavedikāyuktairyuktaṃ dvāraiśca saptabhiḥ .. 161 ..
4.4.d:
सुमूल्यरत्नखचितप्राकारैः परिवेष्टितम् ॥
सद्रत्नवेदिकायुक्तैर्युक्तं द्वारैश्च सप्तभिः ॥ 161 ॥

4.4.s:
saṃyuktaratnacitraiśca vicitrairvartulaṃ mune ..
pradhānasaptadvārebhyaḥ kramaśaḥ kramaśo mune .. 162 ..
4.4.d:
संयुक्तरत्नचित्रैश्च विचित्रैर्वर्तुलं मुने ॥
प्रधानसप्तद्वारेभ्यः क्रमशः क्रमशो मुने ॥ 162 ॥

4.4.s:
sarvato'pi tatastatra ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyutam ..
devā ddaṣṭvā ca prākāraṃ sahasradhanurucchritam .. 163 ..
4.4.d:
सर्वतोऽपि ततस्तत्र षोडशद्वारसंयुतम् ॥
देवा द्दष्ट्वा च प्राकारं सहस्रधनुरुच्छ्रितम् ॥ 163 ॥

4.4.s:
sadratnakṣudrakalaśasamūhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
pradīptaṃ tejasā ramyaṃ paramaṃ vismayaṃ yayuḥ .. 164 ..
4.4.d:
सद्रत्नक्षुद्रकलशसमूहैः सुमनोहरैः ॥
प्रदीप्तं तेजसा रम्यं परमं विस्मयं ययुः ॥ 164 ॥

4.4.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kiyaddūraṃ yayurmudā ..
purato gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ paścādbhūtastadāśramaḥ .. 165 ..
4.4.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य कियद्दूरं ययुर्मुदा ॥
पुरतो गच्छतां तेषां पश्चाद्भूतस्तदाश्रमः ॥ 165 ॥

4.4.s:
gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca dadṛśuścāśramānparān ..
amūlyaratnaracitāñchatakoṭimitānmune .. 166 ..
4.4.d:
गोपानां गोपिकानां च ददृशुश्चाश्रमान्परान् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नरचिताञ्छतकोटिमितान्मुने ॥ 166 ॥

4.4.s:
darśaṃdarśaṃ ca parito gopānāṃ sarvamāśramam ..
gopikānāṃ cāparaṃ vā ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃnavam .. 167 ..
4.4.d:
दर्शंदर्शं च परितो गोपानां सर्वमाश्रमम् ॥
गोपिकानां चापरं वा रम्यं रम्यं नवंनवम् ॥ 167 ॥

4.4.s:
golokaṃ nikhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā pulakāṃgaṃ yayuḥ surāḥ ..
tadeva vartulākāraṃ ramyaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ vanam .. 368 ..
4.4.d:
गोलोकं निखिलं दृष्ट्वा पुलकांगं ययुः सुराः ॥
तदेव वर्तुलाकारं रम्यं वृंदावनं वनम् ॥ 368 ॥

4.4.s:
dadṛśuḥ śataśṛṃgaṃ ca tadbahirvirajānadīm ..
virajāṃ tāṃ yayurdevā dadṛśuḥ śūnyameva ca .. 169 ..
4.4.d:
ददृशुः शतशृंगं च तद्बहिर्विरजानदीम् ॥
विरजां तां ययुर्देवा ददृशुः शून्यमेव च ॥ 169 ॥

4.4.s:
vāyvādhāraṃ ca golokaṃ sadratnamayamadbhutam ..
īśvarecchāvinirmāṇaṃ rādhikājñānubaṃdhanāt .. 170 ..
4.4.d:
वाय्वाधारं च गोलोकं सद्रत्नमयमद्भुतम् ॥
ईश्वरेच्छाविनिर्माणं राधिकाज्ञानुबंधनात् ॥ 170 ॥

4.4.s:
yuktaṃ sahasraiḥ sarasāṃ kevalaṃ maṃgalālayam ..
nṛtyaṃ ca dadṛśustatra devāśca sumanoharam .. 171 ..
4.4.d:
युक्तं सहस्रैः सरसां केवलं मंगलालयम् ॥
नृत्यं च ददृशुस्तत्र देवाश्च सुमनोहरम् ॥ 171 ॥

4.4.s:
sutānaṃ cārusaṃgītaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaguṇānvitam ..
śrutvaiva gītapīyūṣaṃ mūrchāmāpuḥ surā mune .. 172 ..
4.4.d:
सुतानं चारुसंगीतं राधाकृष्णगुणान्वितम् ॥
श्रुत्वैव गीतपीयूषं मूर्छामापुः सुरा मुने ॥ 172 ॥

4.4.s:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya te devāḥ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ..
dadṛśuḥ paramāścaryaṃ sthānesthāne manoharam .. 173 ..
4.4.d:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य ते देवाः कृष्णमानसाः ॥
ददृशुः परमाश्चर्यं स्थानेस्थाने मनोहरम् ॥ 173 ॥

4.4.s:
dadṛśurgopikāḥ sarvā nānāveṣavidhāyikāḥ ..
kāścinmṛdaṃgahastāśca kāścidvīṇākarā varāḥ .. 174 ..
4.4.d:
ददृशुर्गोपिकाः सर्वा नानावेषविधायिकाः ॥
काश्चिन्मृदंगहस्ताश्च काश्चिद्वीणाकरा वराः ॥ 174 ॥

4.4.s:
kāściccāmarahastāśca karatālakarāḥ parāḥ ..
kāścidyaṃtravādyahastā ratnanūpuraśobhitāḥ .. 175 ..
4.4.d:
काश्चिच्चामरहस्ताश्च करतालकराः पराः ॥
काश्चिद्यंत्रवाद्यहस्ता रत्ननूपुरशोभिताः ॥ 175 ॥

4.4.s:
sadratnakiṃkiṇījālaśabdena śabditā varāḥ ..
kāścinmastakakuṃbhāśca nṛtyabhedamanorathāḥ .. 176 ..
4.4.d:
सद्रत्नकिंकिणीजालशब्देन शब्दिता वराः ॥
काश्चिन्मस्तककुंभाश्च नृत्यभेदमनोरथाः ॥ 176 ॥

4.4.s:
puṃveṣanāyikāḥ kāścitkāścittāsāṃ ca nāyikāḥ ..
kṛṣṇaveṣadharāḥ kāścidrādhāveṣadharāḥ parāḥ .. 177 ..
4.4.d:
पुंवेषनायिकाः काश्चित्काश्चित्तासां च नायिकाः ॥
कृष्णवेषधराः काश्चिद्राधावेषधराः पराः ॥ 177 ॥

4.4.s:
kāścitsaṃyogaviratāḥ kāścidāliṃgane ratāḥ ..
krīḍāsaktāśca tā dṛṣṭvā sasmitā jagadīśvarāḥ .. 178 ..
4.4.d:
काश्चित्संयोगविरताः काश्चिदालिंगने रताः ॥
क्रीडासक्ताश्च ता दृष्ट्वा सस्मिता जगदीश्वराः ॥ 178 ॥

4.4.s:
pragacchaṃtaḥ kiyaddūraṃ dadṛśuścāśramānbahūn ..
rādhāsakhīnāṃ gehāṃśca pradhānānāṃ ca nārada ..179..
4.4.d:
प्रगच्छंतः कियद्दूरं ददृशुश्चाश्रमान्बहून् ॥
राधासखीनां गेहांश्च प्रधानानां च नारद ॥179॥

4.4.s:
rūpeṇaiva guṇenaiva veṣeṇa yauvanena ca ..
saubhāgyenaiva vayasā sadṛśīnāṃ ca tatra vai .. 180 ..
4.4.d:
रूपेणैव गुणेनैव वेषेण यौवनेन च ॥
सौभाग्येनैव वयसा सदृशीनां च तत्र वै ॥ 180 ॥

4.4.s:
trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca rādhikāyāśca gopikāḥ ..
veṣānirvacanīyāśca tāsāṃ nāmāni ca śṛṇu .. 181 ..
4.4.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वयस्याश्च राधिकायाश्च गोपिकाः ॥
वेषानिर्वचनीयाश्च तासां नामानि च शृणु ॥ 181 ॥

4.4.s:
suśīlā ca śaśikalā yamunā mādhavī ratī ..
kadaṃbamālā kuṃtī ca jāhnavī ca svayaṃprabhā .. 182 ..
4.4.d:
सुशीला च शशिकला यमुना माधवी रती ॥
कदंबमाला कुंती च जाह्नवी च स्वयंप्रभा ॥ 182 ॥

4.4.s:
caṃdramukhī ca sāvitrī gāyatrī sumukhī sukhā ..
padmālayā pārijātā gaurī ca sarvamaṃgalā .. 183 ..
4.4.d:
चंद्रमुखी च सावित्री गायत्री सुमुखी सुखा ॥
पद्मालया पारिजाता गौरी च सर्वमंगला ॥ 183 ॥

4.4.s:
kālikā kamalā durgā bhāratī ca sarasvatī ..
gaṃgā 'mbikā madhumatī caṃpā'parṇā ca suṃdarī .. 184 ..
4.4.d:
कालिका कमला दुर्गा भारती च सरस्वती ॥
गंगा ऽम्बिका मधुमती चंपाऽपर्णा च सुंदरी ॥ 184 ॥

4.4.s:
kṛṣṇapriyā satī caiva naṃdinī naṃdaneti ca ..
etāḥ samānāḥ sadratnaracitā rādhikāpriyāḥ .. 185 ..
4.4.d:
कृष्णप्रिया सती चैव नंदिनी नंदनेति च ॥
एताः समानाः सद्रत्नरचिता राधिकाप्रियाः ॥ 185 ॥

4.4.s:
etāsāṃ samarūpāṇāṃ ratnadhātuvicitritān ..
nānāprakāracitreṇa citritānsumanoharān .. 185 .
4.4.d:
एतासां समरूपाणां रत्नधातुविचित्रितान् ॥
नानाप्रकारचित्रेण चित्रितान्सुमनोहरान् ॥ 185 ।
4.4.m:
some had mṛdaṅga drums in their hands, while some excellent ones held vīṇās; // 174
some held cāmaras in their hands, and others held cymbals in their hands; / some held musical instruments in their hands, adorned with jewelled anklets, // 175
excellent women made resonant by the sound of networks of fine gem-bells; / some had jars on their heads, intent upon varieties of dance; // 176
some were heroines dressed as men, and some were heroines of those [others]; / some wore the guise of Kṛṣṇa, while others wore the guise of Rādhā; // 177
some had withdrawn from union, while others were delighting in embraces. / Seeing them absorbed in play, the lords of the world smiled. // 178
Going forward a short distance, they saw many hermitages / and the houses of Rādhā's companions, the foremost among them, O Nārada, // 179
who in beauty, virtue, dress, youthfulness, / good fortune, and age were indeed identical there. // 180
There are thirty-three companions of Rādhikā, cowherd women / whose adornment is beyond description; hear their names: // 181
Suśīlā, Śaśikalā, Yamunā, Mādhavī, Ratī, / Kadambamālā, Kuntī, Jāhnavī, Svayaṃprabhā, // 182
Candramukhī, Sāvitrī, Gāyatrī, Sumukhī, Sukhā, / Padmālayā, Pārijātā, Gaurī, Sarvamaṅgalā, // 183
Kālikā, Kamalā, Durgā, Bhāratī, Sarasvatī, / Gaṅgā, Ambikā, Madhumatī, Campā, Aparṇā, Sundarī, // 184
Kṛṣṇapriyā, Satī, and also Nandinī and Nandanā. / These equal, beloved [companions] of Rādhikā were adorned with excellent jewels. // 185
[They saw the homes] of these women of identical form, varied with gems and minerals, / adorned with diverse kinds of wondrous pictures, and very delightful. // 185

4.4.s:
amūlyaratnakalaśasamūhaiḥ śikharojjvalān ..
sadratnaracitāñchubhrānāśramāndadṛśustathā .. 187 ..
4.4.d:
अमूल्यरत्नकलशसमूहैः शिखरोज्ज्वलान् ॥
सद्रत्नरचिताञ्छुभ्रानाश्रमान्ददृशुस्तथा ॥ 187 ॥
4.4.m:
with pinnacles gleaming with clusters of priceless jewelled pitchers; / likewise, they saw the radiant hermitages built of fine jewels.
Beyond and above the cosmic egg there is no realm; / above it, everything consists of the void, and there creation ends.
Below the seven netherworlds, there is no creation; / below them is water, darkness, impassable and invisible. / Hear from me everything up to the cosmic egg and beyond it.
Thus ends the fourth chapter, entitled “Description of Goloka,” in the dialogue between Nārāyaṇa and Nārada, in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmavaivarta.

4.4.s:
brahmāṃḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca nāsti lokastadūrdhvakaḥ ..
ūrdhvaṃ śūnyamayaṃ sarvaṃ tadaṃtā sṛṣṭireva ca .. 188. ..
rasātalebhyaḥ saptabhyo nāstyadhaḥ sṛṣṭireva ca ..
tadadhaśca jalaṃ dhvāṃtamagaṃtavyamadṛśyakam ..
brahmāṃḍāṃtaṃ tadbahiśca sarvaṃ matto niśāmaya .. 189 ..
4.4.d:
ब्रह्मांडाद्बहिरूर्ध्वं च नास्ति लोकस्तदूर्ध्वकः ॥
ऊर्ध्वं शून्यमयं सर्वं तदंता सृष्टिरेव च ॥ 188॥।
रसातलेभ्यः सप्तभ्यो नास्त्यधः सृष्टिरेव च ॥
तदधश्च जलं ध्वांतमगंतव्यमदृश्यकम् ॥
ब्रह्मांडांतं तद्बहिश्च सर्वं मत्तो निशामय ॥ 189 ॥

4.5.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
golokaṃ nikhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
punarājagmū rādhāyāḥ pradhānadvārameva ca .. 1 ..
4.5.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
गोलोकं निखिलं दृष्ट्वा देवास्ते हृष्टमानसाः ॥
पुनराजग्मू राधायाः प्रधानद्वारमेव च ॥ 1 ॥
4.5.m:
Glorious Nārāyaṇa said: / Having seen all of Goloka, those gods, glad at heart, / came once more to the principal gateway of Rādhā.
It was built of fine gems and jewels, furnished with a pair of platforms / of gems having the appearance of turmeric mingled with diamonds,
and adorned with door-leaves crafted of priceless jewels. / At the gate they saw appointed the peerless Vīrabhānu,
seated upon a jewelled throne, adorned with jewelled ornaments, / clad in yellow garments, and radiant with a crown of fine gems.
To the doorkeeper at that gate, wonderful and most marvellous with varied wonders, / the gods gladly made their entire petition.
The gatekeeper spoke without hesitation to the lords of the gods: / “I am not able to permit entry at this time without an order.”
He dispatched attendants to the abode of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; / having obtained Hari’s permission, O sage, he granted the gods passage.
Having conversed with him, the gods went to the excellent second gate, / which was even more wondrous than that one, beautiful and very enchanting.
At that gate they saw appointed Candrabhānu, O Nārada, / a youth, dark-complexioned, handsome, an excellent holder of a golden staff,
seated upon a jewelled throne, adorned with jewelled ornaments, / and attended by a host of five hundred thousand cowherds.
Having conversed with him, the gods went to the excellent third gate, / which was exceedingly beautiful, wondrous, and blazing with the splendour of gems.
At that gate they saw appointed Sūryabhānu, O Nārada, / two-armed, with a flute in his hand, a youth dark and beautiful,
with his cheeks adorned by a pair of jewelled earrings, / holding a jewelled staff, supreme, a paramount attendant of Rādhā and the Lord,
surrounded by nine hundred thousand cowherds like a king of kings. / Having conversed with him, the gods went on to the fourth gate,
distinct from the others, charming, and brightly blazing with the splendour of gems,

4.5.s:
sadratnamaṇinirmāṇaṃ vedikāyugmasaṃyutam ..
haridrākāramaṇinā vajrasaṃmiśritena ca .. 2 ..
4.5.d:
सद्रत्नमणिनिर्माणं वेदिकायुग्मसंयुतम् ॥
हरिद्राकारमणिना वज्रसंमिश्रितेन च ॥ 2 ॥

4.5.s:
amūlyaratnaracitakapāṭena vibhūṣitam ..
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśurvīrabhānumanuttamam .. 3 ..
4.5.d:
अमूल्यरत्नरचितकपाटेन विभूषितम् ॥
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशुर्वीरभानुमनुत्तमम् ॥ 3 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
pītavastraparīdhānaṃ sadratnamukuṭojjvalam .. 4 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च रत्नाभरणभूषितम् ॥
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानं सद्रत्नमुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 4 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāraṃ citravicitreṇa vicitraṃ paramādbhutam ..
sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakrurdevā dauvārikaṃ mudā .. 5 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारं चित्रविचित्रेण विचित्रं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
सर्वं निवेदनं चक्रुर्देवा दौवारिकं मुदा ॥ 5 ॥

4.5.s:
tānuvāca dvārapālo niḥśaṃkaṃ tridaśeśvarān ..
nāhaṃ vinā''jñayā gaṃtuṃ dātuṃ sāṃpratamīśvaraḥ ..6..
4.5.d:
तानुवाच द्वारपालो निःशंकं त्रिदशेश्वरान् ॥
नाहं विना'ऽज्ञया गंतुं दातुं सांप्रतमीश्वरः ॥6॥

4.5.s:
kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇasthānameva ca ..
hareranujñāṃ saṃprāpya dadau gaṃtuṃ surānmune .. 7 ..
4.5.d:
किंकरान्प्रेषयामास श्रीकृष्णस्थानमेव च ॥
हरेरनुज्ञां संप्राप्य ददौ गंतुं सुरान्मुने ॥ 7 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā dvitīyaṃ dvāramuttamam ..
tato'dhikaṃ vicitraṃ ca suṃdaraṃ sumanoharam .. 5 ..
4.5.d:
तं संभाष्य ययुर्देवा द्वितीयं द्वारमुत्तमम् ॥
ततोऽधिकं विचित्रं च सुंदरं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuścaṃdrabhānuṃ ca nārada ..
kiśoraṃ śyāmalaṃ cāru svarṇavetradharaṃ varam .. 9 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशुश्चंद्रभानुं च नारद ॥
किशोरं श्यामलं चारु स्वर्णवेत्रधरं वरम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
gopānāṃ ca samūhena paṃcalakṣeṇa śobhitam .. 4.5.10 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥
गोपानां च समूहेन पंचलक्षेण शोभितम् ॥ 4.5.10 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevāstṛtīyaṃ dvāramuttamam ..
tato'tisundaraṃ citraṃ jvalantaṃ maṇitejasā .. 11 ..
4.5.d:
तं संभाष्य ययुर्देवास्तृतीयं द्वारमुत्तमम् ॥
ततोऽतिसुन्दरं चित्रं ज्वलन्तं मणितेजसा ॥ 11 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuḥ sūryabhānuṃ ca nārada ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram .. 12 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशुः सूर्यभानुं च नारद ॥
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं किशोरं श्यामसुन्दरम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.5.s:
maṇikuṇḍalayugmena kapolasthalarājitam ..
ratnadaṃḍakaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣyaṃ rādheśayoḥ param .. 13 ..
4.5.d:
मणिकुण्डलयुग्मेन कपोलस्थलराजितम् ॥
रत्नदंडकरं श्रेष्ठं प्रेष्यं राधेशयोः परम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.5.s:
navalakṣeṇa gopānāṃ veṣṭitaṃ ca nṛpeṃdravat ..
taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevāścaturthaṃ dvārameva ca ..14..
4.5.d:
नवलक्षेण गोपानां वेष्टितं च नृपेंद्रवत् ॥
तं संभाष्य ययुर्देवाश्चतुर्थं द्वारमेव च ॥14॥

4.5.s:
tebhyo vilakṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ sudīptaṃ maṇitejasā ..
atyadbhutavicitreṇa bhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam .. 15 ..
4.5.d:
तेभ्यो विलक्षणं रम्यं सुदीप्तं मणितेजसा ॥
अत्यद्भुतविचित्रेण भूषितं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśurvasubhānuṃ vrajeśvaram ..
kiśoraṃ sundaravaraṃ maṇidaṇḍakaraṃ param .. 16 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशुर्वसुभानुं व्रजेश्वरम् ॥
किशोरं सुन्दरवरं मणिदण्डकरं परम् ॥ 16 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhaṃ ca sasmitaṃ sumanoharam .. 17 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥
पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठं च सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā pañcamaṃ dvārameva ca ..
vajrabhittisthitaiścitravicitrairjvalitaṃ param .. 18 ..
4.5.d:
तं संभाष्य ययुर्देवा पञ्चमं द्वारमेव च ॥
वज्रभित्तिस्थितैश्चित्रविचित्रैर्ज्वलितं परम् ॥ 18 ॥

4.5.s:
dvārapālaṃ ca dadṛśurdevabhānuṃ ca tatra vai ..
cāru siṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam .. 19 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारपालं च ददृशुर्देवभानुं च तत्र वै ॥
चारु सिंहासनस्थं च रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥ 19 ॥

4.5.s:
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvibhūṣitam ..
kadaṃbapuṣpasaṃsaktasadratnakuṇḍalojjvalam .. 4.5.20 ..
4.5.d:
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च रत्नमालाविभूषितम् ॥
कदंबपुष्पसंसक्तसद्रत्नकुण्डलोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 4.5.20 ॥

4.5.s:
caṃdanāgarukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam ..
nṛpeṃdravaratulyaṃ ca daśalakṣaprajānvitam .. 21 ..
4.5.d:
चंदनागरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवचर्चितम् ॥
नृपेंद्रवरतुल्यं च दशलक्षप्रजान्वितम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ vetrapāṇiṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ ..
vilakṣaṇaṃ dvāraṣaṭkaṃ citrarājivirājitam .. 22 ..
4.5.d:
तं वेत्रपाणिं संभाष्य ययुर्देवा मुदाऽन्विताः ॥
विलक्षणं द्वारषट्कं चित्रराजिविराजितम् ॥ 22 ॥

4.5.s:
vajrabhittiyugmayukte puṣpamālyavibhūṣite ..
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuḥ śukrabhānuṃ vrajeśvaram .. 23 ..
4.5.d:
वज्रभित्तियुग्मयुक्ते पुष्पमाल्यविभूषिते ॥
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशुः शुक्रभानुं व्रजेश्वरम् ॥ 23 ॥

4.5.s:
nānālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ daśalakṣaprajānvitam ..
śrīkhaṃḍapallavāsaktakapolaṃ kuṇḍalojjvalam .. 24..
4.5.d:
नानालंकारशोभाढ्यं दशलक्षप्रजान्वितम् ॥
श्रीखंडपल्लवासक्तकपोलं कुण्डलोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 24॥

4.5.s:
tūrṇaṃ surāstaṃ sabhāṣya yayurdvāraṃ ca saptamam ..
nānāprakāracitraṃ ca ṣaḍbhyaścātivilakṣaṇam .. 25 ..
4.5.d:
तूर्णं सुरास्तं सभाष्य ययुर्द्वारं च सप्तमम् ॥
नानाप्रकारचित्रं च षड्भ्यश्चातिविलक्षणम् ॥ 25 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśū ratnabhānuṃ hareḥ priyam ..
caṃdanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam ..
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇai ramyairmaṇiratnamanoharaiḥ .. 26 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारे नियुक्तं ददृशू रत्नभानुं हरेः प्रियम् ॥
चंदनोक्षितसर्वांगं पुष्पमालाविभूषितम् ॥
भूषितं भूषणै रम्यैर्मणिरत्नमनोहरैः ॥ 26 ॥

4.5.s:
gopairdvādaśalakṣaiśca rājeṃdramiva rājitam ..
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca smerānanasaroruham .. 27 ..
4.5.d:
गोपैर्द्वादशलक्षैश्च राजेंद्रमिव राजितम् ॥
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च स्मेराननसरोरुहम् ॥ 27 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ vetrahastaṃ saṃbhāṣya jagmurdeveśvarā mudā ..
vicitramaṣṭamaṃ dvāraṃ saptabhyo'pi vilakṣaṇam .. 28 ..
4.5.d:
तं वेत्रहस्तं संभाष्य जग्मुर्देवेश्वरा मुदा ॥
विचित्रमष्टमं द्वारं सप्तभ्योऽपि विलक्षणम् ॥ 28 ॥

4.5.s:
dauvārikaṃ te dadṛśuḥ supārśvaṃ sumanoharam ..
sasmitaṃ sundaravaraṃ śrīkhaṇḍatilakojjvalam .. 29 ..
4.5.d:
दौवारिकं ते ददृशुः सुपार्श्वं सुमनोहरम् ॥
सस्मितं सुन्दरवरं श्रीखण्डतिलकोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.5.m:
Smiling, most handsome, radiant with a sandal-paste tilaka,
with lower lip like a bandhujīva flower, adorned with gem-encrusted earrings,
rich in the splendor of all ornaments, holding an exquisite staff of gems,
and accompanied by twelve hundred thousand young cowherd boys.
Then the gods quickly went to the desired ninth gate,
built of diamonds and fine jewels, provided with four platforms,
and adorned with networks of garlands fashioned into unprecedented designs.
There they saw the gatekeeper Subala of graceful form,
rich in the beauty of varied ornaments, worthy of ornaments, charming,
accompanied by twelve hundred thousand diamond[-like cowherds], exceedingly delightful.
Having spoken to him as he held a staff in hand, the gods proceeded to another gate.
Seeing the splendid tenth gate, they were struck with wonder;
it was entirely indescribable, unseen and unheard of before, O sage!
They saw the handsome gatekeeper Sudāman,
of indescribable beauty, charming, equal to Kṛṣṇa,
surrounded by multitudes of two million cowherds.
Having seen him with his staff in hand, the gods went on to another gate:
the gate named the eleventh, beautifully varied, great and wonderful.
Stationed there as gatekeeper was Śrīdāman, the lord of Vraja,
like a son to Rādhikā, dressed in yellow garments,
seated upon a gem-studded throne wrought of priceless jewels,
adorned with priceless gemmed ornaments, exceedingly handsome,
resplendent with sandal, agallochum, musk, and saffron,
radiant with fine gem-encrusted earrings befitting his cheeks and temples,
shining with a wondrous crown wrought of the finest precious gems,
his entire body adorned with garlands of blooming jasmine flowers,
surrounded by ten million cowherds, more brilliant than the greatest of kings.
Having spoken to him, the gods gladly went to the gate named the twelfth,
provided with platforms built of priceless gems,
rare to all, wondrous, unseen, and unheard of, O sage,

4.5.s:
bandhujīvādharoṣṭhaṃ ca ratnakuṇḍalamaṃḍitam ..
sarvālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ ratnadaṇḍadharaṃ varam .. 4.5.30 ..
4.5.d:
बन्धुजीवाधरोष्ठं च रत्नकुण्डलमंडितम् ॥
सर्वालंकारशोभाढ्यं रत्नदण्डधरं वरम् ॥ 4.5.30 ॥

4.5.s:
gopairdvādaśalakṣaiśca kiśoraiśca samanvitam ..
tataḥ śīghraṃ yayurdevā navamaṃ dvāramīpsitam ..31..
4.5.d:
गोपैर्द्वादशलक्षैश्च किशोरैश्च समन्वितम् ॥
ततः शीघ्रं ययुर्देवा नवमं द्वारमीप्सितम् ॥31॥

4.5.s:
vajrasadratnaracitaṃ caturvedisamanvitam ..
apūrvacitraracitamālajālairvirājitam .. 32 ..
4.5.d:
वज्रसद्रत्नरचितं चतुर्वेदिसमन्वितम् ॥
अपूर्वचित्ररचितमालजालैर्विराजितम् ॥ 32 ॥

4.5.s:
dvārapālaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ subalaṃ lalitākṛtim ..
nānābhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhūṣaṇārhaṃ manoharam .. 33 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारपालं च ददृशुः सुबलं ललिताकृतिम् ॥
नानाभूषणशोभाढ्यं भूषणार्हं मनोहरम् ॥ 33 ॥

4.5.s:
vajrairdvādaśalakṣaiśca saṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam ..
taṃ daṇḍahastaṃ sambhāṣya surā dvārātaraṃ yayuḥ .. 34 ..
4.5.d:
वज्रैर्द्वादशलक्षैश्च संयुक्तं सुमनोहरम् ॥
तं दण्डहस्तं सम्भाष्य सुरा द्वारातरं ययुः ॥ 34 ॥

4.5.s:
viśiṣṭaṃ daśamaṃ dvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ yayuḥ ..
sarvānirvacanīyaṃ cāpyadṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ mune .. 39 ..
4.5.d:
विशिष्टं दशमं द्वारं दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मयं ययुः ॥
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं चाप्यदृष्टमश्रुतं मुने ॥ 39 ॥

4.5.s:
dadṛśurdvārapālaṃ ca sudāmānaṃ ca sundaram ..
anivarcanīyarūpaṃ kṛṣṇatulyaṃ manoharam .. 36 ..
4.5.d:
ददृशुर्द्वारपालं च सुदामानं च सुन्दरम् ॥
अनिवर्चनीयरूपं कृष्णतुल्यं मनोहरम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.5.s:
gopaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritam ..
taṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva jagmurdvārāṃtaraṃ surāḥ .. 37 ..
4.5.d:
गोपविंशतिलक्षाणां समूहैः परिवारितम् ॥
तं दण्डहस्तं दृष्ट्वैव जग्मुर्द्वारांतरं सुराः ॥ 37 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāramekādaśākhyaṃ ca sucitraṃ mahadadbhutam ..
dvārapālaṃ ca tatrasthaṃ śrīdāmānaṃ vrajeśvaram .. 38 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारमेकादशाख्यं च सुचित्रं महदद्भुतम् ॥
द्वारपालं च तत्रस्थं श्रीदामानं व्रजेश्वरम् ॥ 38 ॥

4.5.s:
rādhikāputratulyaṃ ca pītavastreṇa bhūṣitam ..
amūlyaratnaracitaratnasiṃhāsanasthitam .. 39 ..
4.5.d:
राधिकापुत्रतुल्यं च पीतवस्त्रेण भूषितम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नरचितरत्नसिंहासनस्थितम् ॥ 39 ॥

4.5.s:
amūlyaratnabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam ..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena virājitam .. 4.5.40 ..
4.5.d:
अमूल्यरत्नभूषाभिर्भूषितं सुमनोहरम् ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमेन विराजितम् ॥ 4.5.40 ॥

4.5.s:
gaṇḍasthalakapolārhasadratnakuṇḍalojjvalam ..
sadratnaśreṣṭharacitavicitramukuṭojjvalam .. 41 ..
4.5.d:
गण्डस्थलकपोलार्हसद्रत्नकुण्डलोज्ज्वलम् ॥
सद्रत्नश्रेष्ठरचितविचित्रमुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 41 ॥

4.5.s:
praphullamālatīmālājālaiḥ sarvāṃgabhūṣitam ..
koṭigopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ rājendrādhikamujjvalam .. 42 ..
4.5.d:
प्रफुल्लमालतीमालाजालैः सर्वांगभूषितम् ॥
कोटिगोपैः परिवृतं राजेन्द्राधिकमुज्ज्वलम् ॥ 42 ॥

4.5.s:
taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdvāraṃ dvādaśākhyaṃ surā mudā ..
amūlyaratnaracitavedikābhiḥ samanvitam .. 43 ..
4.5.d:
तं संभाष्य ययुर्द्वारं द्वादशाख्यं सुरा मुदा ॥
अमूल्यरत्नरचितवेदिकाभिः समन्वितम् ॥ 43 ॥

4.5.s:
sarveṣāṃ durlabhaṃ citramadṛśyamaśrutaṃ mune ..
vajrabhittisthitaṃ citraṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam .. 44 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वेषां दुर्लभं चित्रमदृश्यमश्रुतं मुने ॥
वज्रभित्तिस्थितं चित्रं सुन्दरं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 44 ॥

4.5.s:
dvāre niyuktā dadṛśurdevā gopāṃganā varāḥ ..
navayauvanasaṃpannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ .. 45 ..
4.5.d:
द्वारे नियुक्ता ददृशुर्देवा गोपांगना वराः ॥
नवयौवनसंपन्ना रत्नाभरणभूषिताः ॥ 45 ॥

4.5.s:
pītavastraparīdhānāḥ kabarībhārabhūṣitāḥ ..
sugaṃdhimālatīmālā jālaiḥ sarvāṃgabhūṣitāḥ .. 46 ..
4.5.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानाः कबरीभारभूषिताः ॥
सुगंधिमालतीमाला जालैः सर्वांगभूषिताः ॥ 46 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūraratnanūpurabhūṣitāḥ ..
ratnakuṃḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitāḥ .. 47 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नकंकणकेयूररत्ननूपुरभूषिताः ॥
रत्नकुंडलयुग्मेन गण्डस्थलविराजिताः ॥ 47 ॥

4.5.s:
candanāguru kastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitāḥ ..
pīnaśroṇībharānamrā nitaṃbābhārapīḍitāḥ .. 48 ..
4.5.d:
चन्दनागुरु कस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवचर्चिताः ॥
पीनश्रोणीभरानम्रा नितंबाभारपीडिताः ॥ 48 ॥

4.5.s:
gopīnāṃ śatakoṭīnāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ preṣṭhā harerapi ..
gopīśca koṭiśo dṛṣṭvā surāste vismayaṃ yayuḥ .. 49 ..
4.5.d:
गोपीनां शतकोटीनां श्रेष्ठाः प्रेष्ठा हरेरपि ॥
गोपीश्च कोटिशो दृष्ट्वा सुरास्ते विस्मयं ययुः ॥ 49 ॥

4.5.s:
saṃbhāṣya tā mudā yuktā yayurdvārātaraṃ mune ..
tataśca kramaśo vipra triṣu dvāreṣu tatra vai .. 4.5.50 ..
4.5.d:
संभाष्य ता मुदा युक्ता ययुर्द्वारातरं मुने ॥
ततश्च क्रमशो विप्र त्रिषु द्वारेषु तत्र वै ॥ 4.5.50 ॥

4.5.s:
gopāṃganānāṃ śreṣṭhāśca dadṛśuḥ sumanoharāḥ ..
varāṇāṃ ca varā ramyā dhanyā mānyāśca śobhanāḥ .. 51 ..
4.5.d:
गोपांगनानां श्रेष्ठाश्च ददृशुः सुमनोहराः ॥
वराणां च वरा रम्या धन्या मान्याश्च शोभनाः ॥ 51 ॥

4.5.s:
sarvāḥ saubhāgyayuktāśca rādhikāyāḥ priyāśca tāḥ ..
bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇai ramyaiḥ prodbhinnanavayauvanāḥ .. 52 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वाः सौभाग्ययुक्ताश्च राधिकायाः प्रियाश्च ताः ॥
भूषिता भूषणै रम्यैः प्रोद्भिन्ननवयौवनाः ॥ 52 ॥

4.5.s:
evaṃ dvāratrayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svapnā jñānādbhutāśrutam ..
adṛśyamatiramyaṃ cāpyanirūpyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 53 ..
4.5.d:
एवं द्वारत्रयं दृष्ट्वा स्वप्ना ज्ञानाद्भुताश्रुतम् ॥
अदृश्यमतिरम्यं चाप्यनिरूप्यं विचक्षणैः ॥ 53 ॥

4.5.s:
tāstāḥ saṃbhāṣya devāste vismitā yayurīśvarāḥ ..
rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśākhyaṃ manoharam .. 54 ..
4.5.d:
तास्ताः संभाष्य देवास्ते विस्मिता ययुरीश्वराः ॥
राधिकाभ्यंतरं द्वारं षोडशाख्यं मनोहरम् ॥ 54 ॥

4.5.s:
sarvāsāṃ ca pradhānaṃ ca gopyaṃ gopāṃganāgaṇaiḥ ..
trayastriṃśadvayasyānāṃ nikarairveṣṭitaṃ mune .. 55 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वासां च प्रधानं च गोप्यं गोपांगनागणैः ॥
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वयस्यानां निकरैर्वेष्टितं मुने ॥ 55 ॥

4.5.s:
teṣāmanirvacanīyairnānāguṇasamanvitaiḥ ..
rūpayauvanasaṃpannai ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ .. 56 ..
4.5.d:
तेषामनिर्वचनीयैर्नानागुणसमन्वितैः ॥
रूपयौवनसंपन्नै रत्नालंकारभूषितैः ॥ 56 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūratnanūpurabhūṣitaiḥ ..
sadratnakiṃkiṇījālaimardhyadeśavibhūṣitaiḥ .. 57 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नकंकणकेयूरत्ननूपुरभूषितैः ॥
सद्रत्नकिंकिणीजालैमर्ध्यदेशविभूषितैः ॥ 57 ॥

4.5.s:
ratnakuṃḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitaiḥ ..
praphullamālatīmālājālairvakṣasthalojjvalaiḥ .. 58 ..
4.5.d:
रत्नकुंडलयुग्मेन गंडस्थलविराजितैः ॥
प्रफुल्लमालतीमालाजालैर्वक्षस्थलोज्ज्वलैः ॥ 58 ॥
4.5.m:
situated upon walls of diamond, variegated, lovely, and most enchanting.
Stationed at the gate, the gods saw excellent cowherd women,
endowed with fresh youth, adorned with jewel ornaments,
wearing yellow garments, adorned with heavy masses of braided hair,
their whole limbs adorned with networks of fragrant jasmine garlands,
adorned with jeweled bracelets, armlets, and jeweled anklets,
their cheeks resplendent with pairs of jeweled earrings,
anointed with liquid paste of sandal, agallochum, musk, and saffron,
bending under the weight of their plump hips, laden with the burden of their buttocks,
the foremost among hundreds of millions of gopīs, and dearest even to Hari.
Seeing those millions of gopīs, the gods were filled with wonder.
