Having spoken to them, they joyfully went to another gate, O sage.
Then gradually, O brāhmaṇa, at the three gates there,
they saw the foremost of cowherd women, most charming,
the best of the best, lovely, fortunate, revered, and beautiful,
all endowed with good fortune, dear to Rādhikā,
adorned with lovely ornaments, bursting with fresh youth.
Thus having seen the three gates—unheard of, wonderful, beyond the knowledge of dreams,
unseen, exceedingly lovely, and undefinable even by the wise—
and having spoken with those women, the astonished gods, those lords,
went to the charming sixteenth gate leading to the interior of Rādhikā's abode,
the foremost of all, guarded by hosts of cowherd women,
surrounded by multitudes of her thirty-three companions, O sage.
Those women were indescribable, endowed with diverse virtues,
full of beauty and youth, adorned with jeweled ornaments,
adorned with jeweled bracelets, armlets, and gemmed anklets,
their waists adorned with strings of fine jeweled tinkling bells,
their cheeks resplendent with pairs of jeweled earrings,
their chests radiant with networks of blooming jasmine garlands,

4.5.s:
śaratpārvaṇapadmānāṃ prabhāṃ muṣṇanmukheṃdubhiḥ ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālena veṣṭitaiḥ .. .. 59 ..
4.5.d:
शरत्पार्वणपद्मानां प्रभां मुष्णन्मुखेंदुभिः ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालेन वेष्टितैः ॥ ॥ 59 ॥
4.5.m:
stealing the splendor of autumnal full-moon lotuses with their moon-like faces,
encircled by networks of garlands of pārijāta blossoms,
with lower lips like ripe bimba fruit, smiling lotus-like faces,
adorned with rows of teeth resembling ripe pomegranate seeds,
with the beautiful complexion of the campaka flower, slender at the waist, O sage,
resplendent with noses adorned with elephant-pearls,
stealing the beauty of the graceful beaks of the king of birds,
bent under the heavy burden of breasts firm as the temples of lordly elephants,
afflicted by the weight of their plump hips, their minds fixed upon Mukunda's feet.
Without blinking, the gods beheld both the gate and those maidens.
It was beautified by a pair of platforms set with shining, lovely gems,
always fitted with clusters of pillars of emeralds,
with their middles shining with cinnabar-colored gems,
adorned with networks of garlands of pārijāta blossoms,
scented everywhere by the breezes fragrant from contacting them.
Having seen that supreme wonder, the inner realm of Rādhikā, the gods,
whose sole desire was the vision of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet,
spoke to them and quickly went forward, their bodies thrilled with horripilation,
filled with tears from surging devotion, their necks slightly bowed.
From nearby the gods saw the excellent inner chamber of Rādhikā,
a charming quadrangle situated in the midst of palaces,
fashioned excellently from the quintessence of priceless gems,
adorned with pillars of diverse jewels and gems joined with diamonds,
resplendent with networks of garlands of pārijāta flowers,
adorned, O sage, with heaps of pearls, rubies, white chowries, mirrors,
and pitchers made from the essence of priceless jewels,
its lovely courtyard adorned with clusters of gem-encrusted pillars
provided with sandal-tree shoots tied with knots of silk thread,
endowed with liquid paste of sandal, agallochum, musk, and saffron,
and with white grain, white flowers, coral, fruits, and rice grains.

4.5.s:
pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhaiśca smerānanasaroruhaiḥ ..
pakvadāḍimabījābhiḥ śobhitairdaṃtapaṃktibhiḥ .. 4.5.60 ..
4.5.d:
पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठैश्च स्मेराननसरोरुहैः ॥
पक्वदाडिमबीजाभिः शोभितैर्दंतपंक्तिभिः ॥ 4.5.60 ॥

4.5.s:
cārucaṃpakavarṇābhirmadhyasthalakṛśairmune ..
gajamauktikayuktābhirnāsikābhirvirājitaiḥ .. 61 ..
4.5.d:
चारुचंपकवर्णाभिर्मध्यस्थलकृशैर्मुने ॥
गजमौक्तिकयुक्ताभिर्नासिकाभिर्विराजितैः ॥ 61 ॥

4.5.s:
khageṃdracārucaṃcūnāṃ śobhāmuṣṇābhireva ca ..
gajeṃdragaṃḍakaṭhina stanabhārabharānataiḥ .. 62 ..
4.5.d:
खगेंद्रचारुचंचूनां शोभामुष्णाभिरेव च ॥
गजेंद्रगंडकठिन स्तनभारभरानतैः ॥ 62 ॥

4.5.s:
pīnaśroṇibharārtaiśca mukuṃdapadamānasaiḥ ..
nimeṣarahitā devā dvāraṃ ca dadṛśuśca tāḥ ..63..
4.5.d:
पीनश्रोणिभरार्तैश्च मुकुंदपदमानसैः ॥
निमेषरहिता देवा द्वारं च ददृशुश्च ताः ॥63॥

4.5.s:
lasadramaṇiratnaiśca vedikāyugmaśobhitam ..
harinmaṇīnāṃ staṃbhānāṃ samūhaiḥ saṃyutaṃ sadā .. 64 ..
4.5.d:
लसद्रमणिरत्नैश्च वेदिकायुग्मशोभितम् ॥
हरिन्मणीनां स्तंभानां समूहैः संयुतं सदा ॥ 64 ॥

4.5.s:
siṃdūrākāramaṇibhirmadhyasthalavirājitaiḥ ..
pārijāta prasūnānāṃ mālājālairvibhūṣitam .. 65 ..
4.5.d:
सिंदूराकारमणिभिर्मध्यस्थलविराजितैः ॥
पारिजात प्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विभूषितम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.5.m: adorned with garlands of pārijāta blossoms,

4.5.s:
tatsaṃsparśairgaṃdhavāhaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtam ..
dṛṣṭvā tatparamāścaryaṃ rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ surāḥ .. 66 ..
4.5.d:
तत्संस्पर्शैर्गंधवाहैः सर्वत्र सुरभीकृतम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा तत्परमाश्चर्यं राधिकाभ्यंतरं सुराः ॥ 66 ॥

4.5.s:
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhojadarśanaikamanorathāḥ ..
tāḥ saṃbhāṣya yayuḥ śīghraṃ pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ .. 67 ..
4.5.d:
श्रीकृष्णचरणांभोजदर्शनैकमनोरथाः ॥
ताः संभाष्य ययुः शीघ्रं पुलकांचितविग्रहाः ॥ 67 ॥

4.5.s:
bhaktyudrekādaśrupūrṇāḥ kiṃcinnamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ..
ārātte dadṛśurdevā rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ varam .. 68 ..
4.5.d:
भक्त्युद्रेकादश्रुपूर्णाः किंचिन्नम्रात्मकंधराः ॥
आरात्ते ददृशुर्देवा राधिकाभ्यंतरं वरम् ॥ 68 ॥

4.5.s:
maṃdirāṇāṃ ca madhyasthaṃ catuḥśālaṃ manoharam ..
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sāreṇa racitaṃ param .. 69 ..
4.5.d:
मंदिराणां च मध्यस्थं चतुःशालं मनोहरम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नसाराणां सारेण रचितं परम् ॥ 69 ॥

4.5.s:
nānāratnamaṇistaṃbhairvajrayuktaiśca bhūṣitam ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam .. 4.5.70 ..
4.5.d:
नानारत्नमणिस्तंभैर्वज्रयुक्तैश्च भूषितम् ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विराजितम् ॥ 4.5.70 ॥

4.5.s:
muktāsamūhairmāṇikyaiḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ..
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ kalaśairbhūṣitaṃ mune .. 71 ..
4.5.d:
मुक्तासमूहैर्माणिक्यैः श्वेतचामरदर्पणैः ॥
अमूल्यरत्नसाराणां कलशैर्भूषितं मुने ॥ 71 ॥

4.5.s:
paṭṭasūtragraṃthiyuktaśrīkhaṃḍapallavānvitaiḥ ..
maṇistaṃbhasamūhaiśca ramyaprāṃgaṇabhūṣitam .. 72 ..
4.5.d:
पट्टसूत्रग्रंथियुक्तश्रीखंडपल्लवान्वितैः ॥
मणिस्तंभसमूहैश्च रम्यप्रांगणभूषितम् ॥ 72 ॥

4.5.s:
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam ..
śukladhānyaśuklapuṣpapravālaphalataṃḍulaiḥ .. 73 ..
4.5.d:
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवसंयुतम् ॥
शुक्लधान्यशुक्लपुष्पप्रवालफलतंडुलैः ॥ 73 ॥

4.5.s:
parṇadūrvākṣatairlājairnirmaṃchanavibhūṣitaiḥ ..
phalayuktai ratnakuṃbhaiḥ siṃdūrakuṃkumānvitaiḥ .. 74 ..
4.5.d:
पर्णदूर्वाक्षतैर्लाजैर्निर्मंछनविभूषितैः ॥
फलयुक्तै रत्नकुंभैः सिंदूरकुंकुमान्वितैः ॥ 74 ॥
4.5.m: [adorned with] leaves, dūrvā grass, and unbroken grains, decorated with auspicious waved offerings of parched grains, / with jeweled pitchers bearing fruits and covered with vermilion and saffron; / adorned with garlands of pārijāta blossoms, / and made fragrant everywhere by breezes laden with flowers; / adorned with everything indescribable and unspecified in substance, / with whatever objects are rare in the cosmic egg; / beautifully adorned with clusters of pārijāta blossom garlands, / with charming [gopīs] on jeweled couches, draped in fine garments; / with hundreds of millions of jeweled pitchers, Nārada, and jeweled vessels / that were priceless and beautiful, adorned with those very things; / resounding with the sweet tones of various instruments, / and well-attuned to the singing of the gopīs accompanied by harps and vīṇās; / enchanted by the sounds of instruments and of mṛdaṅga drums, Nārada; / surrounded by multitudes of cowherds equal to Kṛṣṇa; / shining with multitude upon multitude of the gopīs, companions of Rādhā; / filled with the sweet sounds of songs whose verses extolled the virtues of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. / Seeing the interior thus, the gods were amazed; / they heard the sweet singing and saw the supreme dance. / All the gods stood there, their minds absorbed in meditation alone; / the lords of the thirty [gods] beheld a delightful jeweled throne, / a hundred bows in measure and circular in form all around, / furnished with arrays of small vessels made of genuine jewels, / and adorned with wonderful figurines, flowers, and variegated groves. / There [they saw] a mass of splendor with radiance equal to millions of suns, / blazing with light, O Brahman, a great and wondrous marvel; / measuring seven tāla trees, it pervaded upwards in all directions, / eclipsing the radiance of all, free from any weary effort, / all-pervading, the seed of all, obstructing the eyes, supreme. / Having seen that embodiment of radiance, those gods, intent on meditation, / bowed with supreme devotion, their necks bent low in reverence;

4.5.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāyuktairvirājitam ..
prasūnāktairgaṃdhavāhaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtam .. 75 ..
4.5.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालायुक्तैर्विराजितम् ॥
प्रसूनाक्तैर्गंधवाहैः सर्वत्र सुरभीकृतम् ॥ 75 ॥

4.5.s:
sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca yaddravyamanirūpitam ..
brahmāṃḍe durlabhaṃ yadyadvastubhistairvirājitam .. 76 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं च यद्द्रव्यमनिरूपितम् ॥
ब्रह्मांडे दुर्लभं यद्यद्वस्तुभिस्तैर्विराजितम् ॥ 76 ॥

4.5.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiḥ suśobhitam ..
ratnaśayyāsu lalitāḥ sūkṣmavastraparicchadāḥ..77..
4.5.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैः सुशोभितम् ॥
रत्नशय्यासु ललिताः सूक्ष्मवस्त्रपरिच्छदाः॥77॥

4.5.s:
koṭiśo ratnakuṃbhāśca ratnapātrāṇi nārada ..
amūlyāni ca cārūṇi taistaireva vibhūṣitam..78..
4.5.d:
कोटिशो रत्नकुंभाश्च रत्नपात्राणि नारद ॥
अमूल्यानि च चारूणि तैस्तैरेव विभूषितम्॥78॥

4.5.s:
nānāprakāravādyānāṃ kalanādairnināditam..
svarayaṃtraiśca vīṇābhirgopīsaṃgītasuśrutam.. 79 ..
4.5.d:
नानाप्रकारवाद्यानां कलनादैर्निनादितम्॥
स्वरयंत्रैश्च वीणाभिर्गोपीसंगीतसुश्रुतम्॥ 79 ॥

4.5.s:
mohitaṃ vādyaśabdaiśca mṛdaṃgānāṃ ca nārada ..
gopānāṃ kṛṣṇatulyānāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritam.. ..4.5.80..
4.5.d:
मोहितं वाद्यशब्दैश्च मृदंगानां च नारद ॥
गोपानां कृष्णतुल्यानां समूहैः परिवारितम्॥ ॥4.5.80॥

4.5.s:
rādhāsakhīnāṃ gopīnāṃ vṛṃdairvṛṃdairvirājitam ..
rādhākṛṣṇaguṇodrekapadasaṃgītasuśrutam..81..
4.5.d:
राधासखीनां गोपीनां वृंदैर्वृंदैर्विराजितम् ॥
राधाकृष्णगुणोद्रेकपदसंगीतसुश्रुतम्॥81॥

4.5.s:
evamabhyaṃtaraṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūvurvismitāḥ surāḥ.. .
śuśruvurmadhuraṃ gītaṃ dadṛśurnṛtyamuttamam ..82..
4.5.d:
एवमभ्यंतरं दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर्विस्मिताः सुराः॥ ।
शुश्रुवुर्मधुरं गीतं ददृशुर्नृत्यमुत्तमम् ॥82॥

4.5.s:
tatra tasthuḥ surāḥ sarve dhyānaikatānamānasāḥ ..
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśustridaśeśvarāḥ .. 83 ..
4.5.d:
तत्र तस्थुः सुराः सर्वे ध्यानैकतानमानसाः ॥
रत्नसिंहासनं रम्यं ददृशुस्त्रिदशेश्वराः ॥ 83 ॥

4.5.s:
dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca parito vartulākṛtim..
sadratnakṣudrakalaśasamūhaiśca samanvitam ..84 ..
4.5.d:
धनुःशतप्रमाणं च परितो वर्तुलाकृतिम्॥
सद्रत्नक्षुद्रकलशसमूहैश्च समन्वितम् ॥84 ॥

4.5.s:
citraputtalikāpuṣpacitrakānanabhūṣitam ..
tatra tejaḥsamūhaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham .. 85 ..
4.5.d:
चित्रपुत्तलिकापुष्पचित्रकाननभूषितम् ॥
तत्र तेजःसमूहं च सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् ॥ 85 ॥

4.5.s:
prabhayā jvalitaṃ brahmannāścaryaṃ mahadadbhutam ..
saptatālapramāṇaṃ tadvyāptamūrdhvaṃ samantataḥ..66..
4.5.d:
प्रभया ज्वलितं ब्रह्मन्नाश्चर्यं महदद्भुतम् ॥
सप्ततालप्रमाणं तद्व्याप्तमूर्ध्वं समन्ततः॥66॥

4.5.s:
tejomuṣaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mahāśramavivarjitam ..
sarvavyāpi sarvabījaṃ cakṣūrodhakaraṃ param ..87..
4.5.d:
तेजोमुषं च सर्वेषां महाश्रमविवर्जितम् ॥
सर्वव्यापि सर्वबीजं चक्षूरोधकरं परम् ॥87॥

4.5.s:
dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca te devā dhyānatatparāḥ ..
praṇemuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ .. 88 ..
4.5.d:
दृष्ट्वा तेजःस्वरूपं च ते देवा ध्यानतत्पराः ॥
प्रणेमुः परया भक्त्या भक्तिनम्रात्मकंधराः ॥ 88 ॥

4.5.s:
paramānandasaṃyogādaśrupūrṇavilocanāḥ ..
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgā vāṃchāpūrṇamanorathāḥ .. 89 ..
4.5.d:
परमानन्दसंयोगादश्रुपूर्णविलोचनाः ॥
पुलकांकितसर्वांगा वांछापूर्णमनोरथाः ॥ 89 ॥
4.5.m: their eyes filled with tears from the union with supreme bliss, / all their limbs thrilled with horripilation, their desires and longings fulfilled. / Having bowed to that Lord whose form is radiance, the lords of the thirty [gods] / stood up there and, immersed in meditation, remained before that splendor. / Having thus meditated, the creator of the worlds placed his palms together, / setting Śaṅkara on his right and Dharma on his left, O Nārada; / and from an abundance of devotion, his mind fixed in single-pointed meditation, / he praised the Lord, the Paramātman, higher than the highest, beyond the gunas: / Brahmā said: / I bow to that form of radiance, the best, the most worthy, the granter of boons, the cause of the bestowers of boons, / the cause of all beings. / I bow to that form of radiance, the blessing among blessings, auspicious, bestowing auspiciousness, / the support of all auspicious things. / I bow to that form of radiance, present everywhere, untainted, whose form is the Self, higher than the highest, / inactive and inconceivable. / I bow to that form of radiance, with gunas and devoid of gunas, Brahman, whose form is light, eternal, / both with form and formless. / I bow to that form of radiance, indescribable, manifest and unmanifest, single, / consisting of his own will, embodying all forms. / Supreme, assuming three forms to differentiate the three gunas— / all [beings] were made by a part of you; how can they know that which is beyond the Veda? / I bow to that form of radiance, the support of all, the form of all, the seed of all, seedless, / the end of all, and infinite. / That which possesses the six qualities can be perceived and described by the wise; / how can I describe that which is to be perceived? I bow to that form of radiance. / I bow to that form of radiance, bodiless yet possessed of a body, with senses yet beyond the senses, / that which is no witness yet the witness of all. / I bow to that form of radiance, able to go yet footless, without eyes yet seeing all, / without hands or mouth yet the enjoyer. / Good people are able to describe that substance which is set forth in the Veda;

4.5.s:
natvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca tamīśaṃ tridaśeśvarāḥ ..
tatrotthāya dhyānayuktāḥ pratasthustejasaḥ puraḥ .. 4.5.90 ..
4.5.d:
नत्वा तेजःस्वरूपं च तमीशं त्रिदशेश्वराः ॥
तत्रोत्थाय ध्यानयुक्ताः प्रतस्थुस्तेजसः पुरः ॥ 4.5.90 ॥

4.5.s:
dhyātvaivaṃ jagatāṃ dhātā babhūva saṃpuṭāṃjaliḥ ..
dakṣiṇe śaṃkaraṃ kṛtvā vāme dharmaṃ ca nārada .. 91 ..
4.5.d:
ध्यात्वैवं जगतां धाता बभूव संपुटांजलिः ॥
दक्षिणे शंकरं कृत्वा वामे धर्मं च नारद ॥ 91 ॥

4.5.s:
bhaktyudrekātpratuṣṭāva dhyānaikatānamānasaḥ ..
parātparaṃ guṇātītaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram .. 92 ..
4.5.d:
भक्त्युद्रेकात्प्रतुष्टाव ध्यानैकतानमानसः ॥
परात्परं गुणातीतं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ॥ 92 ॥

4.5.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāṃ ca kāraṇam ..
kāraṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 93 ..
4.5.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
वरं वरेण्यं वरदं वरदानां च कारणम् ॥
कारणं सर्वभूतानां तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 93 ॥

4.5.s:
maṃgalaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ maṃgalapradam ..
samastamaṃgalādhāraṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham.. 94 ..
4.5.d:
मंगलं मंगलानां च मंगलं मंगलप्रदम् ॥
समस्तमंगलाधारं तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम्॥ 94 ॥

4.5.s:
sthitaṃ sarvatra nirliptamātmarūpaṃ parātparam ..
nirīhamavitarkyaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 95 ..
4.5.d:
स्थितं सर्वत्र निर्लिप्तमात्मरूपं परात्परम् ॥
निरीहमवितर्क्यं च तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 95 ॥

4.5.s:
saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ..
sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 96 ..
4.5.d:
सगुणं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म ज्योतीरूपं सनातनम् ॥
साकारं च निराकारं तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 96 ॥

4.5.s:
tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca vyaktamavyaktamekakam ..
svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 97 ..
4.5.d:
तमनिर्वचनीयं च व्यक्तमव्यक्तमेककम् ॥
स्वेच्छामयं सर्वरूपं तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 97 ॥

4.5.s:
guṇatrayavibhāgāya rūpatrayadharaṃ param ..
kalayā te kṛtāḥ sarve kiṃ jānanti śruteḥ param .. 98 ..
4.5.d:
गुणत्रयविभागाय रूपत्रयधरं परम् ॥
कलया ते कृताः सर्वे किं जानन्ति श्रुतेः परम् ॥ 98 ॥

4.5.s:
sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvabījamabījakam ..
sarvāṃtakamanantaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 99 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वाधारं सर्वरूपं सर्वबीजमबीजकम् ॥
सर्वांतकमनन्तं च तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 99 ॥

4.5.s:
lakṣyaṃ ṣaṅguṇarūpaṃ ca varṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
kiṃ varṇayāmi lakṣyaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 4.5.100 ..
4.5.d:
लक्ष्यं षङ्गुणरूपं च वर्णनीयं विचक्षणैः ॥
किं वर्णयामि लक्ष्यं च तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 4.5.100 ॥

4.5.s:
aśarīraṃ vigrahavadiṃdriyaṃ yadatīṃdriyam ..
yadasākṣi sarvasākṣi tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 101 ..
4.5.d:
अशरीरं विग्रहवदिंद्रियं यदतींद्रियम् ॥
यदसाक्षि सर्वसाक्षि तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 101 ॥

4.5.s:
gamanārhamapādaṃ yadacakṣuḥ sarvadarśanam ..
hastāsyahīnaṃ yadbhoktṛ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 102 ..
4.5.d:
गमनार्हमपादं यदचक्षुः सर्वदर्शनम् ॥
हस्तास्यहीनं यद्भोक्तृ तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 102 ॥

4.5.s:
vede nirūpitaṃ vastu santaḥ śaktāśca varṇitum ..
vede'nirūpitaṃ yattattejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 103 ..
4.5.d:
वेदे निरूपितं वस्तु सन्तः शक्ताश्च वर्णितुम् ॥
वेदेऽनिरूपितं यत्तत्तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 103 ॥

4.5.s:
sarveśaṃ yadanīśaṃ yatsarvādi yadanādi yat ..
sarvātmakamanātmaṃ yattejorūpaṃ namāmyaham .. 104 ..
4.5.d:
सर्वेशं यदनीशं यत्सर्वादि यदनादि यत् ॥
सर्वात्मकमनात्मं यत्तेजोरूपं नमाम्यहम् ॥ 104 ॥

4.5.s:
ahaṃ vidhātā jagato vedānāṃ janakaḥ svayam ..
pātā dharmo haro hartā stotuṃ śaktā na ke'pi yat .. 105 ..
4.5.d:
अहं विधाता जगतो वेदानां जनकः स्वयम् ॥
पाता धर्मो हरो हर्ता स्तोतुं शक्ता न केऽपि यत् ॥ 105 ॥

4.5.s:
sevayā tava dharmo'yaṃ pālane ca nirūpitaḥ..
tavājñayā ca saṃhartā tvayā kāle nirūpite ..106..
4.5.d:
सेवया तव धर्मोऽयं पालने च निरूपितः॥
तवाज्ञया च संहर्ता त्वया काले निरूपिते ॥106॥

4.5.s:
niḥśeṣotpattikarttā'haṃ tvatpādāṃbhojasevayā ..
karmiṇāṃ phaladātā ca tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ ca naḥ prabhuḥ .. 107
4.5.d:
निःशेषोत्पत्तिकर्त्ताऽहं त्वत्पादांभोजसेवया ॥
कर्मिणां फलदाता च त्वं भक्तानां च नः प्रभुः ॥ 107
4.5.m: I bow to that form of radiance which is not set forth in the Veda. / I bow to that form of radiance which is the Lord of all yet without a lord, the beginning of all yet beginningless, / identical with all yet without a self. / I am the creator of the universe, myself the father of the Vedas; / Dharma is the protector, Hara the destroyer; yet none of us are able to praise you. / By service to you, this Dharma was appointed to protect [it]; / and by your command he is the destroyer, at the time designated by you. / I am the maker of entire creation through service to your lotus feet; / you are the giver of fruits to those who perform action, and our Lord, the master of devotees.

4.5.s:
brahmāṃḍe biṃbasadṛśe bhūtvā viṣayiṇo vayam ..
evaṃ katividhāḥ saṃti teṣvananteṣu sevakāḥ ..108..
4.5.d:
ब्रह्मांडे बिंबसदृशे भूत्वा विषयिणो वयम् ॥
एवं कतिविधाः संति तेष्वनन्तेषु सेवकाः ॥108॥
4.5.m:
We, having become lords of worldly pleasures in a cosmic egg resembling a mere reflection—
how many kinds of such servants exist within those endless [cosmic eggs]?

4.5.s:
yathā na saṃkhyā reṇūnāṃ tathā teṣāmaṇīyasām ..
sarveṣāṃ janakaśceśo yastaṃ stotuṃ ca ke kṣamāḥ ..109..
4.5.d:
यथा न संख्या रेणूनां तथा तेषामणीयसाम् ॥
सर्वेषां जनकश्चेशो यस्तं स्तोतुं च के क्षमाः ॥109॥
4.5.m:
Just as there is no counting of dust particles, so there is none of those minuscule [servants];
who can be capable of praising him who is the father and Lord of all?

4.5.s:
ekaikalomavivare brahmāṃḍamekamekakam ..
yasyaiva mahato viṣṇoḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśastavaiva saḥ ..4.5.110..
4.5.d:
एकैकलोमविवरे ब्रह्मांडमेकमेककम् ॥
यस्यैव महतो विष्णोः षोडशांशस्तवैव सः ॥4.5.110॥
4.5.m:
Within each pore of whose body lies a single cosmic egg—
even that great Viṣṇu is merely a sixteenth portion of you.

4.5.s:
dhyāyaṃte yoginaḥ sarve tavaitadrūpamīpsitam ..
tvadbhaktadāsyaniratāḥ sevaṃte caraṇāṃbujam .. 111 ..
4.5.d:
ध्यायंते योगिनः सर्वे तवैतद्रूपमीप्सितम् ॥
त्वद्भक्तदास्यनिरताः सेवंते चरणांबुजम् ॥ 111 ॥
4.5.m:
All yogins meditate upon this desired form of yours;
devoted to the service of your devotees, they attend upon your lotus feet.

4.5.s:
kiśoraṃ suṃdarataraṃ yakṣaṃ kamanīyakam ..
maṃtradhyānānurūpaṃ ca darśayāsmākamīśvara .. 112 ..
4.5.d:
किशोरं सुंदरतरं यक्षं कमनीयकम् ॥
मंत्रध्यानानुरूपं च दर्शयास्माकमीश्वर ॥ 112 ॥
4.5.m:
[which we hold in our minds], O Lord!
Show us, O Lord, that youthful, exceedingly handsome, / desirable and lovely form, fitting for the meditation of the mantras,

4.5.s:
navīnajaladaśyāmapītāṃbaradharaṃ varam ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam .. 113 ..
4.5.d:
नवीनजलदश्यामपीतांबरधरं वरम् ॥
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 113 ॥
4.5.m: Dark as a fresh raincloud, clad in yellow garments, supreme,

4.5.s:
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatījālamaṃḍitam ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam .. 114 ..
4.5.d:
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च मालतीजालमंडितम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवचर्चितम् ॥ 114 ॥
4.5.m: with a crest of peacock feathers, adorned with a wreath of mālatī flowers,

4.5.s:
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..
amūlyaratnaracitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalam .. 115 ..
4.5.d:
अमूल्यरत्नसाराणां सारभूषणभूषितम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नरचितकिरीटमुकुटोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 115 ॥
4.5.m:
adorned with excellent ornaments made from the essence of priceless gems,
resplendent with a diadem and crown fashioned from priceless jewels,

4.5.s:
śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ prabhāmoṣyāsyacaṃdrakam ..
pakvabiṃbasamānena hyadharoṣṭhena rājitam .. 116 ..
4.5.d:
शरत्प्रफुल्लपद्मानां प्रभामोष्यास्यचंद्रकम् ॥
पक्वबिंबसमानेन ह्यधरोष्ठेन राजितम् ॥ 116 ॥
4.5.m:
his moon-like face stealing the beauty of autumn's blooming lotuses,
shining with a lower lip resembling a ripe bimba fruit,

4.5.s:
pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktimanoharam ..
kelīkadaṃbamūle ca sthitaṃ rāsarasonmukham .. 117 ..
4.5.d:
पक्वदाडिमबीजाभदंतपंक्तिमनोहरम् ॥
केलीकदंबमूले च स्थितं रासरसोन्मुखम् ॥ 117 ॥
4.5.m:
captivating with rows of teeth like the seeds of a ripe pomegranate,
standing at the foot of the play-kadamba tree, eager for the rasa of the rāsa dance,

4.5.s:
gopīvaktrasmitatanuṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ..
evaṃ vāṃchitarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭuṃ ko vā na cotsukaḥ ..118..
4.5.d:
गोपीवक्त्रस्मिततनुं राधावक्षःस्थलस्थितम् ॥
एवं वांछितरूपं ते दृष्टुं को वा न चोत्सुकः ॥118॥
4.5.m:
his body drawing smiles to the faces of the gopīs, resting upon the bosom of Rādhā—
who indeed would not be eager to behold this form that you cherish?

4.5.s:
ityevamuktvā viśvasṛṭ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ..
evaṃ stotreṇa tuṣṭāva dharmo'pi śaṃkaraḥ svayam ..119..
4.5.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा विश्वसृट् प्रणनाम पुनः पुनः ॥
एवं स्तोत्रेण तुष्टाव धर्मोऽपि शंकरः स्वयम् ॥119॥
4.5.m:
Having spoken thus, the Creator of the universe bowed again and again.
With this hymn of praise Dharma also praised [him], and Śaṅkara himself. // 119

4.5.s:
nanāma bhūyobhūyaśca sāśrupūrṇavilocanaḥ ..
tiṣṭhato'pi punaḥ stotraṃ pracakrustridaśeśvarāḥ .. 4.5.120 ..
4.5.d:
ननाम भूयोभूयश्च साश्रुपूर्णविलोचनः ॥
तिष्ठतोऽपि पुनः स्तोत्रं प्रचक्रुस्त्रिदशेश्वराः ॥ 4.5.120 ॥
4.5.m:
He bowed again and again, his eyes filled with tears;
and as he stood there, the lords of the gods made praise once more. // 4.5.120

4.5.s:
vyāptāstatrāśrame sarve śrīkṛṣṇatejasā mune ..
stavarājamimaṃ nityaṃ brahmeśadharmabhiḥ kṛtam .. 121 ..
4.5.d:
व्याप्तास्तत्राश्रमे सर्वे श्रीकृष्णतेजसा मुने ॥
स्तवराजमिमं नित्यं ब्रह्मेशधर्मभिः कृतम् ॥ 121 ॥
4.5.m:
They were all enveloped in that hermitage, O sage, by Śrī Kṛṣṇa's splendour.
Whoever, endowed with devotion at the time of Hari's worship, always recites

4.5.s:
pūjākāle harerevaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ..
sudurlabhāṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ niścalāṃ labhate hareḥ .. 122 ..
4.5.d:
पूजाकाले हरेरेवं भक्तियुक्तश्च यः पठेत् ॥
सुदुर्लभां दृढां भक्तिं निश्चलां लभते हरेः ॥ 122 ॥
4.5.m:
this king of hymns composed by Brahmā, Śiva, and Dharma,
obtains firm, unwavering devotion to Hari, which is exceedingly hard to attain, // 122

4.5.s:
surāsuramunīṃdrāṇāṃ durlabhaṃ dāsyameva ca ..
aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca sālokyādi catuṣṭayam ..123..
4.5.d:
सुरासुरमुनींद्राणां दुर्लभं दास्यमेव च ॥
अणिमादिकसिद्धिं च सालोक्यादि चतुष्टयम् ॥123॥
4.5.m:
and servitude [to him] which is hard to obtain even for gods, asuras, and royal sages,
and the accomplishments beginning with atomicity, as well as the fourfold [liberation] beginning with Sālokya. // 123

4.5.s:
ihaiva viṣṇutulyaśca vikhyātaḥ pūjito dhuvam ..
vāksiddhirmaṃtrasiddhiśca bhavettasya suniścitam .. 124 ..
4.5.d:
इहैव विष्णुतुल्यश्च विख्यातः पूजितो धुवम् ॥
वाक्सिद्धिर्मंत्रसिद्धिश्च भवेत्तस्य सुनिश्चितम् ॥ 124 ॥
4.5.m:
He becomes renowned and honoured right here in this world like Viṣṇu;
he surely attains mastery of speech and the mastery of mantras. // 124

4.5.s:
sarvasaubhāmyasaṃyuktaṃ yaśasā pūritaṃ jagat ..
putraśca vidyā kavitā niścalā kamalā tathā..125..
4.5.d:
सर्वसौभाम्यसंयुक्तं यशसा पूरितं जगत् ॥
पुत्रश्च विद्या कविता निश्चला कमला तथा॥125॥
4.5.m:
Endowed with all good fortune, the world is filled with his fame;
he obtains a son, learning, poetic skill, and unshakeable wealth; // 125

4.5.s:
patnī pativratā sādhvī suśīlā susthirāḥ prajāḥ ..
kīrtiśca cirakālīnā tvaṃte kṛṣṇāṃtike gatiḥ .. 126 ..
4.5.d:
पत्नी पतिव्रता साध्वी सुशीला सुस्थिराः प्रजाः ॥
कीर्तिश्च चिरकालीना त्वंते कृष्णांतिके गतिः ॥ 126 ॥
4.5.m:
a devoted, virtuous wife of good character, enduring offspring,
long-lasting renown, and at the end, destination at Kṛṣṇa's side. // 126

4.6.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
dhyātvā stutvā ca tiṣṭhaṃto devāste tejasaḥ puraḥ ..
dadṛśustejaso madhye śarīraṃ kamanīyakam .. 1 ..
4.6.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
ध्यात्वा स्तुत्वा च तिष्ठंतो देवास्ते तेजसः पुरः ॥
ददृशुस्तेजसो मध्ये शरीरं कमनीयकम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.6.m:
Śrī Nārāyaṇa said:
Standing before the splendour after meditating and praising,
the gods saw a lovely body within the splendour, // 1
having the complexion of a water-laden cloud, smiling, captivating the mind,
an exceedingly delighting form that enchants the minds of the three worlds, // 2
with glittering makara-shaped earrings shining upon both cheeks and temples,
adorned with lotus feet that have anklets of fine gems, // 3
radiant in costly garments with the lustre of fire-purified turmeric,
adorned with delightful ornaments fashioned at will in play // 4
from the finest of precious jewels, ornaments themselves adorned by his very form,
charming with bimba-fruit lips touching a playful flute, // 5
looking on with gracious eyes, eager to show favour to his devotees,
his chest radiant with armour set with fine jewels and pearls, // 6
blazing with the bright splendour of the fine Kaustubha gem attached to it.
And there within that splendour they saw a lovely-limbed woman named Rādhikā, // 7
gazing with sidelong glance at her beloved who was looking at her with a smile,
radiant with a row of teeth that mocked a string of pearls, // 8
her face gracious with a gentle smile, eyes like autumn lotuses,
her face lovely, mocking the brilliance of the autumn full moon, // 9
her charming face possessing lower and upper lips that robbed the glow of the bandhujīva flower,
her lotus feet adorned with a pair of tinkling anklets, // 4.6.10
shining with rows of nails that stole the lustre of precious gems,
her feet adorned below with red dye, having covered the lustre of saffron, // 11
her hips adorned with a girdle of the finest priceless gems,
gleaming and bright with costly garments purified by fire, // 12
with waist adorned with tiny bells made from the finest great jewels,
adorned with necklaces of fine gems, armlets, and bracelets, // 13
with earrings fashioned from the best of precious gems, bright against her cheeks,
adorned above her ears with ear-ornaments of precious gems, // 14
with a pearl from the royal elephant at the tip of her nose resembling the beak of the king of birds,
adorned with a dense mass of braided hair embellished with a garland of mālatī flowers, // 15

4.6.s:
sajalāṃbhodavarṇābhaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ..
paramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ trailokyacittamohanam .. 2 ..
4.6.d:
सजलांभोदवर्णाभं सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् ॥
परमाह्लादकं रूपं त्रैलोक्यचित्तमोहनम् ॥ 2 ॥

4.6.s:
gaṃḍasthalakapolābhyāṃ jvalanmakara kuṇḍalam ..
sadratnanūpurābhyāṃ ca caraṇāṃbhojarājitam .. 3 ..
4.6.d:
गंडस्थलकपोलाभ्यां ज्वलन्मकर कुण्डलम् ॥
सद्रत्ननूपुराभ्यां च चरणांभोजराजितम् ॥ 3 ॥

4.6.s:
vahniśuddhaharidrābhāmūlyavastravirājitam ..
maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ svecchā kautukanirmitaiḥ .. 4 ..
4.6.d:
वह्निशुद्धहरिद्राभामूल्यवस्त्रविराजितम् ॥
मणिरत्नेंद्रसाराणां स्वेच्छा कौतुकनिर्मितैः ॥ 4 ॥

4.6.s:
bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇai ramyaistadrūpeṇaiva bhūṣitaiḥ ..
vinodamuralīyuktabiṃbādharamanoharam .. 5 ..
4.6.d:
भूषितं भूषणै रम्यैस्तद्रूपेणैव भूषितैः ॥
विनोदमुरलीयुक्तबिंबाधरमनोहरम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.6.s:
prasannekṣaṇapaśyaṃtaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ..
sadratnaguṭikāyuktakavacoraḥsthalojjvalam .. 6 ..
4.6.d:
प्रसन्नेक्षणपश्यंतं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् ॥
सद्रत्नगुटिकायुक्तकवचोरःस्थलोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 6 ॥

4.6.s:
kaustubhāsaktasadratnapradīptatejasojjvalam ..
tatra tejasi cārvaṃgīṃ dadṛśū rādhikābhidhām .. 7 ..
4.6.d:
कौस्तुभासक्तसद्रत्नप्रदीप्ततेजसोज्ज्वलम् ॥
तत्र तेजसि चार्वंगीं ददृशू राधिकाभिधाम् ॥ 7 ॥

4.6.s:
paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ kāṃtaṃ paśyaṃtīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ..
muktāpaṃktiviniṃdyaikadaṃtapaṃktivirājitām .. .. 8 ..
4.6.d:
पश्यंतं सस्मितं कांतं पश्यंतीं वक्रचक्षुषा ॥
मुक्तापंक्तिविनिंद्यैकदंतपंक्तिविराजिताम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥

4.6.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāviniṃdāsyamanoharām .. 9 ..
4.6.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां शरत्पंकजलोचनाम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्राभाविनिंदास्यमनोहराम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.6.s:
baṃdhujīvaprabhāmuṣṭādharauṣṭharu cirānanām ..
raṇanmaṃjīrayugmena pādāṃbujavirājitām .. 4.6.10 ..
4.6.d:
बंधुजीवप्रभामुष्टाधरौष्ठरु चिराननाम् ॥
रणन्मंजीरयुग्मेन पादांबुजविराजिताम् ॥ 4.6.10 ॥

4.6.s:
maṇīṃdrāṇāṃ prabhāmoṣanakharājivirājitām ..
kuṅakumābhāsamācchādya padādhorāgabhūṣitām .. 11 ..
4.6.d:
मणींद्राणां प्रभामोषनखराजिविराजिताम् ॥
कुङकुमाभासमाच्छाद्य पदाधोरागभूषिताम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.6.s:
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ raśanāśroṇibhūṣitām ..
hutāśanaviśuddhāṃśukāmūlyajvalitojjvalām .. 12 ..
4.6.d:
अमूल्यरत्नसाराणां रशनाश्रोणिभूषिताम् ॥
हुताशनविशुद्धांशुकामूल्यज्वलितोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.6.s:
mahāmaṇīṃdrasārāṇāṃ kiṅkiṇīmadhyasaṃyutām ..
sadratnahārakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇabhūṣitām .. 13 ..
4.6.d:
महामणींद्रसाराणां किङ्किणीमध्यसंयुताम् ॥
सद्रत्नहारकेयूरकरकंकणभूषिताम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.6.s:
ratneṃdrasāraracitakapolojjvalakuṇḍalām ..
karṇopari maṇīndrāṇāṃ karṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 14 ..
4.6.d:
रत्नेंद्रसाररचितकपोलोज्ज्वलकुण्डलाम् ॥
कर्णोपरि मणीन्द्राणां कर्णभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ 14 ॥

4.6.s:
khageṃdracaṃcunāsāgra gajeṃdramauktikānvitām ..
mālatīmālayā vakrakabarībhāraśobhi tām .. 15 ..
4.6.d:
खगेंद्रचंचुनासाग्र गजेंद्रमौक्तिकान्विताम् ॥
मालतीमालया वक्रकबरीभारशोभि ताम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.6.s:
mālayā kaustubheṃdrāṇāṃ vakṣaḥsthalasuśobhitām..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālojjvalāṃbarām .. 16 ..
4.6.d:
मालया कौस्तुभेंद्राणां वक्षःस्थलसुशोभिताम्॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालोज्ज्वलांबराम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.6.m:
her chest gracefully adorned with a garland of the finest Kaustubhas,
her upper garment radiant with an array of garlands of pārijāta blossoms, // 16
her fingers adorned with heaps of jewel-set rings,
adorned with beautiful conch-shell ornaments fashioned into fine threads, // 17
made of heavenly conch shell and adorned with diverse colours,
splendid with strings made from clusters of the finest choice gems, // 18
her lovely body veiled with the lustre of molten gold,
charming with hips and waist, bent slightly under the weight of swelling breasts, // 19
adorned with all manner of ornaments that were themselves adorned by her beauty.
Seeing that supreme sovereign lady, all the gods were amazed;
all those gods, having all their desires fulfilled, praised her. // 4.6.20
Brahmā said:
May the bee of my mind ever wander, O Lord, at the lotus of your feet in loving devotion;
give me firm, fully mature devotion and servitude to you, which is the medicine to quench the burning pain born from the enjoyment of worldly power! // 21
Śaṅkara said:
My fish-like mind, submerged in the ocean of worldly existence, constantly roams in this terrible well of saṃsāra;
take away this utterly blameworthy worldly concern that is the essence of creation and dissolution, and grant me devotion to your lotus feet! // 22
Dharma said:
O my Lord, may my association with your own people be a sharp sword for cutting the bonds of worldly objects;
give me devotion to your lotus feet birth after birth, the sole cause of granting a place at your lotus feet! // 23
Having thus offered praise, their minds single-pointedly fulfilled,
they stood before the fulfiller of desires, the lord of Rādhikā. // 24
Hearing the praise of the gods, the storehouse of compassion,
his lotus face smiling, addressed them with words beneficial and true. // 25
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Stay, come forward, O gods—you are mine, there is no doubt of this;
it is not fitting now to enquire after the welfare of those who have Śiva as their refuge. // 26
Be free from care right here; what anxiety can there be for you when I am present?

4.6.s:
ratnāṃgulīya nikaraiḥ karāṃgulivibhūṣitām ..
divyaśaṃkhavikāraiśca citrarāgavibhūṣitaiḥ ..17..
4.6.d:
रत्नांगुलीय निकरैः करांगुलिविभूषिताम् ॥
दिव्यशंखविकारैश्च चित्ररागविभूषितैः ॥17॥

4.6.s:
sūkṣmasūtrākṛtai ramyairbhūṣitā śaṃkhabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
sadratnasāraguṭikārājisūtrasuśobhitām .. 18..
4.6.d:
सूक्ष्मसूत्राकृतै रम्यैर्भूषिता शंखभूषणैः ॥
सद्रत्नसारगुटिकाराजिसूत्रसुशोभिताम् ॥ 18॥

4.6.s:
prataptasvarṇavarṇābhāmācchādya cāruvigrahām ..
nitambaśroṇilalitāṃ pīnastananatāṃbarām ..19..
4.6.d:
प्रतप्तस्वर्णवर्णाभामाच्छाद्य चारुविग्रहाम् ॥
नितम्बश्रोणिललितां पीनस्तननतांबराम् ॥19॥

4.6.s:
bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sauṃdaryeṇa vibhūṣitaiḥ ..
vismitāstridaśāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tāmīśvarīṃ varām..
tuṣṭuvuste surāḥ sarve pūrṇasarvamanorathāḥ..4.6.20..
4.6.d:
भूषितां भूषणैः सर्वैः सौंदर्येण विभूषितैः ॥
विस्मितास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तामीश्वरीं वराम्॥
तुष्टुवुस्ते सुराः सर्वे पूर्णसर्वमनोरथाः॥4.6.20॥

4.6.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
tava caraṇasaroje manmanaścaṃcarīko bhramatu satatamīśa premabhaktyā saroje ..
bhuvanavibhavabhogāttāpaśāṃtyauṣadhāyasudṛḍhasu paripakvādehibhakti cadāsyam .. 21 ..
4.6.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
तव चरणसरोजे मन्मनश्चंचरीको भ्रमतु सततमीश प्रेमभक्त्या सरोजे ॥
भुवनविभवभोगात्तापशांत्यौषधायसुदृढसु परिपक्वादेहिभक्ति चदास्यम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.6.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
bhavajalanidhimagnambittamīno madīyo bhramati satatamasminghorasaṃsāra kūpe ..
viṣayamativiniṃdyaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārarūpamapanaya tava bhaktiṃ dehi pādāraviṃde .. 22 ..
4.6.d:
॥ शंकर उवाच ॥ ॥
भवजलनिधिमग्नम्बित्तमीनो मदीयो भ्रमति सततमस्मिन्घोरसंसार कूपे ॥
विषयमतिविनिंद्यं सृष्टिसंहाररूपमपनय तव भक्तिं देहि पादारविंदे ॥ 22 ॥

4.6.s:
.. dharma uvāca ..
tava nijajanasārddhaṃ saṃgamo me madīśa bhavatu viṣayabaṃdhacchedane tīkṣṇakhaṅgaḥ.
tava caraṇasaroje sthānadānaikaheturjanuṣi januṣi bhaktiṃ dehi pādāravinde ..23..
4.6.d:
॥ धर्म उवाच ॥
तव निजजनसार्द्धं संगमो मे मदीश भवतु विषयबंधच्छेदने तीक्ष्णखङ्गः।
तव चरणसरोजे स्थानदानैकहेतुर्जनुषि जनुषि भक्तिं देहि पादारविन्दे ॥23॥

4.6.s:
ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā paripūrṇaikasānasāḥ ..
kāmapūrasya puratastiṣṭhato rādhikāpateḥ .. 24 ..
4.6.d:
इत्येवं स्तवनं कृत्वा परिपूर्णैकसानसाः ॥
कामपूरस्य पुरतस्तिष्ठतो राधिकापतेः ॥ 24 ॥

4.6.s:
surāṇāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tānu vāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vacanaṃ smerānanasaroruhaḥ .. 25 ..
4.6.d:
सुराणां स्तवनं श्रुत्वा तानु वाच कृपानिधिः ॥
हितं तथ्यं च वचनं स्मेराननसरोरुहः ॥ 25 ॥

4.6.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tiṣṭhatāgacchata surā madīyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
śivāśrayāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ praṣṭuṃ yuktaṃ na sāṃpratam .. 26 ..
4.6.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तिष्ठतागच्छत सुरा मदीया नात्र संशयः ॥
शिवाश्रयाणां कुशलं प्रष्टुं युक्तं न सांप्रतम् ॥ 26 ॥

4.6.s:
niściṃtā bhavatātraiva kā ciṃtā vo mayi sthite..
sthito'haṃ sarvajīveṣu pratyakṣo'haṃ stavena vai..27..
4.6.d:
निश्चिंता भवतात्रैव का चिंता वो मयि स्थिते॥
स्थितोऽहं सर्वजीवेषु प्रत्यक्षोऽहं स्तवेन वै॥27॥
4.6.m:
"I reside in all living beings; indeed, I become visible through praise.
I know with certainty whatever intention you have.
And whatever good or evil deed will indeed come to pass in its own time.
O gods, every deed, whether great or small, is wrought by Time.
In their own seasons the trees are ever bearing fruit and blossoming;
ripe are their fruits in time, and in time endowed with ripe fruits.
Happiness, suffering, misfortune, prosperity, grief, anxiety, good and evil,
all resting upon the fruits of one's own deeds, arise at their proper time.
Indeed, no one is dear or unpleasing to anyone in the three worlds;
in time, through the force of circumstances, those disliked become dear, and the dear become disliked.
Kings and Manus on earth were seen by you here;
by the ripening of the fruit of their own deeds, all have gone under the sway of Time.
And the moment that has just now passed for you in Goloka,
by that very moment seven manvantaras have passed on earth.
Seven Indras have passed there, and now there is an eighth lord of the gods.
My wheel of Time turns continually day and night;
Indras, Manus, and kings have all gone under the sway of Time.
Renown and merit on earth are now reduced to mere tales.
Even now, many kings, wicked and blasphemers of Hari,
have arisen on earth, possessing great strength and prowess.
All those kings will certainly pass under the sway of death.
Even though this Time has arrived, the wind blows constantly,
fire burns, and the sun blazes indeed by my command.
Diseases dwell in bodies, death moves among living beings,
these clouds rain, and all the gods [act] by my command.
Brahmins intent on brahminhood, ascetics rich in penance intent on austerity,
Brahma-ṛṣis intent on Brahman, and yogins intent on yoga,
all of them, terrified of fear of me, are devoted each to their own deeds and duties.

4.6.s:
yuṣmākaṃ yamabhiprāyaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmi niścitam ..
śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma kāle khalu bhaviṣyati .. 28 ..
4.6.d:
युष्माकं यमभिप्रायं सर्वं जानामि निश्चितम् ॥
शुभाशुभं च यत्कर्म काले खलु भविष्यति ॥ 28 ॥

4.6.s:
mahatkṣudraṃ ca yatkarma sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ surāḥ ..
sve sve kāle ca taravaḥ phalitāḥ puṣpiṇaḥ sadā .. 29 ..
4.6.d:
महत्क्षुद्रं च यत्कर्म सर्वं कालकृतं सुराः ॥
स्वे स्वे काले च तरवः फलिताः पुष्पिणः सदा ॥ 29 ॥

4.6.s:
paripakvaphalāḥ kāle kāle pakvaphalānvitāḥ ..
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vipatsaṃpacchokaciṃtāśubhāśubham .. 4.6.30 ..
4.6.d:
परिपक्वफलाः काले काले पक्वफलान्विताः ॥
सुखं दुःखं विपत्संपच्छोकचिंताशुभाशुभम् ॥ 4.6.30 ॥

4.6.s:
svakarmaphalaniṣṭhaṃ ca sarvakāle'pyupasthitam ..
na hi kasya priyaḥ ko vā vipriyo vā jagattraye .. 31 ..
4.6.d:
स्वकर्मफलनिष्ठं च सर्वकालेऽप्युपस्थितम् ॥
न हि कस्य प्रियः को वा विप्रियो वा जगत्त्रये ॥ 31 ॥

4.6.s:
kāle kāryavaśātsarve bhavaṃtyevāpriyāḥ priyāḥ ..
rājāno manavaḥ pṛthvyāṃ dṛṣṭā yuṣmābhiratra vai .. 32 ..
4.6.d:
काले कार्यवशात्सर्वे भवंत्येवाप्रियाः प्रियाः ॥
राजानो मनवः पृथ्व्यां दृष्टा युष्माभिरत्र वै ॥ 32 ॥

4.6.s:
svakarmaphalapākena sarve kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ ..
yuṣmākamadhunā caiva goloke yatkṣaṇaṃ gatam .. 33 ..
4.6.d:
स्वकर्मफलपाकेन सर्वे कालवशं गताः ॥
युष्माकमधुना चैव गोलोके यत्क्षणं गतम् ॥ 33 ॥

4.6.s:
pṛthivyāṃ tatkṣaṇenaiva saptamanvataraṃ gatam ..
iṃdrāḥ sapta gatāstatra deveṃdra ścāṣṭamo'dhunā .. 34 ..
4.6.d:
पृथिव्यां तत्क्षणेनैव सप्तमन्वतरं गतम् ॥
इंद्राः सप्त गतास्तत्र देवेंद्र श्चाष्टमोऽधुना ॥ 34 ॥

4.6.s:
kālacakraṃ bhramatyeva madīyaṃ ca divāniśam ..
indrāśca mānavā bhūpāḥ sarve kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ .. 35 ..
4.6.d:
कालचक्रं भ्रमत्येव मदीयं च दिवानिशम् ॥
इन्द्राश्च मानवा भूपाः सर्वे कालवशं गताः ॥ 35 ॥

4.6.s:
kīrtiḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyamadya kathāmātrāvaśeṣitam ..
adhunā'pi ca rājāno duṣṭāśca hariniṃdakāḥ .. 36 ..
4.6.d:
कीर्तिः पृथ्व्यां पुण्यमद्य कथामात्रावशेषितम् ॥
अधुनाऽपि च राजानो दुष्टाश्च हरिनिंदकाः ॥ 36 ॥

4.6.s:
babhūvurbahavo bhūmau mahābala parākramāḥ ..
sarve yāsyaṃti rājānaḥ kālāṃtaravaśaṃ dhuvam .. 37 ..
4.6.d:
बभूवुर्बहवो भूमौ महाबल पराक्रमाः ॥
सर्वे यास्यंति राजानः कालांतरवशं धुवम् ॥ 37 ॥

4.6.s:
upasthito'pi kālo'yaṃ vāto vāti niraṃtaram ..
vahnirdahati sūryaśca tapatyeva mamājñayā .. 38 ..
4.6.d:
उपस्थितोऽपि कालोऽयं वातो वाति निरंतरम् ॥
वह्निर्दहति सूर्यश्च तपत्येव ममाज्ञया ॥ 38 ॥

4.6.s:
vyādhayaḥ saṃti deheṣu mṛtyuścarati jaṃtuṣu ..
varṣaṃtyete jaladharāḥ sarve devā mamājñayā .. 39 ..
4.6.d:
व्याधयः संति देहेषु मृत्युश्चरति जंतुषु ॥
वर्षंत्येते जलधराः सर्वे देवा ममाज्ञया ॥ 39 ॥

4.6.s:
brāhmaṇyaniṣṭhā viprāśca taponiṣṭhāstapodhanāḥ .. bra
hmarṣayo brahmaniṣṭhā yoganiṣṭhāśca yoginaḥ .. 4.6.40 ..
4.6.d:
ब्राह्मण्यनिष्ठा विप्राश्च तपोनिष्ठास्तपोधनाः ॥ ब्र
ह्मर्षयो ब्रह्मनिष्ठा योगनिष्ठाश्च योगिनः ॥ 4.6.40 ॥

4.6.s:
te sarve madbhayādbhītāḥ svakarmadharmatatparāḥ ..
madbhaktāścaiva niḥśaṃkāḥ karmanirmūlakārakāḥ .. 41 ..
4.6.d:
ते सर्वे मद्भयाद्भीताः स्वकर्मधर्मतत्पराः ॥
मद्भक्ताश्चैव निःशंकाः कर्मनिर्मूलकारकाः ॥ 41 ॥
4.6.m:
And my devotees, being free from doubt, eradicate karma.
O gods, I am the Time of Time, the ordainer of the creator itself,
the destroyer of the destroyer, the protector of the protector, higher than the highest.
By my command this one is the destroyer, and therefore is called Hara by name.
You are the creator of the universe for the sake of creation, and [Viṣṇu] is the protector for the guarding of dharma.
From Brahmā down to a blade of grass, I am the sovereign of all.
I am the dispenser of the fruit of one's own deeds, the eradicator of karma.
When I shall destroy them, who could be their protector?
And whom I shall protect, no one at all is their slayer.
I alone am the destroyer, the creator, and the protector of all.
Yet I am not able to destroy my devotees, who possess eternal bodies.
Devotees are ever my followers, intent on worshipping my feet;
I am constantly near the devotees for the sake of their protection.
All things in the cosmic egg perish and are born again and again;
my devotees do not perish, free from doubt and free from danger.
Therefore, all the wise desire servitude [to me], not boons;
those who beg me for servitude are blessed, while others are deceived.
Fear of birth, death, old age, disease, and the torments of Yama
belongs to other actors of deeds, but never to my devotees.
Devotees are not tainted by sins or by merits, as are all [other] agents of actions;
I surely shake off the experiences of their karma.
I am the life-breath of my devotees, and the devotees are my life-breath;
they meditate on me constantly, and I remember them day and night.
The discus named Sudarśana has sixteen spokes and is exceedingly sharp;
even a sixteenth part of its splendour does not exist in any living beings.
Placing that desired discus near my devotee for protection,
I have no peace and no joy [until] I go near them.
I have no peace in Vaikuṇṭha, nor in Goloka beside Rādhikā;

4.6.s:
devāḥ kālasya kālo'haṃ vidhātā dhātureva ca ..
saṃhārakartuḥ saṃhartā pātuḥ pātā parātparaḥ .. 42 ..
4.6.d:
देवाः कालस्य कालोऽहं विधाता धातुरेव च ॥
संहारकर्तुः संहर्ता पातुः पाता परात्परः ॥ 42 ॥

4.6.s:
mamājñayā'yaṃ saṃhartā nāmrā tena haraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tvaṃ viśvasṛṭ sṛṣṭihetoḥ pātā dharmasya rakṣaṇāt .. 43 ..
4.6.d:
ममाज्ञयाऽयं संहर्ता नाम्रा तेन हरः स्मृतः ॥
त्वं विश्वसृट् सृष्टिहेतोः पाता धर्मस्य रक्षणात् ॥ 43 ॥

4.6.s:
brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ sarveṣāmahamīśvaraḥ ..
svakarmaphaladātā'haṃ karmanirmūlakārakaḥ .. 44 ..
4.6.d:
ब्रह्मादितृणपर्यन्तं सर्वेषामहमीश्वरः ॥
स्वकर्मफलदाताऽहं कर्मनिर्मूलकारकः ॥ 44 ॥

4.6.s:
ahaṃ yānsaṃhariṣyāmi kasteṣāmapi rakṣitā ..
yānahaṃ pālayiṣyāmi teṣāṃ haṃtā na ko'pi vā .. 45 ..
4.6.d:
अहं यान्संहरिष्यामि कस्तेषामपि रक्षिता ॥
यानहं पालयिष्यामि तेषां हंता न कोऽपि वा ॥ 45 ॥

4.6.s:
sarveṣāmapi saṃhartā sraṣṭā pātā'hameva ca ..
nāhaṃ śaktaśca bhaktānāṃ saṃhāre nityadehinām .. 46 ..
4.6.d:
सर्वेषामपि संहर्ता स्रष्टा पाताऽहमेव च ॥
नाहं शक्तश्च भक्तानां संहारे नित्यदेहिनाम् ॥ 46 ॥

4.6.s:
bhaktā mamānugā nityaṃ matpādārcanatatparāḥ ..
ahaṃ bhaktāṃtike śaśvatteṣāṃ rakṣaṇahetava .. 47 ..
4.6.d:
भक्ता ममानुगा नित्यं मत्पादार्चनतत्पराः ॥
अहं भक्तांतिके शश्वत्तेषां रक्षणहेतव ॥ 47 ॥

4.6.s:
sarve naśyaṃti brahmāṇḍe prabhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ..
na me bhaktāḥ praṇaśyanti niḥśaṃkāśca nirāpadaḥ .. 48 ..
4.6.d:
सर्वे नश्यंति ब्रह्माण्डे प्रभवंति पुनःपुनः ॥
न मे भक्ताः प्रणश्यन्ति निःशंकाश्च निरापदः ॥ 48 ॥

4.6.s:
ato vipaścitaḥ sarve dāsyaṃ vāṃchaṃti no varam ..
ye māṃ dāsyaṃ prayācaṃte dhanyāste'nye ca vaṃcitāḥ .. 49 ..
4.6.d:
अतो विपश्चितः सर्वे दास्यं वांछंति नो वरम् ॥
ये मां दास्यं प्रयाचंते धन्यास्तेऽन्ये च वंचिताः ॥ 49 ॥

4.6.s:
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhi bhayaṃ ca yamayātanā ..
anyeṣāṃ karmiṇāmasti na bhaktānāṃ ca karhicit .. 4.6.50 ..
4.6.d:
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधि भयं च यमयातना ॥
अन्येषां कर्मिणामस्ति न भक्तानां च कर्हिचित् ॥ 4.6.50 ॥

4.6.s:
bhaktā na liptāḥ pāpeṣu puṇyeṣu sarvaka rmiṇaḥ ..
ahaṃ dhunomi teṣāṃ ca karmabhogānsuniścitam .. 51 ..
4.6.d:
भक्ता न लिप्ताः पापेषु पुण्येषु सर्वक र्मिणः ॥
अहं धुनोमि तेषां च कर्मभोगान्सुनिश्चितम् ॥ 51 ॥

4.6.s:
ahaṃ prāṇaśca bhaktānāṃ bhaktāḥ prāṇā mamāpi ca ..
dhyāyaṃte te ca māṃ nityaṃ tānsmarāmi divāniśam .. 52 ..
4.6.d:
अहं प्राणश्च भक्तानां भक्ताः प्राणा ममापि च ॥
ध्यायंते ते च मां नित्यं तान्स्मरामि दिवानिशम् ॥ 52 ॥

4.6.s:
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśāraṃ sutīkṣṇakam ..
yattejaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśo'pi nāsti sarveṣu jīviṣu .. 93 ..
4.6.d:
चक्रं सुदर्शनं नाम षोडशारं सुतीक्ष्णकम् ॥
यत्तेजः षोडशांशोऽपि नास्ति सर्वेषु जीविषु ॥ 93 ॥

4.6.s:
bhaktāntike tu taccakraṃ dattvā rakṣārthamīpsitam ..
na svāsthyaṃ na ca prītirme yāmi teṣāṃ ca sannidhim .. 54 ..
4.6.d:
भक्तान्तिके तु तच्चक्रं दत्त्वा रक्षार्थमीप्सितम् ॥
न स्वास्थ्यं न च प्रीतिर्मे यामि तेषां च सन्निधिम् ॥ 54 ॥

4.6.s:
na me svāsthyaṃ ca vaikuṃṭhe goloke rādhikāṃtike ..
yatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhaktāste tatra tiṣṭhāmyaharniśam .. 55 ..
4.6.d:
न मे स्वास्थ्यं च वैकुंठे गोलोके राधिकांतिके ॥
यत्र तिष्ठंति भक्तास्ते तत्र तिष्ठाम्यहर्निशम् ॥ 55 ॥

4.6.s:
prāṇebhyaḥ preyasī rādhā sthitorasi divāniśam ..
yūyaṃ prāṇādhikā lakṣmīrna me bhaktātparā priyā .. 56 ..
4.6.d:
प्राणेभ्यः प्रेयसी राधा स्थितोरसि दिवानिशम् ॥
यूयं प्राणाधिका लक्ष्मीर्न मे भक्तात्परा प्रिया ॥ 56 ॥

4.6.s:
bhaktadattaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ bhaktyā 'śnāmi sureśvarāḥ ..
abhaktadattaṃ nāśnāmi dhruvaṃ bhuṃkte baliṃ svayam .. 57 ..
4.6.d:
भक्तदत्तं च यद्द्रव्यं भक्त्या ऽश्नामि सुरेश्वराः ॥
अभक्तदत्तं नाश्नामि ध्रुवं भुंक्ते बलिं स्वयम् ॥ 57 ॥

4.6.s:
strīputrasvajanāṃstyaktvā dhyāyaṃte māmaharniśam ..
yuṣmānvihāya tānnityaṃ smarāmyahamaharniśam .. 58 ..
4.6.d:
स्त्रीपुत्रस्वजनांस्त्यक्त्वा ध्यायंते मामहर्निशम् ॥
युष्मान्विहाय तान्नित्यं स्मराम्यहमहर्निशम् ॥ 58 ॥

4.6.s:
duṣṭā yadā me bhaktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi ..
kratūnāṃ devatānāṃ ca hiṃsāṃ kurvaṃti niścitam .. 59 ..
4.6.d:
दुष्टा यदा मे भक्तानां ब्राह्मणानां गवामपि ॥
क्रतूनां देवतानां च हिंसां कुर्वंति निश्चितम् ॥ 59 ॥

4.6.s:
tathā'ciraṃ te naśyaṃti yathā vahnau tṛṇāni ca ..
na ko'pi rakṣitā teṣāṃ mayi haṃtaryupasthite .. 4.6.60 ..
4.6.d:
तथाऽचिरं ते नश्यंति यथा वह्नौ तृणानि च ॥
न कोऽपि रक्षिता तेषां मयि हंतर्युपस्थिते ॥ 4.6.60 ॥

4.6.s:
yāsyāmi pṛthivīṃ devā yāta yūyaṃ svamālayam ..
yūyaṃ caivāṃśarūpeṇa śīghraṃ gacchata bhūtalam .. 61 ..
4.6.d:
यास्यामि पृथिवीं देवा यात यूयं स्वमालयम् ॥
यूयं चैवांशरूपेण शीघ्रं गच्छत भूतलम् ॥ 61 ॥

4.6.s:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho gopānā hūya gopikāḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ yatsamayocitam .. 62 ..
4.6.d:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां नाथो गोपाना हूय गोपिकाः ॥
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं सत्यं यत्समयोचितम् ॥ 62 ॥

4.6.s:
gopā gopyaśca śṛṇuta yāta naṃdavrajaṃ param ..
vṛṣabhānugṛhe kṣipraṃ gaccha tvamapi rādhike .. 63 ..
4.6.d:
गोपा गोप्यश्च शृणुत यात नंदव्रजं परम् ॥
वृषभानुगृहे क्षिप्रं गच्छ त्वमपि राधिके ॥ 63 ॥

4.6.s:
vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī naṃdagopakalāvatī ..
subalasya sutā sā ca kamalāṃśasamudbhavā .. .. 64 ..
4.6.d:
वृषभानुप्रिया साध्वी नंदगोपकलावती ॥
सुबलस्य सुता सा च कमलांशसमुद्भवा ॥ ॥ 64 ॥

4.6.s:
pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ..
purā durvāsasaḥ śāpājjanma tasyā vraje gṛhe .. 65 ..
4.6.d:
पितॄणां मानसी कन्या धन्या मान्या च योषिताम् ॥
पुरा दुर्वाससः शापाज्जन्म तस्या व्रजे गृहे ॥ 65 ॥

4.6.s:
tasyā gṛhe janma labha śīghraṃ naṃdavrajaṃ vraja ..
tvāmahaṃ bālarūpeṇa gṛhṇāmi kamalānane .. 66 ..
4.6.d:
तस्या गृहे जन्म लभ शीघ्रं नंदव्रजं व्रज ॥
त्वामहं बालरूपेण गृह्णामि कमलानने ॥ 66 ॥

4.6.s:
tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā rādhe tava prāṇādhiko'pyaham..
na kiṃcidāvayorbhinnamekāṃgaṃ sarvadaiva hi ..67..
4.6.d:
त्वं मे प्राणाधिका राधे तव प्राणाधिकोऽप्यहम्॥
न किंचिदावयोर्भिन्नमेकांगं सर्वदैव हि ॥67॥

4.6.s:
śrutvaivaṃ rādhikā tatra ruroda premavihvalā ..
papau cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacaṃdraṃ harermune ..68..
4.6.d:
श्रुत्वैवं राधिका तत्र रुरोद प्रेमविह्वला ॥
पपौ चक्षुश्चकोराभ्यां मुखचंद्रं हरेर्मुने ॥68॥

4.6.s:
janurlabhata gopāśca gopyaśca pṛthivītale ..
gopānāmuttamānāṃ ca maṃdire maṃdire śubhe ..69..
4.6.d:
जनुर्लभत गोपाश्च गोप्यश्च पृथिवीतले ॥
गोपानामुत्तमानां च मंदिरे मंदिरे शुभे ॥69॥
4.6.m:
wherever those devotees of mine abide, there I abide day and night.
Rādhā, dearer than life, dwells upon my chest day and night;
you are dearer than life, Lakṣmī is, but none is dearer to me than a devotee.
And whatever item is offered by a devotee with devotion, O lords of gods, I eat;
what is offered by a non-devotee I do not eat; Bali himself surely consumes it.
Abandoning wife, sons, and kin, they meditate on me day and night;
leaving you, I constantly remember them day and night.
When the wicked surely inflict harm upon my devotees,
upon Brahmins, upon cows, upon sacrifices, and upon deities,
they perish without delay, just like blades of grass in fire;
no one is their protector when I have arrived as their slayer.
I will go to earth, O gods; go to your own abodes.
And you too, in the form of your portions, go quickly to the earthly plane."
Having spoken thus, the Lord of the worlds called the cowherd men and cowherd women
and spoke sweet words, truthful and suited to the occasion:
"O cowherds and cowherdesses, listen! Go to the supreme Vraja of Nanda.
Go swiftly to the house of Vṛṣabhānu, you too, O Rādhikā!
The beloved of Vṛṣabhānu, the virtuous Kalāvatī, [sister of] Nandagopa,
is the daughter of Subala, born from a portion of Kamalā,
the mind-born daughter of the ancestors, blessed and honoured among women.
Formerly, through the curse of Durvāsas, her birth took place in a house in Vraja.
Take birth in her house, and go quickly to the Vraja of Nanda;
I will take you in the form of a child, O lotus-faced one!
You are dearer to me than life, O Rādhā, and I am dearer to you than life;
there is nothing distinct between us two, forever indeed of one body."
Hearing this, Rādhikā wept there, overcome with love;
with the cakora-birds of her eyes, O sage, she drank the moon of Hari's face.
[The Lord said:] "Take birth, O cowherds and cowherdesses, on the earthly plane,
in the auspicious homes of the foremost cowherds."

4.6.s:
etasminnaṃtare sarve dadṛśū rathamuttamam ..
maṇiratneṃdrasāreṇa hīrakeṇa vibhūṣitam ..4.6.70..
4.6.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वे ददृशू रथमुत्तमम् ॥
मणिरत्नेंद्रसारेण हीरकेण विभूषितम् ॥4.6.70॥
4.6.m:
In the meantime, everyone saw an excellent chariot, / adorned with the finest diamonds and precious jewels, / 70
beautified with a hundred thousand white chowries and tens of thousands of mirrors, / adorned with fine, fire-purified ochre garments, / 71
richly decorated with a thousand vessels of excellent gems, / shining with networks of garlands of pārijāta blossoms, / 72
accompanied by choice attendants, auspicious, made of gold, / the very embodiment of splendor, peerless, radiant as a hundred suns. / 73
Seated upon it, [they saw] a dark, handsome, charming man, / holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, clad in excellent yellow garments, / 74
wearing a diadem and earrings, adorned with a forest garland, / anointed with paste of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron, / 75
four-armed, smiling-faced, eager to grant grace to his devotees, / adorned with the finest ornaments made from the essence of prime jewels. / 76
To his left [stood] a charming goddess, fair-complexioned and captivating, / richly endowed with the beauty of gem ornaments, adorned with yellow garments, / 77
with a face like the full autumn moon, eyes like autumn lotuses, / lips like ripe bimba fruit, smiling and delightful, / 78
holding a flute, a vīṇā, and a book in her hands, eager to grant grace to devotees— / the presiding goddess of learning, the embodiment of wisdom, Sarasvatī. / 79
To his right [stood] another charming [goddess], radiant as a hundred moons, / lustrous with the hue of molten gold, smiling, exceedingly delightful, / 80
her beautiful cheeks adorned with earrings of fine gems, / clothed in priceless garments inlaid with priceless jewels, / 81
adorned with armlets and bracelets of priceless gems, / accompanied by the tinkling sound of anklets made from the essence of fine gems, / 82
her waist graced with a girdle of supreme jewels, / her chest bright with garlands of pārijāta blossoms, / 83
her braid of hair adorned with garlands of blooming mālatī flowers, / beautifully adorned with a face outshining the radiance of the autumn moon, / 84

4.6.s:
śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhitaṃ darpaṇāyutaiḥ ..
sūkṣmakāṣāyavastreṇa vahniśuddhena bhūṣitam .. .. 71 ..
4.6.d:
श्वेतचामरलक्षेण शोभितं दर्पणायुतैः ॥
सूक्ष्मकाषायवस्त्रेण वह्निशुद्धेन भूषितम् ॥ ॥ 71 ॥

4.6.s:
sadratnakalaśānāṃ ca sahasreṇa suśobhitam ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam .. 72 ..
4.6.d:
सद्रत्नकलशानां च सहस्रेण सुशोभितम् ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विराजितम् ॥ 72 ॥

4.6.s:
pārṣadapravaraiyuktaṃ śāta kuṃbhamayaṃ śubham ..
tejaḥsvarūpamatulaṃ śatasūryasamaprabham .. 73 ..
4.6.d:
पार्षदप्रवरैयुक्तं शात कुंभमयं शुभम् ॥
तेजःस्वरूपमतुलं शतसूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥ 73 ॥

4.6.s:
tatrasthaṃ puruṣaṃ śyāmaṃ sundaraṃ kamanīyakam ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ varam .. 74 ..
4.6.d:
तत्रस्थं पुरुषं श्यामं सुन्दरं कमनीयकम् ॥
शंखचक्रगदापद्मधरं पीतांबरं वरम् ॥ 74 ॥

4.6.s:
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam .. 75 ..
4.6.d:
किरीटिनं कुण्डलिनं वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवचर्चितम् ॥ 75 ॥

4.6.s:
caturbhujaṃ smeravaktraṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ..
maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam .. 76 ..
4.6.d:
चतुर्भुजं स्मेरवक्त्रं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् ॥
मणिरत्नेंद्रसाराणां सारभूषणभूषितम् ॥ 76 ॥

4.6.s:
devīṃ tadvāmato ramyāṃ śuklavarṇāṃ manoharām ..
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā .. 77 ..
4.6.d:
देवीं तद्वामतो रम्यां शुक्लवर्णां मनोहराम् ॥
रत्नालंकारशोभाढ्यां शोभितां पीतवाससा ॥ 77 ॥

4.6.s:
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ..
pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca smerayu ktāṃ manoharām .. 78 ..
4.6.d:
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यां शरत्पंकजलोचनाम् ॥
पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठीं च स्मेरयु क्तां मनोहराम् ॥ 78 ॥

4.6.s:
veṇuvīṇāgraṃthahastāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ..
vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca jñānarūpāṃ sarasvatīm .. 79 ..
4.6.d:
वेणुवीणाग्रंथहस्तां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम् ॥
विद्याधिष्ठातृदेवीं च ज्ञानरूपां सरस्वतीम् ॥ 79 ॥

4.6.s:
aparāṃ dakṣiṇe ramyāṃ śatacaṃdrasamaprabhām ..
prataptasvarṇavarṇābhāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām .. 4.6.80 ..
4.6.d:
अपरां दक्षिणे रम्यां शतचंद्रसमप्रभाम् ॥
प्रतप्तस्वर्णवर्णाभां सस्मितां सुमनोहराम् ॥ 4.6.80 ॥

4.6.s:
sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca sukapolavirāji tām ..
amūlyaratnakhacitāmūlyavastreṇa bhūṣitām .. 81 ..
4.6.d:
सद्रत्नकुण्डलाभ्यां च सुकपोलविराजि ताम् ॥
अमूल्यरत्नखचितामूल्यवस्त्रेण भूषिताम् ॥ 81 ॥
4.6.m: her lovely cheeks bright with earrings of noble gems,

4.6.s:
amūlyaratnakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇaśobhitām ..
sadratnasāramaṃjīrakalaśabdasa manvitām .. 82 ..
4.6.d:
अमूल्यरत्नकेयूरकरकंकणशोभिताम् ॥
सद्रत्नसारमंजीरकलशब्दस मन्विताम् ॥ 82 ॥

4.6.s:
maṇīṃdrakiṃkiṇīyuktamadhyadeśasamanvitām ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāvakṣaḥ sthalojjvalām .. 83 ..
4.6.d:
मणींद्रकिंकिणीयुक्तमध्यदेशसमन्विताम् ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालावक्षः स्थलोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 83 ॥

4.6.s:
praphulla mālatīmālāsaṃyuktakabarīyutām ..
śaraccaṃdraprabhāmuṣṇanmukhacāruvibhūṣitām .. 84 ..
4.6.d:
प्रफुल्ल मालतीमालासंयुक्तकबरीयुताम् ॥
शरच्चंद्रप्रभामुष्णन्मुखचारुविभूषिताम् ॥ 84 ॥

4.6.s:
kastūrībiṃdusaṃyuktasinduratilakānvitām ..
sucārukajjalāsaktaśaratpaṃkajalocanām .. 85 ..
4.6.d:
कस्तूरीबिंदुसंयुक्तसिन्दुरतिलकान्विताम् ॥
सुचारुकज्जलासक्तशरत्पंकजलोचनाम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.6.m:
bearing a sindūra mark dotted with a drop of musk, / her autumn-lotus eyes painted with exquisite collyrium, / 85
holding a play-lotus attached to a thousand petals, / looking with side-glances at Nārāyaṇa as he looked at her. / 86
Quickly descending from the chariot along with his wife and his attendants, / he entered the delightful assembly filled with cowherds and gopīs. / 87
The gods, gopīs, and cowherds stood joyfully with folded hands, / as hymns of praise from the Sāmaveda were sung by the divine rṣis. / 88
Going forward, the god Nārāyaṇa merged into the body of Kṛṣṇa; / and beholding that supreme wonder, they were all struck with amazement. / 89
In the meantime, descending from a golden chariot right there, / Viṣṇu himself, the protector and lord of the worlds, / 90
arrived, four-armed, adorned with a forest garland, / clad in yellow garments, glorious, smiling, exceedingly charming, / 91
richly adorned with all kinds of ornaments, radiant as ten million suns. / Seeing him, they arose, bowed down, and praised him, O sage. / 92
And he too merged right there into the body of Rādhikā's lord; / seeing that great wonder, they were filled with the highest amazement. / 93
When the dweller of Śvetadvīpa had merged into Hari's body, / in the meantime there swiftly arrived in great haste / 94
one resembling pure crystal, known by the name Saṃkarṣaṇa, / the thousand-headed Puruṣa, radiant as a hundred suns. / 95
Seeing that embodiment of Viṣṇu arrive, all praised him. / And having approached with bent shoulders, he praised the lord of Rādhikā. / 96
With a thousand heads he bowed down in devotion, O Nārada. / And we two sons of Dharma, named Nara and Nārāyaṇa— / 97
I merged into Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, and the younger one became Phālguna. / Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, and Dharma stood together right there. / 98
In the meantime, the gods beheld an excellent chariot, / wrought of pure gold, with varied seats and furnishings, / 99

4.6.s:
sahasradalasaṃsaktalīlākamalasaṃyutām ..
nārāyaṇaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ paśyaṃtī vakraca kṣuṣā .. 86 ..
4.6.d:
सहस्रदलसंसक्तलीलाकमलसंयुताम् ॥
नारायणं च पश्यंतं पश्यंती वक्रच क्षुषा ॥ 86 ॥

4.6.s:
avaruhya rathāttūrṇa sastrīkaḥ sahapārṣadaḥ ..
jagāma ca sabhāṃ ramyāṃ gopagopīsamanvitām .. 87 ..
4.6.d:
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्ण सस्त्रीकः सहपार्षदः ॥
जगाम च सभां रम्यां गोपगोपीसमन्विताम् ॥ 87 ॥

4.6.s:
devā gopyaśca gopāśca tasthuḥ prāṃjalayo mudā ..
sāmavedoktastotreṇa kṛtena ca surarṣibhiḥ .. 88 ..
4.6.d:
देवा गोप्यश्च गोपाश्च तस्थुः प्रांजलयो मुदा ॥
सामवेदोक्तस्तोत्रेण कृतेन च सुरर्षिभिः ॥ 88 ॥

4.6.s:
gatvā nārāyaṇo devo vilīnaḥ kṛṣṇavigrahe ..
dṛṣṭvā ca paramāścaryaṃ te sarve vismayaṃ yayuḥ .. 89 ..
4.6.d:
गत्वा नारायणो देवो विलीनः कृष्णविग्रहे ॥
दृष्ट्वा च परमाश्चर्यं ते सर्वे विस्मयं ययुः ॥ 89 ॥

4.6.s:
etasminnantare tatra śātakuṃbhamayādrathāt ..
avaruhya svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ pātā ca jaga tāṃ patiḥ .. 4.6.90 ..
4.6.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र शातकुंभमयाद्रथात् ॥
अवरुह्य स्वयं विष्णुः पाता च जग तां पतिः ॥ 4.6.90 ॥

4.6.s:
ājagāma caturbāhurvanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ..
pītāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānsasmitaḥ sumanoharaḥ .. 91 ..
4.6.d:
आजगाम चतुर्बाहुर्वनमालाविभूषितः ॥
पीतांबरधरः श्रीमान्सस्मितः सुमनोहरः ॥ 91 ॥

4.6.s:
sarvālaṃkāraśobhā ḍhyaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ..
uttasthuste ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatā mune .. 92 ..
4.6.d:
सर्वालंकारशोभा ढ्यः सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः ॥
उत्तस्थुस्ते च तं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टुवुः प्रणता मुने ॥ 92 ॥

4.6.s:
sa cāpi līnastatraiva rādhikeśasya vigrahe ..
te dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ .. 93 ..
4.6.d:
स चापि लीनस्तत्रैव राधिकेशस्य विग्रहे ॥
ते दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं विस्मयं परमं ययुः ॥ 93 ॥

4.6.s:
saṃvilīne hareraṃge śvetadvīpanivāsini ..
etasminnaṃtare tūrṇamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ .. 94 ..
4.6.d:
संविलीने हरेरंगे श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनि ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तूर्णमाजगाम त्वरान्वितः ॥ 94 ॥

4.6.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo nāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ .. 95 ..
4.6.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशो नाम्ना संकर्षणः स्मृतः ॥
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः शतसूर्यसमप्रभः ॥ 95 ॥

4.6.s:
āgataṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ viṣṇuvi graham ..
sa cāgatya nataskadhastuṣṭāva rādhikeśvaram .. 96 ..
4.6.d:
आगतं तुष्टुवुः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तं विष्णुवि ग्रहम् ॥
स चागत्य नतस्कधस्तुष्टाव राधिकेश्वरम् ॥ 96 ॥

4.6.s:
sahasramūrdhā bhaktyā ca praṇanāma ca nārada ..
āvāṃ ca dharmaputrau dvau nara nārāyaṇābhidhau .. 97 ..
4.6.d:
सहस्रमूर्धा भक्त्या च प्रणनाम च नारद ॥
आवां च धर्मपुत्रौ द्वौ नर नारायणाभिधौ ॥ 97 ॥

4.6.s:
līno'haṃ kṛṣṇapādābje babhūva phālguno'varaḥ..
brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca tasthurekatra tatra vai .. 98 ..
4.6.d:
लीनोऽहं कृष्णपादाब्जे बभूव फाल्गुनोऽवरः॥
ब्रह्मेशशेषधर्माश्च तस्थुरेकत्र तत्र वै ॥ 98 ॥

4.6.s:
etasminnaṃtare devā dadṛśū rathamuttamam ..
svarṇasāravikāraṃ ca nānāsanaparicchadam .. 99 ..
4.6.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवा ददृशू रथमुत्तमम् ॥
स्वर्णसारविकारं च नानासनपरिच्छदम् ॥ 99 ॥

4.6.s:
maṇīṃdrasārasaṃyuktaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ..
śvetacāmara saṃyuktaṃ bhūṣitaṃ darpaṇānvitaiḥ .. 4.6.100 ..
4.6.d:
मणींद्रसारसंयुक्तं वह्निशुद्धांशुकान्वितम् ॥
श्वेतचामर संयुक्तं भूषितं दर्पणान्वितैः ॥ 4.6.100 ॥
4.6.m:
studded with the finest of prime jewels, furnished with fire-purified cloth, / provided with white chowries, adorned with rows of mirrors, / 100
resplendent with a host of jars made of the finest gems, / richly adorned with networks of garlands of pārijāta blossoms, / 101
fitted with a thousand wheels, moving at the speed of thought, delightful, / choice, stealing away the splendor of the summer midday sun, / 102
brilliant with clusters of pearls, rubies, and diamonds, / decorated with painted dolls, flowers, lakes, and groves, / 103
the best among the chariots of the gods and dānavas, O sage, / crafted with care by Viśvakarman out of love for Śaṅkara, / 104
fifty yojanas high and four yojanas wide, / adorned with pleasure pavilions accompanied by women resembling Rati. / 105
Seated upon it they saw the goddess, adorned with gem ornaments, / her luster stealing away the brilliance of refined molten gold, / 106
the peerless embodiment of splendor, the sovereign Mūlaprakṛti, / endowed with a thousand arms, equipped with various weapons, / 107
her pleasant face bearing a gentle smile, eager to bestow grace on devotees, / radiant with fine gem earrings resting on her cheeks and temples, / 108
resplendent with tinkling anklets made from the essence of prime jewels, / her waist gracefully adorned with a girdle of supreme gems, / 109
adorned with armlets and hand bracelets made of the essence of fine gems, / her chest shining brightly with garlands of mandāra flowers, / 110
with broad hips and firm buttocks, bending slightly with full, elevated breasts, / enchanting with a face mocking the splendor of the autumn moon, / 111
with autumn-lotus eyes anointed with bright lines of collyrium, / adorned with painted decorative leaves of sandalwood, agallochum, and musk, / 112
resplendent with rows of teeth that stole away the luster of rows of pearls, / with an exquisite braid intertwined with garlands of blooming mālatī flowers, / 113
adorned at the tip of her eagle-beak nose with an elephant pearl, / and shining brightly in exceedingly luminous fire-purified silk. / 114

4.6.s:
sadratnasārakalaśasamūhena virājitam ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiḥ suśobhitam.. 101 ..
4.6.d:
सद्रत्नसारकलशसमूहेन विराजितम् ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैः सुशोभितम्॥ 101 ॥

4.6.s:
sahasracakrasaṃyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ..
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṃḍaprabhāmoṣakaraṃ varam .. 102 ..
4.6.d:
सहस्रचक्रसंयुक्तं मनोयायि मनोहरम् ॥
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्तंडप्रभामोषकरं वरम् ॥ 102 ॥

4.6.s:
muktāmāṇikyavajrāṇāṃ samūhena samujjvalam ..
citraputtalikāpuṣpasaraḥ kānanacitritam .. 103 ..
4.6.d:
मुक्तामाणिक्यवज्राणां समूहेन समुज्ज्वलम् ॥
चित्रपुत्तलिकापुष्पसरः काननचित्रितम् ॥ 103 ॥

4.6.s:
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca rathānāṃ pravaraṃ mune ..
yatnena śaṃkaraprītyā nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 104 ..
4.6.d:
देवानां दानवानां च रथानां प्रवरं मुने ॥
यत्नेन शंकरप्रीत्या निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ 104 ॥

4.6.s:
paṃcāśadyojanordhvaṃ ca caturyojanavistṛtam ..
ratitulyavadhūyuktaiḥ śobhitaṃ ratimaṃ diraiḥ .. 105 ..
4.6.d:
पंचाशद्योजनोर्ध्वं च चतुर्योजनविस्तृतम् ॥
रतितुल्यवधूयुक्तैः शोभितं रतिमं दिरैः ॥ 105 ॥

4.6.s:
tatrasthāṃ dadṛśurdevīṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
pradagdhasvarṇasārāṇāṃ prabhāmoṣakaradyutim .. 106 ..
4.6.d:
तत्रस्थां ददृशुर्देवीं रत्नालंकारभूषिताम् ॥
प्रदग्धस्वर्णसाराणां प्रभामोषकरद्युतिम् ॥ 106 ॥

4.6.s:
tejaḥsvarūpā matulāṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ..
sahasrabhujasaṃyuktāṃ nānāyudhasamanvitām .. 107 ..
4.6.d:
तेजःस्वरूपा मतुलां मूलप्रकृतिमीश्वरीम् ॥
सहस्रभुजसंयुक्तां नानायुधसमन्विताम् ॥ 107 ॥

4.6.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ..
gaṃḍasthalakapolasthasadratnakuṃḍalojjvalām .. 108 ..
4.6.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम् ॥
गंडस्थलकपोलस्थसद्रत्नकुंडलोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 108 ॥

4.6.s:
ratnendrasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīraraṃjitām ..
maṇīṃdramekhalāyuktamadhya deśasuśobhitām .. 109 ..
4.6.d:
रत्नेन्द्रसाररचितक्वणन्मञ्जीररंजिताम् ॥
मणींद्रमेखलायुक्तमध्य देशसुशोभिताम् ॥ 109 ॥

4.6.s:
sadratnasārakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇabhūṣitām ..
maṃdārapuṣpamālābhiruraḥsthalasamujjvalām .. 4.6.110 ..
4.6.d:
सद्रत्नसारकेयूरकरकंकणभूषिताम् ॥
मंदारपुष्पमालाभिरुरःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 4.6.110 ॥

4.6.s:
nitaṃbakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ pīnonnatakucānatām ..
śaratsudhākarābhāsaviniṃdāsyamanoharām .. 111 ..
4.6.d:
नितंबकठिनश्रोणीं पीनोन्नतकुचानताम् ॥
शरत्सुधाकराभासविनिंदास्यमनोहराम् ॥ 111 ॥

4.6.s:
kajjalojjalarekhāktaśaratpaṃkajaloca nām ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīcitrapatravibhūṣitām .. 112 ..
4.6.d:
कज्जलोज्जलरेखाक्तशरत्पंकजलोच नाम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीचित्रपत्रविभूषिताम् ॥ 112 ॥

4.6.s:
muktāpaṃktiprabhāmuṣṭadaṃtarājivirājitām ..
praphullamālatīmālāsaṃsaktakabarīṃ varām ..113 ..
4.6.d:
मुक्तापंक्तिप्रभामुष्टदंतराजिविराजिताम् ॥
प्रफुल्लमालतीमालासंसक्तकबरीं वराम् ॥113 ॥

4.6.s:
pakṣīṃdracaṃcunāsāgragajeṃdramauktikānvitām ..
vahniśuddhāṃśukenātijvalitena samujjvalām .. 114 ..
4.6.d:
पक्षींद्रचंचुनासाग्रगजेंद्रमौक्तिकान्विताम् ॥
वह्निशुद्धांशुकेनातिज्वलितेन समुज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 114 ॥

4.6.s:
siṃhapṛṣṭhasamārūḍhāṃ sutābhyāṃ sahitāṃ mudā ..
avaruhya rathāttūrṇa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāma ca .. 115 ..
4.6.d:
सिंहपृष्ठसमारूढां सुताभ्यां सहितां मुदा ॥
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्ण श्रीकृष्णं प्रणनाम च ॥ 115 ॥
4.6.m:
[Durgā,] seated upon the back of a lion and accompanied by her two sons, gladly / descended swiftly from the chariot and bowed to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
Along with her two sons, that goddess of fair countenance sat down. / Gaṇeśa and Kārttikeya, having bowed to Kṛṣṇa, who is beyond the highest,
bowed to Śaṅkara, to Dharma, to Ananta, and to the lotus-born [Brahmā]. / Seeing those two lords of the gods, the gods nearby stood up.
The gods gave their blessings and seated them beside them; / filled with joy, the gods conversed pleasantly with them.
The gods remained within the assembly before Lord Hari, / and the cowherds and milkmaids were filled with wonder in many ways.
Kṛṣṇa, whose lotus face was smiling, said to Kamalā [Lakṣmī]: / "Go to the house of Bhīṣmaka, endowed with various jewels,
and take birth, eternal goddess, in the womb of the queen of Vidarbha. / Going to Kuṇḍina, O virtuous lady, I shall take your hand [in marriage]."
Seeing Pārvatī, those goddesses swiftly arose / and seated the sovereign goddess upon a charming, jewelled throne.
O best of brahmins, Pārvatī, Lakṣmī, and the presiding goddess of speech [Sarasvatī] / sat there upon a single seat, having exchanged appropriate greetings.
The cowherd maidens also spoke to them with affection; / some milkmaids spoke with joy in their presence.
There Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the universe, said to Pārvatī: / "O goddess, in the form of a portion, in the auspicious Vraja of Nanda,
take birth, O auspicious Mahāmāyā, bringer of creation and dissolution, / in the womb of Yaśodā through the seed of Nanda.
Village by village across the earth, I will cause worship to be offered to you, / throughout the entire earth with devotion, in cities and in forests.
There humans, filled with joy, shall worship you as the presiding goddess / with various divine articles and offerings.
Upon your merely touching the ground in the lying-in chamber, O auspicious lady,

4.6.s:
sutābhyāṃ sahitā devī samuvā sa varānanāḥ ..
gaṇeśaḥ kārttikeyaśca natvā kṛṣṇa parātparam .. 116 ..
4.6.d:
सुताभ्यां सहिता देवी समुवा स वराननाः ॥
गणेशः कार्त्तिकेयश्च नत्वा कृष्ण परात्परम् ॥ 116 ॥

4.6.s:
nanāma śaṃkaraṃ dharmamanaṃtaṃ kamalodbhavam ..
uttasthurārātte devā dṛṣṭvā tau tridaśeśvarau .. 117 ..
4.6.d:
ननाम शंकरं धर्ममनंतं कमलोद्भवम् ॥
उत्तस्थुरारात्ते देवा दृष्ट्वा तौ त्रिदशेश्वरौ ॥ 117 ॥

4.6.s:
āśiṣaṃ ca dadurdevā vāsayāmāsuraṃtike ..
tābhyāṃ saha sadālāpaṃ cakrurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ .. 118 ..
4.6.d:
आशिषं च ददुर्देवा वासयामासुरंतिके ॥
ताभ्यां सह सदालापं चक्रुर्देवा मुदाऽन्विताः ॥ 118 ॥

4.6.s:
tasthurdevāḥ sabhāmadhye devasya purato hareḥ ..
gopā gopyaśca bahuśo babhūvurvismayākulāḥ .. 119 ..
4.6.d:
तस्थुर्देवाः सभामध्ये देवस्य पुरतो हरेः ॥
गोपा गोप्यश्च बहुशो बभूवुर्विस्मयाकुलाः ॥ 119 ॥

4.6.s:
uvāca kamalāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ ..
tvaṃ gaccha bhīṣmakagṛhaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam .. 4.6.120 ..
4.6.d:
उवाच कमलां कृष्णः स्मेराननसरोरुहः ॥
त्वं गच्छ भीष्मकगृहं नानारत्नसमन्वितम् ॥ 4.6.120 ॥

4.6.s:
vaidarbhyā udare janma labha devi sanā tani ..
tava pāṇiṃ grahīṣyāmi gatvā'haṃ kuṃḍinaṃ sati .. 121 ..
4.6.d:
वैदर्भ्या उदरे जन्म लभ देवि सना तनि ॥
तव पाणिं ग्रहीष्यामि गत्वाऽहं कुंडिनं सति ॥ 121 ॥

4.6.s:
tā devyaḥ pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya tvarānvitāḥ ..
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm .. 122..
4.6.d:
ता देव्यः पार्वतीं दृष्ट्वा समुत्थाय त्वरान्विताः ॥
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये वासयामासुरीश्वरीम् ॥ 122॥

4.6.s:
vipreṃdra pārvatīlakṣmīvāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ ..
tasthurekāsane tatra saṃbhāṣya ca yathoci tam .. 123 ..
4.6.d:
विप्रेंद्र पार्वतीलक्ष्मीवागधिष्ठातृदेवताः ॥
तस्थुरेकासने तत्र संभाष्य च यथोचि तम् ॥ 123 ॥

4.6.s:
tāśca saṃbhāṣayāmāsuḥ saṃprītyā gopakanyakāḥ ..
ūcurgopālikāḥ kāścinmudā tāsāṃ ca saṃnidhau .. 124 ..
4.6.d:
ताश्च संभाषयामासुः संप्रीत्या गोपकन्यकाः ॥
ऊचुर्गोपालिकाः काश्चिन्मुदा तासां च संनिधौ ॥ 124 ॥

4.6.s:
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pārvatīṃ tatra samuvāca jagatpatiḥ ..
devi tvamaṃśarūpeṇa jana naṃdavraje śubhe .. 125 ..
4.6.d:
श्रीकृष्णः पार्वतीं तत्र समुवाच जगत्पतिः ॥
देवि त्वमंशरूपेण जन नंदव्रजे शुभे ॥ 125 ॥

4.6.s:
udare ca yaśodāyāḥ kalyāṇī naṃdaretasā ..
labha janma mahāmāye sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi .. 126 ..
4.6.d:
उदरे च यशोदायाः कल्याणी नंदरेतसा ॥
लभ जन्म महामाये सृष्टिसंहारकारिणि ॥ 126 ॥

4.6.s:
grāme grāme ca pūjāṃ te kārayiṣyāmi bhūtale ..
kṛtsne mahītale bhaktyā nagareṣu vaneṣu ca .. 127 ..
4.6.d:
ग्रामे ग्रामे च पूजां ते कारयिष्यामि भूतले ॥
कृत्स्ने महीतले भक्त्या नगरेषु वनेषु च ॥ 127 ॥

4.6.s:
tatrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
dravyairnānāvidhairdivyairbalibhiśca mudā'nvitāḥ .. 128 ..
4.6.d:
तत्राधिष्ठातृदेवीं त्वां पूजयिष्यंति मानवाः ॥
द्रव्यैर्नानाविधैर्दिव्यैर्बलिभिश्च मुदाऽन्विताः ॥ 128 ॥

4.6.s:
tvadbhūmisparśamātreṇa sūtikāmaṃdire śive ..
pitā māṃ tatra saṃsthāpya tvāmādāya gamiṣyati .. 129 ..
4.6.d:
त्वद्भूमिस्पर्शमात्रेण सूतिकामंदिरे शिवे ॥
पिता मां तत्र संस्थाप्य त्वामादाय गमिष्यति ॥ 129 ॥
4.6.m:
my father will place me there and take you away.
Upon merely seeing Kaṃsa, you will depart to the side of Śiva. / Having relieved the earth’s burden, I shall return to my own abode."
Having spoken thus, Śrī Hari swiftly addressed the six-faced [Kārttikeya]: / "My child, you shall go to the earth in the form of a portion.
Take birth in the womb of Jāmbavatī, O lord of the gods. / Let all the gods go to the earth in their portions.
I shall certainly remove the burden of the earth." / Having spoken thus, the Lord of Rādhikā remained upon his excellent throne.
The gods and goddesses, cowherds and milkmaids remained, O Nārada. / At that moment, Brahmā stood up before Hari
and, joining his hands, humbly spoke to the beloved of the universe:
Brahmā said:
"Attend, O all-pervading Lord, to the petition of your servant!
Give the command, O highly fortunate one: whose place on earth shall be where? / The master is always the protector, the savior, and the lord of his servants.
He is the servant and the eternal devotee who carries out the Lord's command. / Which gods with what form, and which goddesses with which part,
and where is each to have their domain and purpose on the earth?" / Hearing the words of Brahmā, the Lord of the universe replied:
"Where each has their proper place, that I shall explain in accordance with the rule."
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
"Kāmadeva shall be the son of Rukmiṇī, and the virtuous Rati shall be Māyāvatī,
who dwelt in the house of Śambara in the form of a shadow. / You [Brahmā] shall be his son, named Aniruddha.
Bhāratī [Sarasvatī] shall be the daughter of Bāṇa in the city of Śoṇitapura. / Ananta, the Lord of the universe, [shall appear] from the womb of Devakī as the son of Rohiṇī;
because of his extraction from the womb through divine illusion, the lord shall be named Saṃkarṣaṇa. / Kālindī is the daughter of the sun, and on earth [she appears] as a portion of Gaṅgā.
Tulasī [shall appear] as a half-portion, and Lakṣmaṇā is a princess.

4.6.s:
kaṃsadarśana mātreṇa gamiṣyasi śivāṃtikam ..
bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi svamāśramam .. 4.6.130 ..
4.6.d:
कंसदर्शन मात्रेण गमिष्यसि शिवांतिकम् ॥
भारावतरणं कृत्वा गमिष्यामि स्वमाश्रमम् ॥ 4.6.130 ॥

4.6.s:
ityuktvā śrīharistūrṇamuvāca ca ṣaḍānanam ..
aṃśarūpeṇa vatsa tvaṃ gamiṣyasi mahītalam .. 131 ..
4.6.d:
इत्युक्त्वा श्रीहरिस्तूर्णमुवाच च षडाननम् ॥
अंशरूपेण वत्स त्वं गमिष्यसि महीतलम् ॥ 131 ॥

4.6.s:
jāṃbavatyāśca garbhe ca labha janma sureśvara ..
aṃśena devatāḥ sarvā gacchaṃtu dharaṇītalam .. 132 ..
4.6.d:
जांबवत्याश्च गर्भे च लभ जन्म सुरेश्वर ॥
अंशेन देवताः सर्वा गच्छंतु धरणीतलम् ॥ 132 ॥

4.6.s:
bhārahāraṃ kariṣyāmi vasudhāyāśca niścitam ..
ityuktvā rādhikānāthastasthau siṃhāsane vare .. 133 ..
4.6.d:
भारहारं करिष्यामि वसुधायाश्च निश्चितम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा राधिकानाथस्तस्थौ सिंहासने वरे ॥ 133 ॥

4.6.s:
tasthurdevāśca devyaśca gopā gopyaśca nārada ..
etasminnaṃtare brahmā samuttasthau hareḥ puraḥ ..
puṭāṃjalirjagatkāṃtamuvāca vina yānvitaḥ .. 134 ..
4.6.d:
तस्थुर्देवाश्च देव्यश्च गोपा गोप्यश्च नारद ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा समुत्तस्थौ हरेः पुरः ॥
पुटांजलिर्जगत्कांतमुवाच विन यान्वितः ॥ 134 ॥

4.6.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
avadhānaṃ kuru vibho kiṃkarasya nivedanam .. 135 ..
4.6.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
अवधानं कुरु विभो किंकरस्य निवेदनम् ॥ 135 ॥

4.6.s:
ājñāṃ kuru mahābhāga kasya kutra sthalaṃ bhuvi ..
bhartā pātoddhārakartā sevakānāṃ prabhuḥ sadā .. 136 ..
4.6.d:
आज्ञां कुरु महाभाग कस्य कुत्र स्थलं भुवि ॥
भर्ता पातोद्धारकर्ता सेवकानां प्रभुः सदा ॥ 136 ॥

4.6.s:
sa bhṛtyaḥ sarvadā bhakta īśvarājñāṃ karoti yaḥ ..
ke devāḥ kena rūpeṇa devyaśca kalayā kayā .. 137 ..
4.6.d:
स भृत्यः सर्वदा भक्त ईश्वराज्ञां करोति यः ॥
के देवाः केन रूपेण देव्यश्च कलया कया ॥ 137 ॥

4.6.s:
kutra kasyābhideyaṃ ca viṣayaṃ ca mahītale ..
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca jagatpatiḥ .. 138 ..
4.6.d:
कुत्र कस्याभिदेयं च विषयं च महीतले ॥
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच जगत्पतिः ॥ 138 ॥

4.6.s:
yatra yasyāvakāśaṃ ca kathayāmi vidhānataḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kāmadevo raukmiṇeyo ratirmāyāvatī satī .. 139 ..
4.6.d:
यत्र यस्यावकाशं च कथयामि विधानतः ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कामदेवो रौक्मिणेयो रतिर्मायावती सती ॥ 139 ॥

4.6.s:
śaṃbarasya gṛhe yā ca chāyārūpeṇa saṃsthitā ..
tvaṃ tasya putro bhavitā nāmnā'niruddha eva ca .. 4.6.140 ..
4.6.d:
शंबरस्य गृहे या च छायारूपेण संस्थिता ॥
त्वं तस्य पुत्रो भविता नाम्नाऽनिरुद्ध एव च ॥ 4.6.140 ॥

4.6.s:
bhāratī śoṇitapure bāṇaputrī bhaviṣyati ..
anaṃto devakīgarbhādrauhiṇeyo jagatpatiḥ .. 141 ..
4.6.d:
भारती शोणितपुरे बाणपुत्री भविष्यति ॥
अनंतो देवकीगर्भाद्रौहिणेयो जगत्पतिः ॥ 141 ॥

4.6.s:
māyayā garbhasaṃkarṣānnāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
kāliṃdī sūryatanayā gaṃgāṃśena mahītale .. 142 ..
4.6.d:
मायया गर्भसंकर्षान्नाम्ना संकर्षणः प्रभुः ॥
कालिंदी सूर्यतनया गंगांशेन महीतले ॥ 142 ॥

4.6.s:
arddhāṃśenaiva tulasī lakṣmaṇā rāja kanyakā ..
sāvitrī vedamātā ca nāmnā nāgnajitī satī .. 143 ..
4.6.d:
अर्द्धांशेनैव तुलसी लक्ष्मणा राज कन्यका ॥
सावित्री वेदमाता च नाम्ना नाग्नजिती सती ॥ 143 ॥

4.6.s:
vasuṃdharā satyabhāmā śaibyā devī sarasvatī ..
rohiṇī mitraviṃdā ca bhavitā rājakanyakā .. 144 ..
4.6.d:
वसुंधरा सत्यभामा शैब्या देवी सरस्वती ॥
रोहिणी मित्रविंदा च भविता राजकन्यका ॥ 144 ॥

4.6.s:
sūryapatnī ratnamālā kalayā ca jagatprabhoḥ ..
svāhāṃśena suśīlā ca rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyo nava .. 145 ..
4.6.d:
सूर्यपत्नी रत्नमाला कलया च जगत्प्रभोः ॥
स्वाहांशेन सुशीला च रुक्मिण्याद्याः स्त्रियो नव ॥ 145 ॥

4.6.s:
durgāṃśārddhājjāṃbavatī mahiṣīṇāṃ daśa smṛtāḥ ..
arddhāṃśena śailaputrī yātu jāṃbavato gṛham .. 146 ..
4.6.d:
दुर्गांशार्द्धाज्जांबवती महिषीणां दश स्मृताः ॥
अर्द्धांशेन शैलपुत्री यातु जांबवतो गृहम् ॥ 146 ॥

4.6.s:
kailāse śaṃkarājñā ca babhūva pārvatīṃ purā ..
kailāsagāminaṃ viṣṇuṃ śvetadvīpanivāsinam ..
āliṃganaṃ dehi kāṃte nāsti doṣo mamā jñayā .. 147 ..
4.6.d:
कैलासे शंकराज्ञा च बभूव पार्वतीं पुरा ॥
कैलासगामिनं विष्णुं श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनम् ॥
आलिंगनं देहि कांते नास्ति दोषो ममा ज्ञया ॥ 147 ॥

4.6.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
kathaṃ śivājñā tāṃ devīṃ babhūva rādhikāpate ..
viṣṇoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇe pūrvaṃ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ .. 148 ..
4.6.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
कथं शिवाज्ञा तां देवीं बभूव राधिकापते ॥
विष्णोः संभाषणे पूर्वं श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनः ॥ 148 ॥

4.6.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
purā gaṇeśaṃ draṣṭuṃ ca prajagmuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
śvetadvīpātsvayaṃ viṣṇurjagāma śaṃkarālaye .. 149 ..
4.6.d:
॥ श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा गणेशं द्रष्टुं च प्रजग्मुः सर्वदेवताः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपात्स्वयं विष्णुर्जगाम शंकरालये ॥ 149 ॥

4.6.s:
dṛṣṭvā gaṇeśaṃ muditaḥ samuvāsa sukhāsane ..
sukhena dadṛśuḥ sarve trailokyamohanaṃ vapuḥ .. 4.6.150..
4.6.d:
दृष्ट्वा गणेशं मुदितः समुवास सुखासने ॥
सुखेन ददृशुः सर्वे त्रैलोक्यमोहनं वपुः ॥ 4.6.150॥

4.6.s:
kirīṭinaṃ kuṃḍalinaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ varam ..
suṃdaraṃ śyāma rūpaṃ ca navayauvanasaṃyutam .. 151 ..
4.6.d:
किरीटिनं कुंडलिनं पीतांबरधरं वरम् ॥
सुंदरं श्याम रूपं च नवयौवनसंयुतम् ॥ 151 ॥

4.6.s:
caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam ..
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhayaṃ smerānanasaroruham .. 152 ..
4.6.d:
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवसंयुतम् ॥
रत्नालंकारशोभाढयं स्मेराननसरोरुहम् ॥ 152 ॥

4.6.s:
ratna siṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pārṣadaiḥ pariveṣṭitam ..
vaṃditaṃ ca suraiḥ sarvaiḥ śivena pūjitaṃ stutam ..153..
4.6.d:
रत्न सिंहासनस्थं च पार्षदैः परिवेष्टितम् ॥
वंदितं च सुरैः सर्वैः शिवेन पूजितं स्तुतम् ॥153॥

4.6.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatī viṣṇuṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ..
mukhamācchāditaṃ cakre vāsasā vrīḍayā satī ..154..
4.6.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पार्वती विष्णुं प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥
मुखमाच्छादितं चक्रे वाससा व्रीडया सती ॥154॥

4.6.s:
atīva sundaraṃ rūpaṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
dadarśa mukhamācchādya nimeṣarahitā satī .. 159 ..
4.6.d:
अतीव सुन्दरं रूपं दर्शंदर्शं पुनःपुनः ॥
ददर्श मुखमाच्छाद्य निमेषरहिता सती ॥ 159 ॥

4.6.s:
paramādbhutaveṣaṃ ca sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā ..
sukhasāgarasammagnā babhūva pulakāṃcitā ..156..
4.6.d:
परमाद्भुतवेषं च सस्मिता वक्रचक्षुषा ॥
सुखसागरसम्मग्ना बभूव पुलकांचिता ॥156॥

4.6.s:
kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa pañcāsyaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ trilocanam ..
triśūlaparighadharaṃ kandarpakoṭisundaram .. 157 ..
4.6.d:
क्षणं ददर्श पञ्चास्यं शुभ्रवर्णं त्रिलोचनम् ॥
त्रिशूलपरिघधरं कन्दर्पकोटिसुन्दरम् ॥ 157 ॥
4.6.m:
Sāvitrī, the mother of the Vedas, shall be the virtuous lady named Nāgnajitī.
Vasundharā [shall be] Satyabhāmā, and the goddess Sarasvatī shall be Śaibyā. / Rohiṇī and Mitravindā shall be princesses.
Ratnamālā, the wife of the sun, shall be born from a part of the Lord of the universe, / and Suśīlā from a portion of Svāhā. Rukmiṇī and the others make nine wives;
from a half-portion of Durgā comes Jāmbavatī—these are remembered as the ten principal queens. / Let the daughter of the mountain [Durgā] go to the house of Jāmbavat with a half-portion.
Long ago in Kailāsa, an instruction came from Śaṅkara to Pārvatī / [concerning] Viṣṇu, dweller in Śvetadvīpa, who had come to Kailāsa: / 'Embrace him, my beloved; there is no fault by my command.'"
Brahmā said:
"How did that instruction of Śiva come to the goddess, O Lord of Rādhikā, / previously concerning conversation with Viṣṇu, who dwells in Śvetadvīpa?"
The Blessed Lord said:
"Long ago, all the gods went to see Gaṇeśa. / Viṣṇu himself went from Śvetadvīpa to the abode of Śaṅkara.
Having seen Gaṇeśa, he sat down rejoicing upon a comfortable seat. / With delight, everyone beheld his form that enchants the three worlds:
wearing a diadem and earrings, clad in an excellent yellow garment, / lovely, dark in complexion, endowed with fresh youth,
anointed with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and liquid saffron, / adorned with the splendour of jewelled ornaments, his lotus face smiling,
seated upon a jewelled throne and surrounded by his attendants, / saluted by all the gods, worshipped and praised by Śiva.
Seeing that Viṣṇu, Pārvatī, with a joyful face and eyes, / covered her face with her garment out of modesty, O virtuous lady.
Looking again and again at that exceedingly handsome form, / the chaste lady, covering her face, gazed without blinking,
smiling, with a sideways glance at that supremely wondrous form; / plunged into an ocean of bliss, her hair stood on end.
For a moment she looked at the five-faced, white-complexioned, three-eyed [Śiva]...
