holding a trident and an iron bludgeon, handsome as tens of millions of Kamas. / For an instant she saw him dark-hued, with one face and two eyes, / with four arms, clad in yellow garments, adorned with a garland of forest flowers. / Whether established as one Brahman with distinction of forms or without distinction, / seeing him, she became filled with desire through Viṣṇu's māyā. / 'The three gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, are my portions; / and through superior excellence over the other two, he who is made of the quality of sattva is supreme.' / Seeing him with devotion, her body bristling with horripilation, / Pārvatī worshipped the Paramātman, the Lord, in her mind. / And Śaṅkara himself understood Durgā's inner intention, / being the inner self of all, the Blessed Lord, the Inner Ruler, the master of the universe. / Calling Durgā into solitude, Hara spoke to her himself; / he instructed her in various ways, with beneficial, true, and unassailable words. / Śrī Śaṅkara said: / Hear my petition, O daughter of the mountain: / give erotic delight to Hari, the Paramātman; may it be well with you! / I, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu are the one eternal Brahman; / being one without division, he possesses diversity of forms according to functions. / You are the one Prakṛti, the mother of all, having all forms; / you are speech in Svayambhū; you are Lakṣmī on Nārāyaṇa's chest; / you are Durgā upon my chest. Understand the spiritual truth, O virtuous woman! / Having heard Śiva's words, the queen of the gods said to him: / Pārvatī said: / O friend of the poor, O ocean of compassion, why is there no compassion from you toward me? / You, the lord of the worlds, were obtained by me after long penance as my husband. / O lord, you ought not to abandon a handmaid such as me! / Speak not, speak not such unfitting words, O Maheśvara! / I will certainly obey your command, O Mahādeva: / having obtained birth in another body, I shall worship Hari, O Hara! / Having heard these words, Maheśvara fell silent.

4.6.s:
kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa śyāmaṃ tamekāsyaṃ ca dvilocanam ..
caturbhujaṃ pītavastraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam .. 158 ..
4.6.d:
क्षणं ददर्श श्यामं तमेकास्यं च द्विलोचनम् ॥
चतुर्भुजं पीतवस्त्रं वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥ 158 ॥

4.6.s:
ekaṃ bahma mūrtibhedamabhedaṃ vā nirūpitam ..
dṛṣṭvā babhūva sā māyā sakāmā viṣṇu māyayā .. 159 ..
4.6.d:
एकं बह्म मूर्तिभेदमभेदं वा निरूपितम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा बभूव सा माया सकामा विष्णु मायया ॥ 159 ॥

4.6.s:
madaṃśāśca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
tābhyāmautkarṣapātācca śreṣṭhaḥ sattvaguṇātmakaḥ .. 4.6.160 ..
4.6.d:
मदंशाश्च त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥
ताभ्यामौत्कर्षपाताच्च श्रेष्ठः सत्त्वगुणात्मकः ॥ 4.6.160 ॥

4.6.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ pārvatī bhaktyā pulakāṃcitavigrahā..
manasā pūjayāmāsa paramātmānamīśvaram .. 161 ..
4.6.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं पार्वती भक्त्या पुलकांचितविग्रहा॥
मनसा पूजयामास परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ॥ 161 ॥

4.6.s:
durgāṃtarābhiprāyaṃ ca bubudhe śaṃkaraḥ svayam ..
sarvāṃtarātmā bhagavānaṃtaryāmī jagatpatiḥ .. 162 ..
4.6.d:
दुर्गांतराभिप्रायं च बुबुधे शंकरः स्वयम् ॥
सर्वांतरात्मा भगवानंतर्यामी जगत्पतिः ॥ 162 ॥

4.6.s:
durgāṃ nirjanamāhūya tāmuvāca haraḥ svayam ..
bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ hitaṃ tathyamakhaṃḍitam .. 163 ..
4.6.d:
दुर्गां निर्जनमाहूय तामुवाच हरः स्वयम् ॥
बोधयामास विविधं हितं तथ्यमखंडितम् ॥ 163 ॥

4.6.s:
.. śrīśaṃkara uvāca .. ..
nivedanaṃ madīyaṃ ca nibodhaṃ śailakanyake ..
śṛṃgāraṃ dehi bhadraṃ te haraye paramātmane .. 154 ..
4.6.d:
॥ श्रीशंकर उवाच ॥ ॥
निवेदनं मदीयं च निबोधं शैलकन्यके ॥
शृंगारं देहि भद्रं ते हरये परमात्मने ॥ 154 ॥

4.6.s:
ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca brahmaikaṃ ca sanātanam ..
vadaiko vedarahito viṣayānmūrtibhedakaḥ .. 165 ..
4.6.d:
अहं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च ब्रह्मैकं च सनातनम् ॥
वदैको वेदरहितो विषयान्मूर्तिभेदकः ॥ 165 ॥

4.6.s:
ekā prakṛtiḥ sarveṣāṃ mātā tvaṃ sarvarūpiṇī ..
svayaṃbhūrasi vāṇī tva lakṣmīrnārāyaṇorasi .. 166 ..
4.6.d:
एका प्रकृतिः सर्वेषां माता त्वं सर्वरूपिणी ॥
स्वयंभूरसि वाणी त्व लक्ष्मीर्नारायणोरसि ॥ 166 ॥

4.6.s:
mama vakṣasi durgā tvaṃ nibodhādhyātmakaṃ sati ..
śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca sureśvarī .. 167 ..
4.6.d:
मम वक्षसि दुर्गा त्वं निबोधाध्यात्मकं सति ॥
शिवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तमुवाच सुरेश्वरी ॥ 167 ॥

4.6.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
dīnabaṃdho kṛpāsiṃdho tava māmakṛpā katham..
suciraṃ tapasā labdho nāthastvaṃ jagatāṃ mayā .. 168 ..
4.6.d:
॥ पार्वत्युवाच ॥ ॥
दीनबंधो कृपासिंधो तव मामकृपा कथम्॥
सुचिरं तपसा लब्धो नाथस्त्वं जगतां मया ॥ 168 ॥

4.6.s:
mādṛśīṃ kiṃkarī nātha na parityaktumarhasi ..
ayogyamīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ mā mā vada maheśvara .. 169 ..
4.6.d:
मादृशीं किंकरी नाथ न परित्यक्तुमर्हसि ॥
अयोग्यमीदृशं वाक्यं मा मा वद महेश्वर ॥ 169 ॥

4.6.s:
tava vākyaṃ mahādeva kariṣyāmyeva pālanam ..
dehāṃtare janma labdhvā bhajiṣyāmi hariṃ hara .. 4.6.170 ..
4.6.d:
तव वाक्यं महादेव करिष्याम्येव पालनम् ॥
देहांतरे जन्म लब्ध्वा भजिष्यामि हरिं हर ॥ 4.6.170 ॥

4.6.s:
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā virarāma maheśvaraḥ ..
uccairjahāsābhayadaḥ pārvatyai cābhayaṃ dadau .. 171 ..
4.6.d:
इत्येवं वचनं श्रुत्वा विरराम महेश्वरः ॥
उच्चैर्जहासाभयदः पार्वत्यै चाभयं ददौ ॥ 171 ॥
4.6.m: Loudly he laughed, he who grants fearlessness, and gave reassurance to Pārvatī. / To fulfill that promise, Pārvatī in the house of Jāmbavat / will obtain birth, O creator, as the chaste woman named Jāmbavatī. / Brahmā said: / When there were kings of so many kinds on earth, why did Pārvatī / take birth in Bhārata in the censured house of a bear? / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the Rāma incarnation, in the Tretā age, portions of the gods went to earth. / A servant named Jāmbavat was a bear who was a portion of Himālaya; / by the granting of a boon from Rāma, he was long-lived and endowed with prosperity, / and of great strength, possessing the strength of ten million lions. / In the house of her father's portion, Durgā went by her portion to the surface of the earth. / The story of what happened before has been told; now hear from my mouth: / Let the lines of all the gods go to the surface of the earth; / sons of kings, they will be my helpers in battle, O creator. / Let all the daughters of kings be born by a part of Kamalā; / they will be my sixteen thousand queens. / This Dharma, in the form of a portion, is Yudhiṣṭhira, the son of Pāṇḍu; / Bhīmasena is from a portion of Vāyu; and Arjuna is the Wielder of the Thunderbolt himself. / Nakula and Sahadeva are born from portions of the two heavenly physicians; / the hero Karṇa is a portion of Sūrya; Vidura is Yama himself. / Duryodhana is a portion of Kali; and Śantanu is a portion of the Ocean. / Aśvatthāman is a portion of Śaṅkara; Droṇa is born from a portion of Agni; / the mighty, blessed Dhṛṣṭadyumna is a portion of the Fire God; / Abhimanyu is a portion of Candra; and Bhīṣma is born of a Vasu. / Vasudeva is a portion of Kaśyapa, and Devakī is a portion of Aditi; / Nanda the cowherd is a portion of a Vasu, and Yaśodā is the Vasu's wife. / Draupadī is a portion of Kamalā, born from the sacrificial pit; / Subhadrā is a portion of Śatarūpā, born from the womb of Devakī. / Let the gods go to the earth by their portions to remove the burden;

4.6.s:
tatpratijñāpālanāya pārvatī jāṃbavadgṛhe ..
labhiṣyati janurdhātarnāmnā jāṃbavatī satī .. 172 ..
4.6.d:
तत्प्रतिज्ञापालनाय पार्वती जांबवद्गृहे ॥
लभिष्यति जनुर्धातर्नाम्ना जांबवती सती ॥ 172 ॥

4.6.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhūmau katividhe bhūpe saṃsthite pārvatī katham ..
lalābha bhārate janma niṃdite bhālluke gṛhe ..173..
4.6.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
भूमौ कतिविधे भूपे संस्थिते पार्वती कथम् ॥
ललाभ भारते जन्म निंदिते भाल्लुके गृहे ॥173॥

4.6.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rāmāvatāre tretāyāṃ devāṃśāśca yayurmahīm ..
himālayāṃśo bhallūko jāṃbavānnāma kiṃkaraḥ .. 174 ..
4.6.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
रामावतारे त्रेतायां देवांशाश्च ययुर्महीम् ॥
हिमालयांशो भल्लूको जांबवान्नाम किंकरः ॥ 174 ॥

4.6.s:
rāmasya varadānena ciraṃjīvī śriyā yutaḥ ..
koṭisiṃhabalādhānaṃ vidhatte ca mahābalaḥ .. 175 ..
4.6.d:
रामस्य वरदानेन चिरंजीवी श्रिया युतः ॥
कोटिसिंहबलाधानं विधत्ते च महाबलः ॥ 175 ॥

4.6.s:
pituraṃśagṛhe durgā jagāmāṃśena bhūtalam ..
pūrvaṃ pūrvasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathitaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt .. 175 ..
4.6.d:
पितुरंशगृहे दुर्गा जगामांशेन भूतलम् ॥
पूर्वं पूर्वस्य वृत्तांतं कथितं शृणु मन्मुखात् ॥ 175 ॥

4.6.s:
sarveṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ vai vaṃśā gacchaṃtu bhūtalam ..
nṛpaputrā matsahāyā bhaviṣyaṃti raṇe vidhe .. 177 ..
4.6.d:
सर्वेषां च सुराणां वै वंशा गच्छंतु भूतलम् ॥
नृपपुत्रा मत्सहाया भविष्यंति रणे विधे ॥ 177 ॥

4.6.s:
kamalākalayā sarvā bhavaṃtu nṛpakanyakāḥ ..
manmahiṣyo bhaviṣyaṃti sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa .. 178 ..
4.6.d:
कमलाकलया सर्वा भवंतु नृपकन्यकाः ॥
मन्महिष्यो भविष्यंति सहस्राणां च षोडश ॥ 178 ॥

4.6.s:
dharmo'yamaṃśarūpeṇa pāṃḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ..
vāyoraṃśādbhīmasenaḥ sa vajrī hyarjunaḥ svayam .. 179 ..
4.6.d:
धर्मोऽयमंशरूपेण पांडुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥
वायोरंशाद्भीमसेनः स वज्री ह्यर्जुनः स्वयम् ॥ 179 ॥

4.6.s:
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca svarvaidyāṃśasamudbhavau .
sṛryāṃśaḥ karṇavīraśca viduraḥ sa yamaḥ svayam .. 4.6.180 ..
4.6.d:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च स्वर्वैद्यांशसमुद्भवौ ।
सृर्यांशः कर्णवीरश्च विदुरः स यमः स्वयम् ॥ 4.6.180 ॥

4.6.s:
duryodhanaḥ kaleraṃśaḥ samudrāṃśaśca śaṃtanuḥ ..
aśvatthāmā śaṃkarāṃśo droṇo vahnyaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 181 ..
4.6.d:
दुर्योधनः कलेरंशः समुद्रांशश्च शंतनुः ॥
अश्वत्थामा शंकरांशो द्रोणो वह्न्यंशसंभवः ॥ 181 ॥

4.6.s:
hutāśanāṃśo bhagavāndhṛṣṭadyumno mahābalaḥ ..
caṃdrāṃśo'pyabhimanyuśca bhīṣmaścaiva vasūdbhavaḥ .. 182 ..
4.6.d:
हुताशनांशो भगवान्धृष्टद्युम्नो महाबलः ॥
चंद्रांशोऽप्यभिमन्युश्च भीष्मश्चैव वसूद्भवः ॥ 182 ॥

4.6.s:
vasudevaḥ kaśyapāṃśo'pyadityaṃśā ca devakī ..
vasvaṃśo naṃdagopaśca yaśodā vasukā minī .. 183 ..
4.6.d:
वसुदेवः कश्यपांशोऽप्यदित्यंशा च देवकी ॥
वस्वंशो नंदगोपश्च यशोदा वसुका मिनी ॥ 183 ॥

4.6.s:
draupadī kamalāṃśā ca yajñakuṃḍasamudbhavā ..
subhadrā śatarūpāṃśā devakīgarbhasaṃbhavā ..184..
4.6.d:
द्रौपदी कमलांशा च यज्ञकुंडसमुद्भवा ॥
सुभद्रा शतरूपांशा देवकीगर्भसंभवा ॥184॥

4.6.s:
devā gacchaṃtu pṛthivīmaṃśena bhārahārakāḥ ..
kalayā devapatnyaśca gacchaṃtu pṛthivītalam .. 185 ..
4.6.d:
देवा गच्छंतु पृथिवीमंशेन भारहारकाः ॥
कलया देवपत्न्यश्च गच्छंतु पृथिवीतलम् ॥ 185 ॥
4.6.m: and let the wives of the gods go to the surface of the earth by their parts. / Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord fell silent, O Nārada. / Having heard the entire account, Prajāpati remained seated there. / To Kṛṣṇa's left stood the goddess of speech, to his right Lakṣmī; / before him stood all the deities, and also Pārvatī, O Nārada; / all around were the cowherds and cowherd girls, and Rādhā was situated on his chest. / In the meantime, she, the sovereign of Vraja, spoke to him: / Rādhikā said: / Listen, O lord; I will speak the words of your servant, O master! / My vital breaths continually burn; my mind wavers. / I am unable to shut my eyes while gazing upon you; / without you, O lord, how shall I go to the surface of the earth? / After how long a time will there be my reunion with you / in Gokula? Tell me the truth, O lord of my life! / A moment without you will be a hundred cosmic ages for me. / Whom shall I see? Where shall I go? Or who will protect me? / Mother, father, kinsman, brother, sister, son— / without you, O lord of my life, I consider none of these. / If you cause me to be veiled by māyā on the surface of the earth, O Lord of Māyā, / having given me wealth while I have forgotten you, swear an oath to me in truth: / at every instant, let the bee of my mind, O Madhusūdana, / wander continually upon your lotus feet, which are filled with sweet nectar! / Wherever and in whatever womb this birth may be, / you must grant me the desired recollection of yourself and your service! / You are Kṛṣṇa, and I am Rādhikā—grant me the supreme boon / that I do not forget our love and our good fortune on earth! / Just as the vital breaths go with the body, just as the body goes with its shadow, / so may our lives proceed; grant me this boon, O all-pervading Lord! / Let there be not even the parting of a wink of an eye for the two of us on earth!

4.6.s:
ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca nārada ..
sarvaṃ vivaraṇaṃ śrutvā tatrovāsa prajāpatiḥ ..186..
4.6.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान्विरराम च नारद ॥
सर्वं विवरणं श्रुत्वा तत्रोवास प्रजापतिः ॥186॥

4.6.s:
kṛṣṇasya vāme vāgdevī dakṣiṇe kamalālayā ..
purato devatāḥ sarvāḥ pārvatī cāpi nārada .. 187 ..
4.6.d:
कृष्णस्य वामे वाग्देवी दक्षिणे कमलालया ॥
पुरतो देवताः सर्वाः पार्वती चापि नारद ॥ 187 ॥

4.6.s:
gopyo gopāśca parito rādhā vakṣaḥsthalasthitā ..
etasminnaṃtare sā ca tamuvāca vrajeśvarī ..188..
4.6.d:
गोप्यो गोपाश्च परितो राधा वक्षःस्थलस्थिता ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सा च तमुवाच व्रजेश्वरी ॥188॥

4.6.s:
.. rādhikovāca ..
śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi kiṃkarīvacanaṃ prabho ..
prāṇā dahaṃti satatamāṃdolayati me manaḥ .. 189 ..
4.6.d:
॥ राधिकोवाच ॥
शृणु नाथ प्रवक्ष्यामि किंकरीवचनं प्रभो ॥
प्राणा दहंति सततमांदोलयति मे मनः ॥ 189 ॥

4.6.s:
cakṣurnimīlanaṃ kartumaśaktā tava darśane ..
tvayā vinā kathaṃ nātha yāsyāmi dharaṇītalam .. 4.6.190 ..
4.6.d:
चक्षुर्निमीलनं कर्तुमशक्ता तव दर्शने ॥
त्वया विना कथं नाथ यास्यामि धरणीतलम् ॥ 4.6.190 ॥

4.6.s:
kiyatkālāṃtareṇaiva melanaṃ me tvayā saha ..
prāṇeśvara brūhi satyaṃ bhaviṣyatyeva gokule .. 191 ..
4.6.d:
कियत्कालांतरेणैव मेलनं मे त्वया सह ॥
प्राणेश्वर ब्रूहि सत्यं भविष्यत्येव गोकुले ॥ 191 ॥

4.6.s:
nimeṣaṃ ca yugaśataṃ bhavitā me tvayā vinā ..
kaṃ drakṣyāmi kva yāsyāmi ko vā māṃ pālayiṣyati .. 192 ..
4.6.d:
निमेषं च युगशतं भविता मे त्वया विना ॥
कं द्रक्ष्यामि क्व यास्यामि को वा मां पालयिष्यति ॥ 192 ॥

4.6.s:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ baṃdhuṃ bhrātaraṃ bhaginīṃ sutam ..
tvayā vinā'haṃ prāṇeśa ciṃtayāmi na kaścana .. 193 ..
4.6.d:
मातरं पितरं बंधुं भ्रातरं भगिनीं सुतम् ॥
त्वया विनाऽहं प्राणेश चिंतयामि न कश्चन ॥ 193 ॥

4.6.s:
karoṣi māyayā channā māṃ cenmāyeśa bhūtale ..
vismṛtāṃ vibhavaṃ dattvā me satyaṃ śapathaṃ kuru .. 194 ..
4.6.d:
करोषि मायया छन्ना मां चेन्मायेश भूतले ॥
विस्मृतां विभवं दत्त्वा मे सत्यं शपथं कुरु ॥ 194 ॥

4.6.s:
anukṣaṇaṃ mama manomadhupo madhusūdana ..
karotu bhramaṇaṃ nityaṃ samādhvīke padāṃbuje .. 195 ..
4.6.d:
अनुक्षणं मम मनोमधुपो मधुसूदन ॥
करोतु भ्रमणं नित्यं समाध्वीके पदांबुजे ॥ 195 ॥

4.6.s:
yatrayatra ca yasyāṃ vā yonau janma bhavatvidam ..
tvaṃ svasya smaraṇaṃ dāsyaṃ mahyaṃ dāsyasi vāṃchitam .. 196 ..
4.6.d:
यत्रयत्र च यस्यां वा योनौ जन्म भवत्विदम् ॥
त्वं स्वस्य स्मरणं दास्यं मह्यं दास्यसि वांछितम् ॥ 196 ॥

4.6.s:
kṛṣṇastvaṃ rādhikā'haṃ ca premasaubhāgyamāvayoḥ ..
na vismarāmi bhūmau ca dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ param .. 197 ..
4.6.d:
कृष्णस्त्वं राधिकाऽहं च प्रेमसौभाग्यमावयोः ॥
न विस्मरामि भूमौ च देहि मह्यं वरं परम् ॥ 197 ॥

4.6.s:
yathā tanvā saha prāṇāḥ śarīraṃ chāyayā saha ..
tathā''vayorjanma yātu dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ vibho .. 198 ..
4.6.d:
यथा तन्वा सह प्राणाः शरीरं छायया सह ॥
तथा'ऽवयोर्जन्म यातु देहि मह्यं वरं विभो ॥ 198 ॥

4.6.s:
cakṣurnimeṣavicchedo bhavitā nāvayorbhuvi ..
tatrāgatyāpi kutrāpi dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ prabho .. 199 ..
4.6.d:
चक्षुर्निमेषविच्छेदो भविता नावयोर्भुवि ॥
तत्रागत्यापि कुत्रापि देहि मह्यं वरं प्रभो ॥ 199 ॥
4.6.m: Grant me a boon, O Lord, even after going there anywhere! / By whom was your body made with my life-breaths, O merciful Hari? / Were the flute and feet fashioned by your own self, or by the mind? / How many kinds of women or men are there, O you praised by many? / Nowhere is there a beloved like me in beauty and in power. / By whom was I fashioned from half of your body? / This alone is the distinction between us; therefore my mind is set upon you. / Just as my self, mind, and life-breaths are situated in you, / so your self, mind, and life-breaths are situated in me. / Therefore, from a moment's separation, the mind of both of us becomes perturbed; / my life-breaths continually burn, tormented at hearing of separation! / Having spoken thus, that goddess right there in the assembly of the gods / wept again and again aloud, holding his lotus feet. / Taking her on his lap and wiping her face with his cloth, / Kṛṣṇa enlightened her with manifold words that were true, fitting, and beneficial. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The supreme spiritual yoga that destroys sorrow, / hear, O goddess, I shall declare—difficult even for the lords of yogis to obtain. / Behold the entire cosmic egg, O beautiful one, in terms of container and contained: / without a container, the contained cannot exist. / The fruit's container is the flower, and the flower's container is the sprout; / the branch is the container of the sprout, and the tree itself is the container of the branch. / The shoot endowed with the vital power of life is the container of the tree; / the seed is the container of the solitary shoot, and the earth is the container of the seed. / Śeṣa is the container of the earth, and the tortoise is the container of Śeṣa; / the wind is the container of the tortoise, and I myself am the container of the wind. / You are the embodiment of my support; I abide in you now. / You are the aggregate of all powers, the primordial Prakṛti, the sovereign ruler. / You are the nature of the body, the embodiment of the container of the three gunas.

4.6.s:
mama prāṇaistava tanuḥ kena vā karuṇā hare ..
ātmanā muralīpādau manasā vā vinirmitau .. 4.6.200 ..
4.6.d:
मम प्राणैस्तव तनुः केन वा करुणा हरे ॥
आत्मना मुरलीपादौ मनसा वा विनिर्मितौ ॥ 4.6.200 ॥

4.6.s:
striyaḥ katividhāḥ saṃti puruṣā vā puruṣṭuta ..
nāsti kutrāpi kāṃtā vā kāṃtyā śaktyā ca mādṛśī .. 201 ..
4.6.d:
स्त्रियः कतिविधाः संति पुरुषा वा पुरुष्टुत ॥
नास्ति कुत्रापि कांता वा कांत्या शक्त्या च मादृशी ॥ 201 ॥

4.6.s:
tava dehārdhabhāgena kena vā'haṃ vinirmitā ..
ayamevāvayorbhedo nāstyatastvayi me manaḥ .. 202 ..
4.6.d:
तव देहार्धभागेन केन वाऽहं विनिर्मिता ॥
अयमेवावयोर्भेदो नास्त्यतस्त्वयि मे मनः ॥ 202 ॥

4.6.s:
mamātmā mānasaṃ prāṇāstvayi saṃsthāpitā yathā ..
tavātmamānasaprāṇā mayi vā saṃsthitāstathā ..203..
4.6.d:
ममात्मा मानसं प्राणास्त्वयि संस्थापिता यथा ॥
तवात्ममानसप्राणा मयि वा संस्थितास्तथा ॥203॥

4.6.s:
ato nimeṣavirahādātmanorviklavaṃ manaḥ ..
pradagdhaṃ santataṃ prāṇā dahaṃti virahaśrutau .. 204 ..
4.6.d:
अतो निमेषविरहादात्मनोर्विक्लवं मनः ॥
प्रदग्धं सन्ततं प्राणा दहंति विरहश्रुतौ ॥ 204 ॥

4.6.s:
ityevamuktvā sā devī tatraiva surasaṃsadi..
bhūyobhūyo rurodoccairdhṛtvā taccaraṇāṃbujam .. 205..
4.6.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा देवी तत्रैव सुरसंसदि॥
भूयोभूयो रुरोदोच्चैर्धृत्वा तच्चरणांबुजम् ॥ 205॥

4.6.s:
kroḍe kṛtvā tu tāṃ kṛṣṇo mukhaṃ saṃmṛjya vāsasā ..
bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ satyaṃ tathyaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ .. 206 ..
4.6.d:
क्रोडे कृत्वा तु तां कृष्णो मुखं संमृज्य वाससा ॥
बोधयामास विविधं सत्यं तथ्यं हितं वचः ॥ 206 ॥

4.6.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
ādhyātmikaṃ paraṃ yogaṃ śokacchedanakārakam ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yogīṃdrāṇāṃ ca durlabham .. 207 ..
4.6.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
आध्यात्मिकं परं योगं शोकच्छेदनकारकम् ॥
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि योगींद्राणां च दुर्लभम् ॥ 207 ॥

4.6.s:
ādhārādheyayoḥ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ paśya sundari ..
ādhāravyatirekeṇa nāstyādheyasya saṃbhavaḥ .. .. 208 ..
4.6.d:
आधाराधेययोः सर्वं ब्रह्मांडं पश्य सुन्दरि ॥
आधारव्यतिरेकेण नास्त्याधेयस्य संभवः ॥ ॥ 208 ॥

4.6.s:
phalādhāraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca puṣpādhāraṃ ca pallavam ..
skandhaśca pallavādhāraḥ skandhādhārastaruḥ svayam .. 209 ..
4.6.d:
फलाधारं च पुष्पं च पुष्पाधारं च पल्लवम् ॥
स्कन्धश्च पल्लवाधारः स्कन्धाधारस्तरुः स्वयम् ॥ 209 ॥

4.6.s:
vṛkṣādhāro 'pyaṃkuraśca jīvaśaktisamanvitaḥ ..
aṣṭirekāṃkurādhāraścāṣṭyādhāro vasundharā .. 4.6.210 ..
4.6.d:
वृक्षाधारो ऽप्यंकुरश्च जीवशक्तिसमन्वितः ॥
अष्टिरेकांकुराधारश्चाष्ट्याधारो वसुन्धरा ॥ 4.6.210 ॥

4.6.s:
śeṣo vasundharādhāraḥ śeṣādhāro hi kacchapaḥ..
vāyuśca kacchapādhāro vāyvādhāro'hameva ca .. 211 ..
4.6.d:
शेषो वसुन्धराधारः शेषाधारो हि कच्छपः॥
वायुश्च कच्छपाधारो वाय्वाधारोऽहमेव च ॥ 211 ॥

4.6.s:
mamādhārasvarūpā tvaṃ tvayi tiṣṭhāmi sāṃpratam ..
tvaṃ ca śaktisamūhā ca mūlaprakṛ tirīśvarī .. 212 ..
4.6.d:
ममाधारस्वरूपा त्वं त्वयि तिष्ठामि सांप्रतम् ॥
त्वं च शक्तिसमूहा च मूलप्रकृ तिरीश्वरी ॥ 212 ॥

4.6.s:
tvaṃ śarīrasvarūpā'si triguṇā''dhārarūpiṇī ..
tavātmā'haṃ nirīhaśca ceṣṭāvāṃśca tvayā saha ..213..
4.6.d:
त्वं शरीरस्वरूपाऽसि त्रिगुणा'ऽधाररूपिणी ॥
तवात्माऽहं निरीहश्च चेष्टावांश्च त्वया सह ॥213॥

4.6.s:
puruṣādvīryamutpannaṃ vīryātsantatireva ca ..
tayorādhārarūpā ca kāminī prakṛteḥ kalā .. 214 ..
4.6.d:
पुरुषाद्वीर्यमुत्पन्नं वीर्यात्सन्ततिरेव च ॥
तयोराधाररूपा च कामिनी प्रकृतेः कला ॥ 214 ॥

4.6.s:
vinā dehena kvātmā ca kva śarīraṃ vinā''tmanā..
prādhānyaṃ ca tayordevi vinā tvā'dya kuto bhavaḥ ..215..
4.6.d:
विना देहेन क्वात्मा च क्व शरीरं विना'ऽत्मना॥
प्राधान्यं च तयोर्देवि विना त्वाऽद्य कुतो भवः ॥215॥

4.6.s:
na kutrāpyāvayorbhedo rādhe saṃsārabījayoḥ ..
yatrātmā tatra dehaṃ ca na bhedo vinayena kim .. 216 ..
4.6.d:
न कुत्राप्यावयोर्भेदो राधे संसारबीजयोः ॥
यत्रात्मा तत्र देहं च न भेदो विनयेन किम् ॥ 216 ॥

4.6.s:
yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ dāhikā ca hutāśane ..
bhūmau gandho jale śaityaṃ tathā tvayi mayi sthite .. 217 ..
4.6.d:
यथा क्षीरे च धावल्यं दाहिका च हुताशने ॥
भूमौ गन्धो जले शैत्यं तथा त्वयि मयि स्थिते ॥ 217 ॥

4.6.s:
dhāvalyadugdhayoraikyaṃ dāhikānalayoryathā ..
bhūgandhajalaśaityānāṃ nāsti bhedastathā''vayoḥ .. 218 ..
4.6.d:
धावल्यदुग्धयोरैक्यं दाहिकानलयोर्यथा ॥
भूगन्धजलशैत्यानां नास्ति भेदस्तथा'ऽवयोः ॥ 218 ॥

4.6.s:
mayā vinā tvaṃ nirjīvā cādṛśyo'haṃ tvayā vinā ..
tvayā vinā bhavaṃ kartuṃ nālaṃ sundari niścitam .. 219 ..
4.6.d:
मया विना त्वं निर्जीवा चादृश्योऽहं त्वया विना ॥
त्वया विना भवं कर्तुं नालं सुन्दरि निश्चितम् ॥ 219 ॥

4.6.s:
vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ yathā nālaṃ kulālakaḥ ..
vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro'laṃkāraṃ kartumakṣamaḥ .. 4.6.220 ..
4.6.d:
विना मृदा घटं कर्तुं यथा नालं कुलालकः ॥
विना स्वर्णं स्वर्णकारोऽलंकारं कर्तुमक्षमः ॥ 4.6.220 ॥

4.6.s:
svayamātmā yathā nityastathā tvaṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam ..
sarvaśaktisamāyuktā sarvādhārā sanātanī .. 221 ..
4.6.d:
स्वयमात्मा यथा नित्यस्तथा त्वं प्रकृतिः स्वयम् ॥
सर्वशक्तिसमायुक्ता सर्वाधारा सनातनी ॥ 221 ॥

4.6.s:
mama prāṇasamā lakṣmīvāṇī ca sarvamaṃgalā ..
brahmeśānantadha rmāśca tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā priyā .. 222 ..
4.6.d:
मम प्राणसमा लक्ष्मीवाणी च सर्वमंगला ॥
ब्रह्मेशानन्तध र्माश्च त्वं मे प्राणाधिका प्रिया ॥ 222 ॥

4.6.s:
samīpasthā ime sarve surā devyaśca rādhike ..
ebhyo'pyadhikā no cetkathaṃ vakṣaḥ sthalasthitā .. 223 ..
4.6.d:
समीपस्था इमे सर्वे सुरा देव्यश्च राधिके ॥
एभ्योऽप्यधिका नो चेत्कथं वक्षः स्थलस्थिता ॥ 223 ॥

4.6.s:
tyajāśrumokṣaṇaṃ rādhe bhrāṃtiṃ ca niṣphalāṃ sati ..
vihāya śaṃkāṃ niḥśaṃkaṃ vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja .. 224 ..
4.6.d:
त्यजाश्रुमोक्षणं राधे भ्रांतिं च निष्फलां सति ॥
विहाय शंकां निःशंकं वृषभानुगृहं व्रज ॥ 224 ॥

4.6.s:
kalāvatyāśca jaṭhare māsānāṃ nava sundari ..
vāyunā pūrayitvā ca garbhaṃ rodhaya māyayā .. 225..
4.6.d:
कलावत्याश्च जठरे मासानां नव सुन्दरि ॥
वायुना पूरयित्वा च गर्भं रोधय मायया ॥ 225॥

4.6.s:
daśame samanuprāpte tvamāvirbhava bhūtale ..
svātmarūpaṃ parityajya śiśurūpaṃ vidhāya ca .. 226 ..
4.6.d:
दशमे समनुप्राप्ते त्वमाविर्भव भूतले ॥
स्वात्मरूपं परित्यज्य शिशुरूपं विधाय च ॥ 226 ॥

4.6.s:
vāyuniḥsāraṇe kāle kalāvatyāḥ samīpataḥ ..
bhūmau vivasanībhūya patitvā rodiṣi dhruvam ..227..
4.6.d:
वायुनिःसारणे काले कलावत्याः समीपतः ॥
भूमौ विवसनीभूय पतित्वा रोदिषि ध्रुवम् ॥227॥
4.6.m: I am your self, free from desire, yet endowed with activity together with you. / From the man semen is produced, and from semen comes offspring; / the container of both of these is the woman, a part of Prakṛti. / Without a body, where is the self? And where is the body without the self? / Their primacy is mutual, O goddess; without you today, whence could existence come? / Nowhere is there any difference between us two, O Rādhā, the two seeds of the universe. / Where the self is, there is the body; there is no division—what is the use of modesty? / Just as whiteness resides in milk and the power to burn in fire, / just as fragrance resides in the earth and coolness in water, so it is with you and me. / Just as there is identity between whiteness and milk, and between burning power and fire, / and between earth and fragrance, and water and coolness, so there is no difference between us. / Without me you are lifeless, and without you I am invisible; / without you I am not capable of creating the world, O beautiful one, certainly. / Just as a potter is unable to make a pot without clay, / and a goldsmith is incapable of making an ornament without gold, / just as the self is inherently eternal, so you are Prakṛti itself, / endowed with all powers, the container of all, eternal. / Lakṣmī, Vāṇī, and Sarvamaṅgalā are dear to me as my life-breaths, / as are Brahmā, Īśa, Ananta, and Dharma; but you are dearer to me than life. / All these gods and goddesses stand nearby, O Rādhikā; / if you were not superior even to them, how could you abide upon my chest? / Give up shedding tears, O Rādhā, and discard this useless delusion, O virtuous woman; / abandoning all fear, go fearless to the house of Vṛṣabhānu. / In the womb of Kalāvatī, O beautiful one, for nine months / fill and withhold the pregnancy with wind by your māyā. / When the tenth month arrives, manifest on the surface of the earth, / relinquishing your own form and assuming the form of an infant. / At the time of the expulsion of the wind, near Kalāvatī, / falling onto the earth unclothed, you will surely cry.

4.6.s:
ayonisaṃbhavā tvaṃ ca bhavitā gokule sati ..
ayonisaṃbhavo'haṃ ca nāvayorgarbhasaṃsthitiḥ .. 228 ..
4.6.d:
अयोनिसंभवा त्वं च भविता गोकुले सति ॥
अयोनिसंभवोऽहं च नावयोर्गर्भसंस्थितिः ॥ 228 ॥
4.6.m: You shall be born without a womb in Gokula, O virtuous woman, / and I too am born without a womb; there is no dwelling in a womb for us two. / The moment I touch the earth, [someone] will bring me to Gokula; / for your sake I will go, using fear of Kaṃsa as a pretext. / In the abode of Yaśodā, you shall daily see me, / the delight of Nanda, full of bliss, O auspicious one, while embracing me. / By my boon your memory shall return in due time, O Rādhikā; / I will sport freely and constantly in the forest of Vṛndāvana. / Go to Gokula with twenty-one hundred crores of gopīs / and with thirty-three companions, Suśīlā and the rest. / Settling the countless gopīs in Gokula itself, / and comforting them with consolations and gentle, nectarlike words, / I, having settled my cowherd friends right here, O Rādhikā, / will then go to the abode of Vasudeva in the city of Mathurā. / Let those dearer than the dear go to Vraja to sport along with me; / let crores of cowherds take birth in the homes of the milkmen. / Having spoken thus, O Nārada, Śrī Kṛṣṇa fell silent; / and there the gods and goddesses, cowherds and gopīs, remained. / Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, and Dharma, as well as Śivā, Padmā, and Sarasvatī, / praised that Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the highest of the high, with supreme joy. / With devotion, the cowherds and gopīs, distressed by the fever of separation, / having praised Śrī Kṛṣṇa there, bowed down, overcome with love,

4.6.s:
bhūmisaṃspṛṣṭamātraṃ māṃ gokule prāpayiṣyati ..
tava hetorgamiṣyāmi kṛtvā kaṃsabhayaṃ chalam .. 229 ..
4.6.d:
भूमिसंस्पृष्टमात्रं मां गोकुले प्रापयिष्यति ॥
तव हेतोर्गमिष्यामि कृत्वा कंसभयं छलम् ॥ 229 ॥

4.6.s:
yaśodāmaṃdire māṃ ca sānandaṃ nandanaṃdanam ..
nityaṃ drakṣyasi kalyāṇi mamāśleṣaṇapūrvakam .. 4.6.230 ..
4.6.d:
यशोदामंदिरे मां च सानन्दं नन्दनंदनम् ॥
नित्यं द्रक्ष्यसि कल्याणि ममाश्लेषणपूर्वकम् ॥ 4.6.230 ॥

4.6.s:
smṛtiste bhavitā kāle vareṇa mama rādhike ..
svacchandaṃ vihariṣyāmi nityaṃ vṛndāvane vane .. 231 ..
4.6.d:
स्मृतिस्ते भविता काले वरेण मम राधिके ॥
स्वच्छन्दं विहरिष्यामि नित्यं वृन्दावने वने ॥ 231 ॥

4.6.s:
triḥsaptaśatakoṭībhirgopībhirgokulaṃ vraja ..
trayastriṃśadvayasyābhiḥ suśīlādibhireva ca .. 232 ..
4.6.d:
त्रिःसप्तशतकोटीभिर्गोपीभिर्गोकुलं व्रज ॥
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वयस्याभिः सुशीलादिभिरेव च ॥ 232 ॥

4.6.s:
saṃsthāpya saṃkhyārahitā gopīrgokula eva ca ..
tā āśvāsya prabodhaiśca mitayā ca sudhāgirā ..233..
4.6.d:
संस्थाप्य संख्यारहिता गोपीर्गोकुल एव च ॥
ता आश्वास्य प्रबोधैश्च मितया च सुधागिरा ॥233॥

4.6.s:
ahaṃ gopāla suhṛdaḥ saṃsthāpyātraiva rādhike ..
vasudevāśramaṃ paścādyāsyāmi mathurāṃ purīm .. 234 ..
4.6.d:
अहं गोपाल सुहृदः संस्थाप्यात्रैव राधिके ॥
वसुदेवाश्रमं पश्चाद्यास्यामि मथुरां पुरीम् ॥ 234 ॥

4.6.s:
vraje vrajantu krīḍārthaṃ mama saṃge priyātpriyāḥ..
ballavānāṃ gṛhe janma labhantāṃ gopakoṭayaḥ .. 235 ..
4.6.d:
व्रजे व्रजन्तु क्रीडार्थं मम संगे प्रियात्प्रियाः॥
बल्लवानां गृहे जन्म लभन्तां गोपकोटयः ॥ 235 ॥

4.6.s:
ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada ..
ūṣurdevāśca devyaśca gopā gopyaśca tatra vai .. 236 ..
4.6.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा श्रीकृष्णो विरराम च नारद ॥
ऊषुर्देवाश्च देव्यश्च गोपा गोप्यश्च तत्र वै ॥ 236 ॥

4.6.s:
brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parātparam ..
śivāpadmāsarasvatyastuṣṭuvuḥ parayā mudā .. 237 ..
4.6.d:
ब्रह्मेशशेषधर्माश्च श्रीकृष्णं तं परात्परम् ॥
शिवापद्मासरस्वत्यस्तुष्टुवुः परया मुदा ॥ 237 ॥

4.6.s:
bhaktyā gopāśca gopyaśca virahajvarakātarāḥ ..
tatra saṃstūya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇemuḥ premavihvalāḥ .. 238
4.6.d:
भक्त्या गोपाश्च गोप्यश्च विरहज्वरकातराः ॥
तत्र संस्तूय श्रीकृष्णं प्रणेमुः प्रेमविह्वलाः ॥ 238

4.6.s:
prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ kāṃtaṃ rādhāpūrṇamanoratham ..
parituṣṭo'bhavadbhaktyāvirahajvarakātarām .. 239 ..
4.6.d:
प्राणाधिकं प्रियं कांतं राधापूर्णमनोरथम् ॥
परितुष्टोऽभवद्भक्त्याविरहज्वरकातराम् ॥ 239 ॥
4.6.m:
to their beloved lord, dearer than life, who fulfills the desires of Rādhā.
He was pleased by her devotion; [and seeing her] distressed by the fever of separation,

4.6.s:
sāśrupūrṇātidīnāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayākulām ..
prabodhavacanaṃ śrutyamuvāca tāṃ hariḥ svayam .. 4.6.240 ..
4.6.d:
साश्रुपूर्णातिदीनां च दृष्ट्वा राधां भयाकुलाम् ॥
प्रबोधवचनं श्रुत्यमुवाच तां हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 4.6.240 ॥
4.6.m:
seeing Rādhā filled with tears, exceedingly miserable, and agitated by fear,
Hari himself addressed comforting words worthy of being heard to her:

4.6.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
prāṇādhike mahādevi sthirā bhava bhayaṃ tyaja ..
yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca kā ciṃtā te mayi sthite .. 241 ..
4.6.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
प्राणाधिके महादेवि स्थिरा भव भयं त्यज ॥
यथा त्वं च तथाऽहं च का चिंता ते मयि स्थिते ॥ 241 ॥
4.6.m:
O you who are dearer than my life, O great goddess, be calm and cast away fear!
As you are, so am I; what worry can you have while I am present?

4.6.s:
kiṃ tu te kathayiṣyāmi kiṃcidevāstyamaṃgalam ..
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ pūrṇaṃ tvadvicchedo mayā saha .. 242 ..
4.6.d:
किं तु ते कथयिष्यामि किंचिदेवास्त्यमंगलम् ॥
वर्षाणां शतकं पूर्णं त्वद्विच्छेदो मया सह ॥ 242 ॥
4.6.m:
However, I shall tell you of a slight misfortune.
For a full hundred years there will be separation between you and me,

4.6.s:
śrīdāmaśāpajanyena karmabhogena sundari ..
bhaviṣyatyeva mama ca mathurāgamanaṃ tataḥ .. 243 ..
4.6.d:
श्रीदामशापजन्येन कर्मभोगेन सुन्दरि ॥
भविष्यत्येव मम च मथुरागमनं ततः ॥ 243 ॥
4.6.m:
brought about by the curse of Śrīdāman, through the experience of karma, O beautiful one.
Then indeed my departure for Mathurā will come to pass;

4.6.s:
tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ pitrorbaṃdhanamocanam ..
mālākārataṃtuvāyakubjikānāṃ ca mokṣaṇam .. 244 ..
4.6.d:
तत्र भारावतरणं पित्रोर्बंधनमोचनम् ॥
मालाकारतंतुवायकुब्जिकानां च मोक्षणम् ॥ 244 ॥
4.6.m:
there, the removal of the burden [of the earth], the release of my parents from bondage,
and the liberation of the florist, the weaver, and Kubjikā;

4.6.s:
ghātayitvā ca yavanaṃ mucukundasya mokṣaṇam ..
dvārakāyāśca nirmāṇaṃ rājasūyasya darśanam .. 245 ..
4.6.d:
घातयित्वा च यवनं मुचुकुन्दस्य मोक्षणम् ॥
द्वारकायाश्च निर्माणं राजसूयस्य दर्शनम् ॥ 245 ॥
4.6.m:
and having caused the death of the Yavana, the liberation of Mucukunda;
the building of Dvārakā, the witnessing of the Rājasūya [sacrifice],

4.6.s:
udvāhaṃ rājakanyānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ..
daśādhikaśatasyāpi śatrūṇāṃ damanaṃ tathā .. 246 ..
4.6.d:
उद्वाहं राजकन्यानां सहस्राणां च षोडश ॥
दशाधिकशतस्यापि शत्रूणां दमनं तथा ॥ 246 ॥
4.6.m:
the marriage to sixteen thousand princesses,
and also one hundred and ten, and likewise the subduing of enemies;

4.6.s:
mitropakaraṇaṃ caiva vārāṇasyāśca dāhanam ..
harasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ tatra bāṇasya bhujakṛṃtanam .. 247 ..
4.6.d:
मित्रोपकरणं चैव वाराणस्याश्च दाहनम् ॥
हरस्य जृंभणं तत्र बाणस्य भुजकृंतनम् ॥ 247 ॥
4.6.m:
the assisting of friends, the burning of Vārāṇasī,
the yawning of Hara, the severing of Bāṇa’s arms there,

4.6.s:
pārijātasya haraṇaṃ yadyatkarmāṇi tāni ca ..
gamanaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ munisaṃghapradarśanam .. 248 ..
4.6.d:
पारिजातस्य हरणं यद्यत्कर्माणि तानि च ॥
गमनं तीर्थयात्रायां मुनिसंघप्रदर्शनम् ॥ 248 ॥
4.6.m:
the carrying off of the pārijāta tree, and whatever deeds there may be;
going on pilgrimage, meeting an assembly of sages,

4.6.s:
saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ yajñasaṃpādanaṃ pituḥ ..
śubhakṣaṇe punastatra tvayā sārddhaṃ pradarśanam ..
kariṣyāmi ca tatraiva gopikānāṃ ca darśanam .. 249 ..
4.6.d:
संभाषणं च बंधूनां यज्ञसंपादनं पितुः ॥
शुभक्षणे पुनस्तत्र त्वया सार्द्धं प्रदर्शनम् ॥
करिष्यामि च तत्रैव गोपिकानां च दर्शनम् ॥ 249 ॥

4.6.s:
tubhyamādhyātmikaṃ dattvā punaḥ satyaṃ tvayā saha ..
divāniśamavicchedo mayā sārddhamataḥ param .. 4.6.250 ..
4.6.d:
तुभ्यमाध्यात्मिकं दत्त्वा पुनः सत्यं त्वया सह ॥
दिवानिशमविच्छेदो मया सार्द्धमतः परम् ॥ 4.6.250 ॥
4.6.m:
Having imparted spiritual knowledge to you, then in truth with you
there will be no separation day or night with me hereafter;

4.6.s:
bhaviṣyati tvayā sārddhaṃ punarāgamanaṃ vraje ..
kāṃte vicchedasamaye varṣāṇāṃ śatake sati .. 251 ..
4.6.d:
भविष्यति त्वया सार्द्धं पुनरागमनं व्रजे ॥
कांते विच्छेदसमये वर्षाणां शतके सति ॥ 251 ॥
4.6.m:
there will be a return to Vraja together with you.
O beloved, during the hundred years of the time of separation,

4.6.s:
nityaṃ saṃmīlana svapne bhaviṣyati tvayā saha ..
mama nārāyaṇāṃśo yastasya yānaṃ ca dvārakām .. 292 ..
4.6.d:
नित्यं संमीलन स्वप्ने भविष्यति त्वया सह ॥
मम नारायणांशो यस्तस्य यानं च द्वारकाम् ॥ 292 ॥
4.6.m:
there will be a constant meeting with you in dreams.
That portion of mine which is Nārāyaṇa, his journey to Dvārakā—

4.6.s:
śatavarṣāṃtare sādhyametadeva suniścitam ..
bhaviṣyati punastatra vane rāsastvayā saha .. 253 ..
4.6.d:
शतवर्षांतरे साध्यमेतदेव सुनिश्चितम् ॥
भविष्यति पुनस्तत्र वने रासस्त्वया सह ॥ 253 ॥
4.6.m:
within a span of a hundred years this is certainly to be accomplished.
Again there in the forest the rāsa dance will take place with you;

4.6.s:
punaḥ pitrośca gopīnāṃ śokasaṃmārjanaṃ param ..
kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ punarāgamanaṃ mama .. 254 ..
4.6.d:
पुनः पित्रोश्च गोपीनां शोकसंमार्जनं परम् ॥
कृत्वा भारावतरणं पुनरागमनं मम ॥ 254 ॥
4.6.m:
again the supreme wiping away of the sorrow of [my] parents and the gopīs.
Having accomplished the removal of the burden, my return [will occur],

4.6.s:
tvayā sahāpi golokaṃ gopairgopībhireva ca ..
mama nārāyaṇāṃśasya vāṇyā ca padmayā saha .. 255 ..
4.6.d:
त्वया सहापि गोलोकं गोपैर्गोपीभिरेव च ॥
मम नारायणांशस्य वाण्या च पद्मया सह ॥ 255 ॥
4.6.m:
together with you to Goloka, and indeed with the gopas and gopīs.
The departure of my portion, Nārāyaṇa, with Vāṇī and Padmā

4.6.s:
vaikuṃṭhagamanaṃ rādhe nityasya paramātmanaḥ ..
śvetadvīpaṃ dharmagehamaṃśānāṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 256 ..
4.6.d:
वैकुंठगमनं राधे नित्यस्य परमात्मनः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपं धर्मगेहमंशानां च भविष्यति ॥ 256 ॥
4.6.m:
to Vaikuṇṭha [will take place], O Rādhā, [and the return] of the eternal Paramātman.
The abode of the portions will be Śvetadvīpa, the house of Dharma;

4.6.s:
devānāṃ caiva devīnāmaṃśā yāsyaṃti svakṣayam ..
punaḥ saṃsthitiratraiva goloke me tvayā saha .. 257 ..
4.6.d:
देवानां चैव देवीनामंशा यास्यंति स्वक्षयम् ॥
पुनः संस्थितिरत्रैव गोलोके मे त्वया सह ॥ 257 ॥
4.6.m:
and the portions of the gods and goddesses will go to their own abodes.
Once more my residence will be right here in Goloka together with you.

4.6.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śubhāśubham ..
mayā nirūpitaṃ yattatkāṃte kena nivāryate .. 258 ..
4.6.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं भविष्यं च शुभाशुभम् ॥
मया निरूपितं यत्तत्कांते केन निवार्यते ॥ 258 ॥
4.6.m:
Thus all the future has been spoken of, both auspicious and inauspicious.
What has been determined by me, O beloved, by whom can that be averted?"

4.6.s:
ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi ..
tasthau tasthuḥ surāḥ sarve surapatnyaśca vismitāḥ .. 259 ..
4.6.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा श्रीकृष्णः कृत्वा राधां स्ववक्षसि ॥
तस्थौ तस्थुः सुराः सर्वे सुरपत्न्यश्च विस्मिताः ॥ 259 ॥
4.6.m:
Having spoken thus, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, holding Rādhā to his chest,
remained [there], and all the gods and their wives stood astonished.

4.6.s:
uvāca śrīharirdevāndevīṃ ca samayocitam ..
devā gacchata kāryārthaṃ svālayaṃ viṣayocitam .. 4.6.260 ..
4.6.d:
उवाच श्रीहरिर्देवान्देवीं च समयोचितम् ॥
देवा गच्छत कार्यार्थं स्वालयं विषयोचितम् ॥ 4.6.260 ॥
4.6.m:
Śrī Hari spoke to the gods and the goddess as suited the occasion:
"O gods, depart to your own abodes for the sake of your work, as befits each realm.

4.6.s:
gaccha pārvati kailāsaṃ sutābhyāṃ svāmi nā saha ..
mayā niyojitaṃ karma sarvaṃ kāle bhaviṣyati .. 261 ..
4.6.d:
गच्छ पार्वति कैलासं सुताभ्यां स्वामि ना सह ॥
मया नियोजितं कर्म सर्वं काले भविष्यति ॥ 261 ॥
4.6.m:
Go, O Pārvatī, to Kailāsa with your two sons and your husband;
the deed ordained by me will all come to pass in due time.

4.6.s:
bhavitā kalayā janma sarveṣāṃ ca vrajeśvari ..
kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ devaṃ laṃbodaraṃ vinā .. 262 ..
4.6.d:
भविता कलया जन्म सर्वेषां च व्रजेश्वरि ॥
क्षुद्राणां चैव महतां देवं लंबोदरं विना ॥ 262 ॥
4.6.m:
There will be a birth by a part of all [of you], O queen of Vraja,
both of the small and of the great, except for the pot-bellied god [Gaṇeśa]."

4.6.s:
praṇamya śrīhariṃ devāḥ svālayaṃ prayayurmudā ..
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ bhaktyā praṇamya puruṣottamam .. 263 ..
4.6.d:
प्रणम्य श्रीहरिं देवाः स्वालयं प्रययुर्मुदा ॥
लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीं भक्त्या प्रणम्य पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ 263 ॥
4.6.m:
Having bowed to Śrī Hari, the gods departed joyfully to their own abodes;
having bowed with devotion to Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, and Puruṣottama,

4.6.s:
hariṇā yojitaṃ karma kartuṃ vyagrā mahīṃ yayuḥ ..
bhartrā nirūpitaṃ sthānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham .. 264 ..
4.6.d:
हरिणा योजितं कर्म कर्तुं व्यग्रा महीं ययुः ॥
भर्त्रा निरूपितं स्थानं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ॥ 264 ॥
4.6.m:
eager to perform the task ordained by Hari, they went to the earth,
to the place determined by their Lord, hard even for the gods to attain.

4.6.s:
uvāca rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇo vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja ..
gopagopīsamūhaiśca saha pūrvanirūpitaiḥ .. 265 ..
4.6.d:
उवाच राधिकां कृष्णो वृषभानुगृहं व्रज ॥
गोपगोपीसमूहैश्च सह पूर्वनिरूपितैः ॥ 265 ॥
4.6.m:
Kṛṣṇa said to Rādhikā: "Go to the house of Vṛṣabhānu,
together with the hosts of gopas and gopīs previously appointed.

4.6.s:
ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ vasudevālayaṃ priye ..
paścātkaṃsabhaya vyājādgokulaṃ tava sannidhim .. 266 ..
4.6.d:
अहं यास्यामि मथुरां वसुदेवालयं प्रिये ॥
पश्चात्कंसभय व्याजाद्गोकुलं तव सन्निधिम् ॥ 266 ॥
4.6.m:
I shall go to Mathurā, to the house of Vasudeva, O beloved;
thereafter, on the pretext of fear of Kaṃsa, to Gokula, into your presence."

4.6.s:
rādhā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ raktapaṃkajalocanā ..
bhṛśaṃ ruroda purataḥ premavicchedakātarā .. 267 ..
4.6.d:
राधा प्रणम्य श्रीकृष्णं रक्तपंकजलोचना ॥
भृशं रुरोद पुरतः प्रेमविच्छेदकातरा ॥ 267 ॥
4.6.m:
Rādhā, having bowed to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, with eyes like red lotuses,
wept bitterly before him, anguished by separation from her love.

4.6.s:
sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ kvacidyāṃtī gatvāgatvā punaḥ punaḥ ..
punaḥ punaḥ samāgatya darśaṃdarśaṃ harermukham .. 268 ..
4.6.d:
स्थायंस्थायं क्वचिद्यांती गत्वागत्वा पुनः पुनः ॥
पुनः पुनः समागत्य दर्शंदर्शं हरेर्मुखम् ॥ 268 ॥
4.6.m:
Stopping and stopping, sometimes walking on, going and going again and again,
coming back again and again, gazing repeatedly at Hari’s face,

4.6.s:
papau cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ nimeṣarahitā satī ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhasudhāpūrṇaṃ prabhormukham .. 269 ..
4.6.d:
पपौ चक्षुश्चकोराभ्यां निमेषरहिता सती ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्राभसुधापूर्णं प्रभोर्मुखम् ॥ 269 ॥
4.6.m:
the virtuous lady drank without blinking, with eyes like cakora birds,
the Lord’s face, filled with nectar, radiant as the autumnal full moon.

4.6.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saptadhā parameśvarī ..
praṇamya saptadhā caiva punastasthau hareḥ puraḥ .. 4.6.270 ..
4.6.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य सप्तधा परमेश्वरी ॥
प्रणम्य सप्तधा चैव पुनस्तस्थौ हरेः पुरः ॥ 4.6.270 ॥
4.6.m:
Then, having circumambulated [him] seven times, the supreme goddess,
and having bowed down seven times, stood once more before Hari.

4.6.s:
ājagmurgopikānāṃ ca triḥsaptaśatakoṭayaḥ ..
ājagāma ca gopānāṃ samūhaḥ koṭisaṃkhyakaḥ .. 271 ..
4.6.d:
आजग्मुर्गोपिकानां च त्रिःसप्तशतकोटयः ॥
आजगाम च गोपानां समूहः कोटिसंख्यकः ॥ 271 ॥
4.6.m:
There arrived twenty-one hundred crores of gopīs,
and there arrived a host of gopas numbering in crores.

4.6.s:
gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca samūhaiḥ saha rādhikā ..
punaḥ praṇamya taṃ rādhā tatra tasthau ca nārada .. 272 ..
4.6.d:
गोपानां गोपिकानां च समूहैः सह राधिका ॥
पुनः प्रणम्य तं राधा तत्र तस्थौ च नारद ॥ 272 ॥
4.6.m:
With the multitudes of cowherds and cowherd maidens, Rādhikā,
bowing once more to him, stood there, O Nārada.

4.6.s:
trayastriṃśadvayasyābhirgopībhiḥ saha suṃdarī ..
gopānāṃ ca samūhaiśca praṇamya prayayau mahīm .. 273 ..
4.6.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वयस्याभिर्गोपीभिः सह सुंदरी ॥
गोपानां च समूहैश्च प्रणम्य प्रययौ महीम् ॥ 273 ॥
4.6.m:
Together with thirty-three companion cowherdesses, the beautiful lady,
along with the multitudes of cowherds, bowed and departed for the earth.

4.6.s:
hariṇā yojitaṃ sthānaṃ prajagmurnaṃdagokulam ..
vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ rādhā gopīgopagṛhaṃ yayau .. 274 ..
4.6.d:
हरिणा योजितं स्थानं प्रजग्मुर्नंदगोकुलम् ॥
वृषभानुगृहं राधा गोपीगोपगृहं ययौ ॥ 274 ॥
4.6.m:
They went to the place designated by Hari: Nanda's Gokula.
Rādhā went to Vṛṣabhānu's house, and the cowherd women and cowherd men went to their respective homes.

4.6.s:
mahīṃ gatāyāṃ rādhāyāṃ gopībhiḥ saha gopakaiḥ ..
babhūva śrīhariḥ sadyaḥ pṛthivīṃ gamanotsukaḥ .. 275 ..
4.6.d:
महीं गतायां राधायां गोपीभिः सह गोपकैः ॥
बभूव श्रीहरिः सद्यः पृथिवीं गमनोत्सुकः ॥ 275 ॥
4.6.m:
When Rādhā had departed for the earth together with the cowherdesses and cowherds,
the blessed Hari at once became eager to go to the earth.

4.6.s:
saṃbhāṣya gopāngopīśca niyojya svīyakarmaṇi ..
manoyāyī jagannātho jagāma mathurāṃ hariḥ .. 276 ..
4.6.d:
संभाष्य गोपान्गोपीश्च नियोज्य स्वीयकर्मणि ॥
मनोयायी जगन्नाथो जगाम मथुरां हरिः ॥ 276 ॥
4.6.m:
Conversing with the cowherds and cowherdesses and directing them to their own duties,
moving at the speed of thought, Hari, the Lord of the Universe, went to Mathurā.

4.6.s:
pūrvaṃ yadyadapatyaṃ ca devakīvasudevayoḥ ..
babhūva sadyastatkaṃsaḥ putraṣaṭkaṃ jaghāna ha .. 277 ..
4.6.d:
पूर्वं यद्यदपत्यं च देवकीवसुदेवयोः ॥
बभूव सद्यस्तत्कंसः पुत्रषट्कं जघान ह ॥ 277 ॥
4.6.m:
Whatever offspring had previously been born to Devakī and Vasudeva,
Kaṃsa promptly killed those six sons.

4.6.s:
śeṣāṃśaṃ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyayā''kṛṣya gokule ..
nidhāya rohiṇīgarbhe jagāma cājñayā hareḥ ..278..
4.6.d:
शेषांशं सप्तमं गर्भं मायया'ऽकृष्य गोकुले ॥
निधाय रोहिणीगर्भे जगाम चाज्ञया हरेः ॥278॥
4.6.m:
Drawing out the seventh embryo, a portion of Śeṣa, by Māyā to Gokula,
and placing it within Rohiṇī's womb, [Māyā] departed by the command of Hari.

4.8.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ brūhi vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ..
phalaṃ jayaṃtīyogasya sāmānyenaiva sāṃpratam .. 1 ..
4.8.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
जन्माष्टमीव्रतं ब्रूहि व्रतानां व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
फलं जयंतीयोगस्य सामान्येनैव सांप्रतम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.8.s:
ko vā doṣo'pyakaraṇe bhojano vā mahāmune ..
upavāsaphalaṃ kiṃ vā jayaṃtyāṃ ca susaṃmatam .. 2 ..
4.8.d:
को वा दोषोऽप्यकरणे भोजनो वा महामुने ॥
उपवासफलं किं वा जयंत्यां च सुसंमतम् ॥ 2 ॥

4.8.s:
vrataṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca saṃyamasya ca sāṃpratam ..
upavāsapāraṇayoḥ suvicārya vada prabho .. 3 ..
4.8.d:
व्रतं पूजाविधानं च संयमस्य च सांप्रतम् ॥
उपवासपारणयोः सुविचार्य वद प्रभो ॥ 3 ॥

4.8.s:
.. nārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ saptamyāṃ saṃyataḥ pāraṇe tathā ..
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ samutthāya pare'hani .. 4 ..
4.8.d:
॥ नारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
कृत्वा हविष्यं सप्तम्यां संयतः पारणे तथा ॥
अरुणोदयवेलायां समुत्थाय परेऽहनि ॥ 4 ॥

4.8.s:
prātaḥkṛtya saṃvidhāya snātvā saṃkalpamācaret ..
vratopavāsayorbrahmañchrīkṛṣṇaprītihetukam .. 5 ..
4.8.d:
प्रातःकृत्य संविधाय स्नात्वा संकल्पमाचरेत् ॥
व्रतोपवासयोर्ब्रह्मञ्छ्रीकृष्णप्रीतिहेतुकम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.8.s:
manvādidivase prāpte yatphalaṃ snānapūjanaiḥ ..
phalaṃ bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ dvija .. 6 ..
4.8.d:
मन्वादिदिवसे प्राप्ते यत्फलं स्नानपूजनैः ॥
फलं भाद्रपदेऽष्टम्यां भवेत्कोटिगुणं द्विज ॥ 6 ॥

4.8.s:
tasyāṃ tithau vārimātraṃ pitṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
gayāśrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śatābdaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7 ..
4.8.d:
तस्यां तिथौ वारिमात्रं पितॄणां यः प्रयच्छति ॥
गयाश्राद्धं कृतं तेन शताब्दं नात्र संशयः ॥ 7 ॥

4.8.s:
snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā nirmāya sūtikāgṛham ..
lohakhaṃḍavahnijālairyuktaṃ rakṣakasaṃghakaiḥ.. .. 8 ..
4.8.d:
स्नात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा निर्माय सूतिकागृहम् ॥
लोहखंडवह्निजालैर्युक्तं रक्षकसंघकैः॥ ॥ 8 ॥

4.8.s:
tatra dravyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ nābhicchedanakartanam ..
dhātrīsvarūpāṃ nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ .. 9 ..
4.8.d:
तत्र द्रव्यं बहुविधं नाभिच्छेदनकर्तनम् ॥
धात्रीस्वरूपां नारीं च यत्नतः स्थापयेद्बुधः ॥ 9 ॥

4.8.s:
pūjādravyāṇi cārūṇi sopacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ..
phalānyaṣṭau ca miṣṭāni dravyāṇyeva hi nārada .. 4.8.10 ..
4.8.d:
पूजाद्रव्याणि चारूणि सोपचाराणि षोडश ॥
फलान्यष्टौ च मिष्टानि द्रव्याण्येव हि नारद ॥ 4.8.10 ॥

4.8.s:
jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ dāḍimaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā ..
nārikeraṃ ca jaṃbīraṃ kūṣmāṃḍaṃ ca suvāsasam .. 11 ..
4.8.d:
जातीफलं च कंकोलं दाडिमं श्रीफलं तथा ॥
नारिकेरं च जंबीरं कूष्मांडं च सुवाससम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.8.s:
āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathaiva ca ..
arghyamācanīyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ śayanaṃ tathā ..12 ..
4.8.d:
आसनं वसनं पाद्यं मधुपर्कं तथैव च ॥
अर्घ्यमाचनीयं च स्नानीयं शयनं तथा ॥12 ॥

4.8.s:
gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāṃbūlamanulepanam ..
dhūpadīpau bhūṣaṇaṃ vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa .. 13 ..
4.8.d:
गंधं पुष्पं च नैवेद्यं तांबूलमनुलेपनम् ॥
धूपदीपौ भूषणं वै चोपचारांश्च षोडश ॥ 13 ॥

4.8.s:
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ..
ācamya cāsane sthitvā svastivācanapūrvakam .. 14 ..
4.8.d:
पादप्रक्षालनं कृत्वा धृत्वा धौते च वाससी ॥
आचम्य चासने स्थित्वा स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकम् ॥ 14 ॥

4.8.s:
ghaṭasyāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya paṃca devatāḥ ..
ghaṭe hyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram .. 15 ..
4.8.d:
घटस्यारोपणं कृत्वा संपूज्य पंच देवताः ॥
घटे ह्यावाहनं कृत्वा श्रीकृष्णं परमेश्वरम् ॥ 15 ॥

4.8.s:
vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca yaśodāṃ naṃdameva ca ..
rohiṇīṃ baladevaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhīdevīṃ vasuṃdharām .. 16 ..
4.8.d:
वसुदेवं देवकीं च यशोदां नंदमेव च ॥
रोहिणीं बलदेवं च षष्ठीदेवीं वसुंधराम् ॥ 16 ॥

4.8.s:
rohiṇīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva aṣṭamīṃ sthānadevatām ..
aśvatthāmnā saha baliṃ hanumaṃtaṃ vibhīṣaṇam .. 17 ..
4.8.d:
रोहिणीं ब्राह्मणीं चैव अष्टमीं स्थानदेवताम् ॥
अश्वत्थाम्ना सह बलिं हनुमंतं विभीषणम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.8.s:
kṛpaṃ paraśurāmaṃ ca vedavyāsaṃ mṛkaṃḍakam ..
sarvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ kuryāddharestadā .. 16 ..
4.8.d:
कृपं परशुरामं च वेदव्यासं मृकंडकम् ॥
सर्वस्यावाहनं कृत्वा ध्यानं कुर्याद्धरेस्तदा ॥ 16 ॥

4.8.s:
puṣpakaṃ mastake nyasya punardhyāyedvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi nārada .. 19 ..
4.8.d:
पुष्पकं मस्तके न्यस्य पुनर्ध्यायेद्विचक्षणः ॥
ध्यानं च सामवेदोक्तं शृणु वक्ष्यामि नारद ॥ 19 ॥

4.8.s: brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ kumārāya mahātmane .. 4.8.20 ..
4.8.d: ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं कुमाराय महात्मने ॥ 4.8.20 ॥

4.8.s:
bālaṃ nīlāṃbujābhamatiśayaruciraṃ smeravaktrāṃbujaṃ taṃ
brahmeśānaṃtadharmaiḥ katikatidivasaiḥ stūyamānaṃ paraṃ yat ..
dhyānāsādhyamṛṣīndrairmunigaṇamanujaiḥ siddhasaṃghairasādhyaṃ
yogīṃdrāṇāmaciṃtyamatiśayamatulaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ bhaje'ham .. 21 ..
4.8.d:
बालं नीलांबुजाभमतिशयरुचिरं स्मेरवक्त्रांबुजं तं
ब्रह्मेशानंतधर्मैः कतिकतिदिवसैः स्तूयमानं परं यत् ॥
ध्यानासाध्यमृषीन्द्रैर्मुनिगणमनुजैः सिद्धसंघैरसाध्यं
योगींद्राणामचिंत्यमतिशयमतुलं साक्षिरूपं भजेऽहम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.8.s:
dhyātvā puṣpaṃ ca dattvā ca tatsarvaṃ ca nivedayet ..
evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kuryācchṛṇu maṃtrakramaṃ mune .. 22 ..
4.8.d:
ध्यात्वा पुष्पं च दत्त्वा च तत्सर्वं च निवेदयेत् ॥
एवं व्रती व्रतं कुर्याच्छृणु मंत्रक्रमं मुने ॥ 22 ॥

4.8.s:
āsanaṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sadratnamaṇinirmitam..
vicitraṃ ca vicitreṇa gṛhyatāṃ śobhanaṃ hare .. 23 ..
4.8.d:
आसनं सर्वशोभाढ्यं सद्रत्नमणिनिर्मितम्॥
विचित्रं च विचित्रेण गृह्यतां शोभनं हरे ॥ 23 ॥

4.8.s:
vasanaṃ vahniśaucaṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ..
prataptasvarṇakhacitaṃ citritaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 24 ..
4.8.d:
वसनं वह्निशौचं च निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥
प्रतप्तस्वर्णखचितं चित्रितं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 24 ॥

4.8.s:
pādaprakṣālanārthaṃ ca svarṇapātrasthitaṃ jalam ..
pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ cāru pādyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 25 ..
4.8.d:
पादप्रक्षालनार्थं च स्वर्णपात्रस्थितं जलम् ॥
पवित्रं निर्मलं चारु पाद्यं च गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 25 ॥

4.8.s:
madhusarpirdadhikṣīraṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ param ..
svarṇapātrasthitaṃ deyaṃ snānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 26 ..
4.8.d:
मधुसर्पिर्दधिक्षीरं शर्करासंयुतं परम् ॥
स्वर्णपात्रस्थितं देयं स्नानार्थं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 26 ॥

4.8.s:
dūrvākṣataṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ svacchatoyasamanvitam ..
caṃdanāgurukastūrīsahitaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 27 ..
4.8.d:
दूर्वाक्षतं शुक्लपुष्पं स्वच्छतोयसमन्वितम् ॥
चंदनागुरुकस्तूरीसहितं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 27 ॥

4.8.s:
susvādu svacchatoyaṃ ca vāsitaṃ gaṃdhavastunā ..
śuddhamācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara .. 28 ..
4.8.d:
सुस्वादु स्वच्छतोयं च वासितं गंधवस्तुना ॥
शुद्धमाचमनीयं च गृह्यतां परमेश्वर ॥ 28 ॥

4.8.s:
gaṃdhadravyasamāyuktaṃ viṣṇo tailaṃ suvāsitam ..
āmalakyā dravaṃ caiva snānīyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 29 ..
4.8.d:
गंधद्रव्यसमायुक्तं विष्णो तैलं सुवासितम् ॥
आमलक्या द्रवं चैव स्नानीयं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 29 ॥

4.8.s:
sadratnamaṇisāreṇa racitāṃ sumanoharām ..
chāditāṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa śayyāṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 4.8.30 ..
4.8.d:
सद्रत्नमणिसारेण रचितां सुमनोहराम् ॥
छादितां सूक्ष्मवस्त्रेण शय्यां च गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 4.8.30 ॥

4.8.s:
cūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣabhedānāṃ mūlānāṃ dravasaṃyutam ..
kastūrīdravasaṃyuktaṃ gandhaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 31 ..
4.8.d:
चूर्णं च वृक्षभेदानां मूलानां द्रवसंयुतम् ॥
कस्तूरीद्रवसंयुक्तं गन्धं च गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 31 ॥

4.8.s:
puṣpaṃ sugaṃdhiyuktaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumena ca ..
supriyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sāṃprataṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 32 ..
4.8.d:
पुष्पं सुगंधियुक्तं च संयुक्तं कुंकुमेन च ॥
सुप्रियं सर्वदेवानां सांप्रतं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 32 ॥

4.8.s:
gṛhyatāṃ svastikoktaṃ ca miṣṭadravyasamanvitam ..
supakvaphalasaṃyuktaṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 33 ..
4.8.d:
गृह्यतां स्वस्तिकोक्तं च मिष्टद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ॥
सुपक्वफलसंयुक्तं नैवेद्यं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 33 ॥

4.8.s:
laḍḍukaṃ modakaṃ caiva sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ guḍaṃ madhu ..
navoddhṛtaṃ dadhi takraṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare .. 34 ..
4.8.d:
लड्डुकं मोदकं चैव सर्पिः क्षीरं गुडं मधु ॥
नवोद्धृतं दधि तक्रं नैवेद्यं गृह्यतां हरे ॥ 34 ॥

4.8.s:
śītalaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ kṣīrasvādusupakvakam ..
tāṃbūlaṃ bhogasāraṃ ca karpūrādisamanvitam .. 35 ..
4.8.d:
शीतलं शर्करायुक्तं क्षीरस्वादुसुपक्वकम् ॥
तांबूलं भोगसारं च कर्पूरादिसमन्वितम् ॥ 35 ॥

4.8.s:
bhaktyā niveditamidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ..
candanāguru kastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam .. 36 ..
4.8.d:
भक्त्या निवेदितमिदं गृह्यतां परमेश्वर ॥
चन्दनागुरु कस्तूरीकुंकुमद्रवसंयुतम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.8.s:
abīracūrṇaṃ ruciraṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ..
tarubhedarasotkarṣo gaṃdhayukto'gninā saha .. 37 ..
4.8.d:
अबीरचूर्णं रुचिरं गृह्यतां परमेश्वर ॥
तरुभेदरसोत्कर्षो गंधयुक्तोऽग्निना सह ॥ 37 ॥

4.8.s:
supriyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ..
ghorāṃdhakāranāśaikahetureva śubhāvahaḥ .. 38 ..
4.8.d:
सुप्रियः सर्वदेवानां धूपोऽयं गृह्यतां हरे ॥
घोरांधकारनाशैकहेतुरेव शुभावहः ॥ 38 ॥

4.8.s:
supradīpo dīptikaro dīpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ..
pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ toyaṃ karpūrādisamāyutam .. 39 ..
4.8.d:
सुप्रदीपो दीप्तिकरो दीपोऽयं गृह्यतां हरे ॥
पवित्रं निर्मलं तोयं कर्पूरादिसमायुतम् ॥ 39 ॥

4.8.s:
jīvanaṃ sarvabījānāṃ pānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ..
nānāpuṣpasamāyuktaṃ grathitaṃ sūkṣmataṃtunā .. 4.8.40 ..
4.8.d:
जीवनं सर्वबीजानां पानार्थं गृह्यतां हरे ॥
नानापुष्पसमायुक्तं ग्रथितं सूक्ष्मतंतुना ॥ 4.8.40 ॥

4.8.s:
śarīrabhūṣaṇavaraṃ mālyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām ..
dattvā deyāni dravyāṇi pūjopayogitāni ca .. 41 ..
4.8.d:
शरीरभूषणवरं माल्यं च प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥
दत्त्वा देयानि द्रव्याणि पूजोपयोगितानि च ॥ 41 ॥

4.8.s:
vratasthānasthitaṃ dravyaṃ haraye deyameva ca ..
phalāni tarubījāni svādūni suṃdarāṇi ca .. 42 ..
4.8.d:
व्रतस्थानस्थितं द्रव्यं हरये देयमेव च ॥
फलानि तरुबीजानि स्वादूनि सुंदराणि च ॥ 42 ॥

4.8.s:
vaṃśavṛddhikarāṇyeva gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ..
āvāhitāṃśca devāṃśca pratyekaṃ pūjayedvratī .. 43 ..
4.8.d:
वंशवृद्धिकराण्येव गृह्यतां परमेश्वर ॥
आवाहितांश्च देवांश्च प्रत्येकं पूजयेद्व्रती ॥ 43 ॥

4.8.s:
tānpūjya bhaktibhāvena dadyātpuṣpāṃjalitrayam ..
sunaṃdanaṃdakumudāngopāngopīśca rādhikām .. 44 ..
4.8.d:
तान्पूज्य भक्तिभावेन दद्यात्पुष्पांजलित्रयम् ॥
सुनंदनंदकुमुदान्गोपान्गोपीश्च राधिकाम् ॥ 44 ॥

4.8.s:
gaṇeśaṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ ca śivaṃ śivām ..
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva dikpālāṃśca grahāṃstathā .. 45 ..
4.8.d:
गणेशं कार्त्तिकेयं च ब्रह्माणं च शिवं शिवाम् ॥
लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीं चैव दिक्पालांश्च ग्रहांस्तथा ॥ 45 ॥

4.8.s:
śeṣaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva pārṣadapravarāṃstathā..
sampūjya sarvadevāṃśca praṇamya daṃḍavadbhuvi ..
brāhmaṇebhyaśca naivedyaṃ dattvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām .. 46 ..
4.8.d:
शेषं सुदर्शनं चैव पार्षदप्रवरांस्तथा॥
सम्पूज्य सर्वदेवांश्च प्रणम्य दंडवद्भुवि ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च नैवेद्यं दत्त्वा दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥ 46 ॥

4.8.s:
kathāṃ ca janmādhyāyoktāṃ śṛṇuyādbhakti bhāvataḥ ..
tadā kuśāsane sthitvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī .. 47 ..
4.8.d:
कथां च जन्माध्यायोक्तां शृणुयाद्भक्ति भावतः ॥
तदा कुशासने स्थित्वा कुर्याज्जागरणं व्रती ॥ 47 ॥

4.8.s:
prabhāte cāhnikaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya śrīhariṃ mudā ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca kārayeddharikīrtanam .. 48 ..
4.8.d:
प्रभाते चाह्निकं कृत्वा संपूज्य श्रीहरिं मुदा ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा च कारयेद्धरिकीर्तनम् ॥ 48 ॥

4.8.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
vratakālavyavasthāṃ ca vedoktāṃ sarvasaṃmatām ..
vedārthaṃ ca samālocya saṃhitāṃ ca purātanīm ..49..
4.8.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
व्रतकालव्यवस्थां च वेदोक्तां सर्वसंमताम् ॥
वेदार्थं च समालोच्य संहितां च पुरातनीम् ॥49॥

4.8.s:
upavāse jāgaraṇe vrate kiṃ vā phalaṃ mune ..
kiṃ vā pāpaṃ tatra bhuktvā vada vedavidāṃ vara ..4.8.50 ..
4.8.d:
उपवासे जागरणे व्रते किं वा फलं मुने ॥
किं वा पापं तत्र भुक्त्वा वद वेदविदां वर ॥4.8.50 ॥

4.8.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
aṣṭamī karkṣasaṃyuktā rātryarthe yadi dṛśyate ..
sa eva mukhyakālaśca tatra jātaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ .. 51 ..
4.8.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
अष्टमी कर्क्षसंयुक्ता रात्र्यर्थे यदि दृश्यते ॥
स एव मुख्यकालश्च तत्र जातः स्वयं हरिः ॥ 51 ॥

4.8.s:
jayaṃ puṇyaṃ ca kurute jayaṃtī tena saṃsmṛtā ..
tatropoṣya vrataṃ kṛtvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ budhaḥ .. 52 ..
4.8.d:
जयं पुण्यं च कुरुते जयंती तेन संस्मृता ॥
तत्रोपोष्य व्रतं कृत्वा कुर्याज्जागरणं बुधः ॥ 52 ॥
4.8.m:
She brings about victory and merit, and is therefore remembered as Jayantī.
Having fasted and observed the vow then, the wise person should keep a night-vigil.

4.8.s:
sarvāpavādaḥ kālo'yaṃ pradhānaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ ..
iti vedavidāṃ vāṇī cetyuktā vedhasā purā .. 53 ..
4.8.d:
सर्वापवादः कालोऽयं प्रधानः सर्वसंमतः ॥
इति वेदविदां वाणी चेत्युक्ता वेधसा पुरा ॥ 53 ॥
4.8.m:
This time, which dispels all flaws, is foremost and accepted by all;
such is the utterance of the knowers of the Veda, spoken of old by the Creator.

4.8.s:
tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yaścopoṣya vrataṃ caret ..
koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 54 ..
4.8.d:
तत्र जागरणं कृत्वा यश्चोपोष्य व्रतं चरेत् ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 54 ॥
4.8.m: One who keeps a night-vigil then and, having fasted, observes the vow,

4.8.s:
varjanīyā prayatnena saptamīsahitāṣṭamī ..
sā sarkṣāpi na kartavyā saptamīsahitāṣṭamī ..
aviddhāyāṃ kaṛkṣāyāṃ jāto devakinaṃdanaḥ .. 55 ..
4.8.d:
वर्जनीया प्रयत्नेन सप्तमीसहिताष्टमी ॥
सा सर्क्षापि न कर्तव्या सप्तमीसहिताष्टमी ॥
अविद्धायां कऋक्षायां जातो देवकिनंदनः ॥ 55 ॥

4.8.s:
vedavedāṃgaguptetiviśiṣṭaṃ maṃgalakṣaṇe ..
vyatīte rohiṇīṛkṣe vratī kuryācca pāraṇām .. 56 ..
4.8.d:
वेदवेदांगगुप्तेतिविशिष्टं मंगलक्षणे ॥
व्यतीते रोहिणीऋक्षे व्रती कुर्याच्च पारणाम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.8.m:
distinguished by the auspicious mark concealed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.
When the asterism Rohiṇī has elapsed, the practitioner of the vow should break the fast.

4.8.s:
tithyaṃte ca hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā devārcanaṃ vratī. ..
pāraṇaṃ pāvanaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 57 ..
4.8.d:
तिथ्यंते च हरिं स्मृत्वा कृत्वा देवार्चनं व्रती॥।
पारणं पावनं पुंसां सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.8.m:
And at the end of the lunar day, remembering Hari and worshipping the deity, the practitioner of the vow [should break fast].
Breaking the fast is purifying for men and destroys all sins;

4.8.s:
upavāsāṃgabhūtaṃ ca phaladaṃ siddhikāraṇam ..
sarveṣvevopavāseṣu divā pāraṇamiṣyate .. 58 ..
4.8.d:
उपवासांगभूतं च फलदं सिद्धिकारणम् ॥
सर्वेष्वेवोपवासेषु दिवा पारणमिष्यते ॥ 58 ॥
4.8.m:
it forms a limb of the fast, grants its fruit, and brings about success.
In all fasts indeed, breaking the fast during the day is desired;

4.8.s:
anyathā phalahāniḥ syātkṛte dhāraṇapāraṇe..
na rātrau pāraṇaṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇīvratāt ..59..
4.8.d:
अन्यथा फलहानिः स्यात्कृते धारणपारणे॥
न रात्रौ पारणं कुर्यादृते वै रोहिणीव्रतात् ॥59॥
4.8.m:
otherwise there would be loss of fruit when the observance and fast-breaking are performed.
One should not break the fast at night, except indeed in the Rohiṇī vow.

4.8.s:
niśāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryādvarjayitvā mahāniśām ..
pūrvāhṇe pāraṇaṃ śastaṃ kṛtvā viprasurārcanam .. 4.8.60 ..
4.8.d:
निशायां पारणं कुर्याद्वर्जयित्वा महानिशाम् ॥
पूर्वाह्णे पारणं शस्तं कृत्वा विप्रसुरार्चनम् ॥ 4.8.60 ॥
4.8.m:
One may break the fast at night, avoiding the deep night.
Breaking the fast in the forenoon, having worshipped the brahmins and the gods, is praised.

4.8.s:
sarveṣāṃ saṃmataṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇī vratam ..
budhasomasamāyuktā jayaṃtī yadi labhyate ..61..
4.8.d:
सर्वेषां संमतं कुर्यादृते वै रोहिणी व्रतम् ॥
बुधसोमसमायुक्ता जयंती यदि लभ्यते ॥61॥
4.8.m:
One should perform what is agreed upon by all, except indeed the Rohiṇī vow.
If a Jayantī conjoined with Wednesday or Monday is obtained,

4.8.s:
na kuryādgarbhavāsaṃ ca tatra kṛtvā vrataṃ vratī ..
udaye cāṣṭamī kiṃcinnavamī sakalā yadi .. 62 ..
4.8.d:
न कुर्याद्गर्भवासं च तत्र कृत्वा व्रतं व्रती ॥
उदये चाष्टमी किंचिन्नवमी सकला यदि ॥ 62 ॥
4.8.m:
the practitioner of the vow, having observed the vow on it, does not enter the womb again.
If the eighth [lunar day] is slightly present at sunrise and the ninth is complete,

4.8.s:
bhavedbudheṃdusaṃyuktā prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā ..
apivarṣaśatenāpi labhyate vā na labhyate .. 63 ..
4.8.d:
भवेद्बुधेंदुसंयुक्ता प्राजापत्यर्क्षसंयुता ॥
अपिवर्षशतेनापि लभ्यते वा न लभ्यते ॥ 63 ॥
4.8.m:
and it is conjoined with Wednesday or Monday, and conjoined with the asterism of Prajāpati [Rohiṇī],
it may or may not be obtained even in a hundred years.

4.8.s:
vrataṃ tatra vratī kuryātpuṃsāṃ koṭiṃ samuddharet ..
nṛṇāṃ vinā vratenāpi bhaktānāṃ hīnasaṃpadām .. 64 ..
4.8.d:
व्रतं तत्र व्रती कुर्यात्पुंसां कोटिं समुद्धरेत् ॥
नृणां विना व्रतेनापि भक्तानां हीनसंपदाम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.8.m:
The practitioner of the vow should observe the vow on it; he liberates ten million ancestors.
Even without the [full] vow, for devoted men of meager means,

4.8.s:
kṛtenaivopavāsena prīto bhavati mādhavaḥ ..
bhaktyā nānopacāreṇa rātrau jāgaraṇena ca .. 65 ..
4.8.d:
कृतेनैवोपवासेन प्रीतो भवति माधवः ॥
भक्त्या नानोपचारेण रात्रौ जागरणेन च ॥ 65 ॥
4.8.m:
Mādhava is pleased merely by the fast that is observed.
Through devotion, various offerings, and keeping a night-vigil,

4.8.s:
phalaṃ dadāti daityārirjayantīvratasaṃbhavam ..
vittaśāṭhyamakurvāṇaḥ samyakphalamavāpnuyāt ..66..
4.8.d:
फलं ददाति दैत्यारिर्जयन्तीव्रतसंभवम् ॥
वित्तशाठ्यमकुर्वाणः सम्यक्फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥66॥
4.8.m:
the enemy of the Daityas grants the fruit arising from the Jayantī vow.
One who does not practice deceit regarding his wealth attains the full fruit;

4.8.s:
kurvāṇo vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca labhate sadṛśaṃ phalam ..
aṣṭamyāmatha rohiṇyāṃ na kuryātpāraṇaṃ budhaḥ .. 67 ..
4.8.d:
कुर्वाणो वित्तशाठ्यं च लभते सदृशं फलम् ॥
अष्टम्यामथ रोहिण्यां न कुर्यात्पारणं बुधः ॥ 67 ॥
4.8.m:
one who practices deceit regarding his wealth obtains a fruit corresponding [to it].
The wise person should not break the fast during the eighth [lunar day] or during Rohiṇī;

4.8.s:
hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ copavāsārjitaṃ phalam ..
tithiraṣṭaguṇaṃ haṃti nakṣatraṃ ca caturguṇam .. 68 ..
4.8.d:
हन्यात्पुराकृतं पुण्यं चोपवासार्जितं फलम् ॥
तिथिरष्टगुणं हंति नक्षत्रं च चतुर्गुणम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.8.m:
it destroys previously acquired merit and the fruit earned by the fast.
The lunar day destroys eightfold, and the asterism fourfold;

4.8.s:
tasmātprayatnataḥ kuryāttithibhāṃte ca pāraṇam ..
mahāniśāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tithibhāṃtaṃ yadā bhavet .. 69 ..
4.8.d:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतः कुर्यात्तिथिभांते च पारणम् ॥
महानिशायां प्राप्तायां तिथिभांतं यदा भवेत् ॥ 69 ॥
4.8.m:
therefore, one should make an effort to break the fast at the end of both the lunar day and the asterism.
When the end of the lunar day and the asterism occurs after deep night has arrived,

4.8.s:
tṛtīye'hni muniśreṣṭha pāraṇaṃ kurute budhaḥ ..
ṣaṇmuhūrte vyatīte tu rātrāveva mahāniśā .. 4.8.70 ..
4.8.d:
तृतीयेऽह्नि मुनिश्रेष्ठ पारणं कुरुते बुधः ॥
षण्मुहूर्ते व्यतीते तु रात्रावेव महानिशा ॥ 4.8.70 ॥
4.8.m:
on the third day, O best of sages, the wise person breaks the fast.
When six muhūrtas have elapsed in the night, that indeed is the deep night.

4.8.s:
labhate brahmahatyāṃ ca tatra bhuktvā ca nārada ..
gomāṃsaviṇmūtrasamaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam .. 71 ..
4.8.d:
लभते ब्रह्महत्यां च तत्र भुक्त्वा च नारद ॥
गोमांसविण्मूत्रसमं तांबूलं च फलं जलम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.8.m:
By eating at that time, O Nārada, one incurs the sin of killing a brahmin.
Betel, fruit, and water [eaten then] become equal to beef, feces, and urine;

4.8.s:
puṃsāmabhakṣyaṃ śuddhānāmodanasya ca kā kathā ..
triyāmāṃ rajanī prāhustyaktvādya ca catuṣṭayam .. 72 ..
4.8.d:
पुंसामभक्ष्यं शुद्धानामोदनस्य च का कथा ॥
त्रियामां रजनी प्राहुस्त्यक्त्वाद्य च चतुष्टयम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.8.m:
they are unfit to be consumed by pure men—what then of cooked rice?
They declare the night to have three watches, excluding the first and last four

4.8.s:
nāḍīnāṃ tadubhe sandhye divasādyaṃtasaṃjñite ..
janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ vratam .. 75 ..
4.8.d:
नाडीनां तदुभे सन्ध्ये दिवसाद्यंतसंज्ञिते ॥
जन्माष्टम्यां च शुद्धायां कृत्वा जागरणं व्रतम् ॥ 75 ॥
4.8.m:
nāḍīs, which are both called the twilight junctions at the beginning and end of day.
Having observed the vow and the night-vigil on pure Janmāṣṭamī,

4.8.s:
śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāmupoṣya kevalaṃ naraḥ .. 74 ..
4.8.d:
शतजन्मकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
जन्माष्टम्यां च शुद्धायामुपोष्य केवलं नरः ॥ 74 ॥
4.8.m: A person merely fasting on pure Janmāṣṭamī,

4.8.s:
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vinā ..
yadbālye yacca kaumāre yauvane yacca vārdhake .. 75 ..
4.8.d:
अश्वमेधफलं तस्य व्रतं जागरणं विना ॥
यद्बाल्ये यच्च कौमारे यौवने यच्च वार्धके ॥ 75 ॥
4.8.m:
even without the [full] vow or night-vigil, obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.
Whatever [sin was committed] in childhood, youth, adulthood, or old age,

4.8.s:
saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇajanmadivase yaśca bhuktaṃ narādhamaḥ .. 76 ..
4.8.d:
सप्तजन्मकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
श्रीकृष्णजन्मदिवसे यश्च भुक्तं नराधमः ॥ 76 ॥
4.8.m:
he is freed from the sin committed in seven births; of this there is no doubt.
And whatever vile man eats on the day of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s birth,

4.8.s:
sa bhavenmātṛgāmī ca brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam .. 77 ..
4.8.d:
स भवेन्मातृगामी च ब्रह्महत्याशतं लभेत् ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं तस्य नश्यति निश्चितम् ॥ 77 ॥
4.8.m: he becomes an incestuous violator of his mother and incurs a hundred murders of brahmins.

4.8.s:
anarhaścāśuciḥ śaśvaddaive pitrye ca karmaṇi ..
ante vasetkālasūtre yāvaccaṃdradivākarau .. 78 ..
4.8.d:
अनर्हश्चाशुचिः शश्वद्दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि ॥
अन्ते वसेत्कालसूत्रे यावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 78 ॥
4.8.m:
Unfit and impure, he is perpetually excluded from rites for the gods and the ancestors.
In the end, he dwells in Kālasūtra for as long as the moon and sun endure,

4.8.s:
kṛmibhiḥ śūlatulyaiśca tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca bhakṣitaḥ ..
pāpī tataḥ samutthāya bhārate janma cellabhet .. 79 ..
4.8.d:
कृमिभिः शूलतुल्यैश्च तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैश्च भक्षितः ॥
पापी ततः समुत्थाय भारते जन्म चेल्लभेत् ॥ 79 ॥
4.8.m:
devoured by sharp-fanged worms resembling spikes.
Rising from there, if that sinner attains birth in Bhārata,

4.8.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ..
gṛdhrakoṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ .. 4.8.80 ..
4.8.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां च कृमिर्भवेत् ॥
गृध्रकोटिसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि सूकरः ॥ 4.8.80 ॥
4.8.m: a vulture for ten million years, and a pig for a hundred births.

4.8.s:
śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni sṛgālaḥ sapta janma ca ..
saptajanmasu sarpaśca kākaśca saptajanmasu .. 81 ..
4.8.d:
श्वापदः शतजन्मानि सृगालः सप्त जन्म च ॥
सप्तजन्मसु सर्पश्च काकश्च सप्तजन्मसु ॥ 81 ॥
4.8.m:
[He becomes] a wild beast for a hundred births, and a jackal for seven births,
and a serpent for seven births, and a crow for seven births. // 81

4.8.s:
tato bhavennaro mūko galatkuṣṭhī sadāturaḥ ..
tato bhavetpaśughnaśca vyālagrāhī tato bhavet .. 82 ..
4.8.d:
ततो भवेन्नरो मूको गलत्कुष्ठी सदातुरः ॥
ततो भवेत्पशुघ्नश्च व्यालग्राही ततो भवेत् ॥ 82 ॥
4.8.m:
Then he becomes a mute man, afflicted with suppurating leprosy, always diseased;
then he becomes a killer of animals, and then a snake-catcher. // 82

4.8.s:
tadaṃte ca bhaveddasyurdharmahīnaśca gṛdhrakaḥ ..
tato bhevatsa rajakastailakārastato bhavet .. 83 ..
4.8.d:
तदंते च भवेद्दस्युर्धर्महीनश्च गृध्रकः ॥
ततो भेवत्स रजकस्तैलकारस्ततो भवेत् ॥ 83 ॥
4.8.m:
And after that he becomes a bandit, and a vulture devoid of righteousness;
then he becomes a washerman, and then he becomes an oil-presser. // 83

4.8.s:
tato bhaveddevalako brāhmaṇaśca sadā'śuciḥ ..
upavāsāsamarthaścedekaṃ vipraṃ ca bhojayet .. 84 ..
4.8.d:
ततो भवेद्देवलको ब्राह्मणश्च सदाऽशुचिः ॥
उपवासासमर्थश्चेदेकं विप्रं च भोजयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
4.8.m:
Then he becomes a temple-attendant Brahmin, ever impure.
If one is unable to fast, he should feed a single vipra, // 84

4.8.s:
tāvaddhanāni vā dadyādyadbhuktaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ..
sahasrasaṃmitāṃ devīṃ japedvā prāṇasaṃyamān .. .. 85 ..
4.8.d:
तावद्धनानि वा दद्याद्यद्भुक्तं द्विगुणं भवेत् ॥
सहस्रसंमितां देवीं जपेद्वा प्राणसंयमान् ॥ ॥ 85 ॥
4.8.m:
or give wealth to such an extent that it equals twice [the value of] what was eaten;
or he should recite the divine [Gāyatrī] a thousand times, or [perform] breath-controls; // 85

4.8.s:
kuryāddvādaśasaṃkhyākānyathārthaṃ tadvrate naraḥ ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrutaṃ yaddharmavaktrataḥ ..
vratopavāsapūjānāṃ vidhānamakṛte ca yat .. 86 ..
4.8.d:
कुर्याद्द्वादशसंख्याकान्यथार्थं तद्व्रते नरः ॥
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स श्रुतं यद्धर्मवक्त्रतः ॥
व्रतोपवासपूजानां विधानमकृते च यत् ॥ 86 ॥
4.8.m:
a man should perform twelve [of them] in accordance with the proper observance of that vow.
Thus has been related, my child, what was heard from the mouth of Dharma,
concerning the rules of the vow, fasting, and worship, and what [befalls] when it is not performed. // 86

4.9.s:
nārada uvāca ..
saṃsthāpya gokule kṛṣṇaṃ yaśodāmaṃdiraṃ vasuḥ ..
jagāma svagṛhaṃ nandaḥ kiṃ cakāra mahāṃ prabhuḥ .. 1 ..
4.9.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
संस्थाप्य गोकुले कृष्णं यशोदामंदिरं वसुः ॥
जगाम स्वगृहं नन्दः किं चकार महां प्रभुः ॥ 1 ॥

4.9.s:
kiñcakāra haristatra kativarṣasthitiḥ prabhoḥ ..
bālakrīḍanakaṃ tasya varṇaya kramaśo mune .. 2 ..
4.9.d:
किञ्चकार हरिस्तत्र कतिवर्षस्थितिः प्रभोः ॥
बालक्रीडनकं तस्य वर्णय क्रमशो मुने ॥ 2 ॥

4.9.s:
purā kṛtā yā pratijñā goloke rādhayā saha ..
tatkṛtaṃ kena vidhinā pratijñāpālanaṃ hareḥ .. 3 ..
4.9.d:
पुरा कृता या प्रतिज्ञा गोलोके राधया सह ॥
तत्कृतं केन विधिना प्रतिज्ञापालनं हरेः ॥ 3 ॥

4.9.s:
kīdṛgvṛndāvanaṃ nāma maṇḍalaṃ kiṃvidhaṃ vada ..
rāsakrīḍāṃ jalakrīḍāṃ saṃvyasya varṇaya prabho .. 4 ..
4.9.d:
कीदृग्वृन्दावनं नाम मण्डलं किंविधं वद ॥
रासक्रीडां जलक्रीडां संव्यस्य वर्णय प्रभो ॥ 4 ॥

4.9.s:
nandastapaḥ kiñcakāra yaśodā cātha rohiṇī ..
hareḥ pūrvaṃ ca halinaḥ kutra janma babhūva ha .. .. 5 ..
4.9.d:
नन्दस्तपः किञ्चकार यशोदा चाथ रोहिणी ॥
हरेः पूर्वं च हलिनः कुत्र जन्म बभूव ह ॥ ॥ 5 ॥

4.9.s:
pīyūṣakhaṃḍamākhyānamapūrvaṃ śrīhareḥ smṛtam ..
viśeṣataḥ kavimukhānnavyaṃ nūnaṃ pade pade .. 6 ..
4.9.d:
पीयूषखंडमाख्यानमपूर्वं श्रीहरेः स्मृतम् ॥
विशेषतः कविमुखान्नव्यं नूनं पदे पदे ॥ 6 ॥

4.9.s:
svarāsamaṇḍalakrīḍāṃ varṇaya svayameva ca ..
parokṣavarṇanātkāvyaṃ praśastaṃ navyavarṇanam ..7..
4.9.d:
स्वरासमण्डलक्रीडां वर्णय स्वयमेव च ॥
परोक्षवर्णनात्काव्यं प्रशस्तं नव्यवर्णनम् ॥7॥

4.9.s:
śrīkṛṣṇāṃśo bhavānsākṣādyogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ..
yo yasyāṃśaḥ sa ca janastasyaiva sukhataḥ sukhī .. 8 ..
4.9.d:
श्रीकृष्णांशो भवान्साक्षाद्योगींद्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥
यो यस्यांशः स च जनस्तस्यैव सुखतः सुखी ॥ 8 ॥

4.9.s:
tvayaiva varṇitau pādau vilīnau tu yuvāṃ hareḥ ..
sākṣādgolokanāthāṃśastvameva tatsamo mahān .. 9 ..
4.9.d:
त्वयैव वर्णितौ पादौ विलीनौ तु युवां हरेः ॥
साक्षाद्गोलोकनाथांशस्त्वमेव तत्समो महान् ॥ 9 ॥

4.9.s:
.. nārāyaṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmeśaśeṣavighneśāḥ kūrmo dharmo'hameva ca ..
naraśca kārttikeyaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṃśā vayaṃ nava ..4.9.10..
4.9.d:
॥ नारायण उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मेशशेषविघ्नेशाः कूर्मो धर्मोऽहमेव च ॥
नरश्च कार्त्तिकेयश्च श्रीकृष्णांशा वयं नव ॥4.9.10॥

4.9.s:
aho golokanāthasya mahimā kena varṇyate ..
yaṃ svayaṃ no vijānīmo na vedāḥ kiṃ vipaścitaḥ .. 11 ..
4.9.d:
अहो गोलोकनाथस्य महिमा केन वर्ण्यते ॥
यं स्वयं नो विजानीमो न वेदाः किं विपश्चितः ॥ 11 ॥

4.9.s:
sūkaro vāmanaḥ kalkirbauddhaḥ kapilamīnakau ..
ete cāṃśāḥ kalāścānye saṃtyeva katidhā mune .. 12 ..
4.9.d:
सूकरो वामनः कल्किर्बौद्धः कपिलमीनकौ ॥
एते चांशाः कलाश्चान्ये संत्येव कतिधा मुने ॥ 12 ॥

4.9.s:
kūrmo nṛsiṃho rāmaśca śvetadvīpavirāḍvibhuḥ ..
paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇo vaikuṇṭhe gokule svayam .. .. 13 ..
4.9.d:
कूर्मो नृसिंहो रामश्च श्वेतद्वीपविराड्विभुः ॥
परिपूर्णतमः कृष्णो वैकुण्ठे गोकुले स्वयम् ॥ ॥ 13 ॥

4.9.s:
vaikuṇṭhe kamalākāṃto rūpabhedāccaturbhujaḥ ..
goloke gokule rādhākāṃto'yaṃ dvibhujaḥ svayam .. 14 ..
4.9.d:
वैकुण्ठे कमलाकांतो रूपभेदाच्चतुर्भुजः ॥
गोलोके गोकुले राधाकांतोऽयं द्विभुजः स्वयम् ॥ 14 ॥

4.9.s:
asyaiva tejo nityaṃ ca citte kurvaṃti yoginaḥ ..
bhaktāḥ pādāmbujaṃ tejaḥ kutastejasvinaṃ vinā .. 15 ..
4.9.d:
अस्यैव तेजो नित्यं च चित्ते कुर्वंति योगिनः ॥
भक्ताः पादाम्बुजं तेजः कुतस्तेजस्विनं विना ॥ 15 ॥

4.9.s:
śṛṇu vipra varṇayāmi yaśodānandayostapaḥ ..
rohiṇyāśca yato hetordadṛśuste harermukham .. 16 ..
4.9.d:
शृणु विप्र वर्णयामि यशोदानन्दयोस्तपः ॥
रोहिण्याश्च यतो हेतोर्ददृशुस्ते हरेर्मुखम् ॥ 16 ॥

4.9.s:
vasūnāṃ pravaro nando nāmnā droṇastapodhanaḥ ..
tasya patnī dharā sādhvī yaśodā sā tapasvinī ..17..
4.9.d:
वसूनां प्रवरो नन्दो नाम्ना द्रोणस्तपोधनः ॥
तस्य पत्नी धरा साध्वी यशोदा सा तपस्विनी ॥17॥

4.9.s:
rohiṇī sarpamātā ca kadrūśca sarpakāriṇī ..
eteṣāṃ janmacaritaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te.. 18 ..
4.9.d:
रोहिणी सर्पमाता च कद्रूश्च सर्पकारिणी ॥
एतेषां जन्मचरितं निबोध कथयामि ते॥ 18 ॥

4.9.s:
ekadā ca dharā droṇau parvate gandhamādane ..
puṇyade bhārate varṣe gautamāśramasannidhau .. 19 ..
4.9.d:
एकदा च धरा द्रोणौ पर्वते गन्धमादने ॥
पुण्यदे भारते वर्षे गौतमाश्रमसन्निधौ ॥ 19 ॥

4.9.s:
cakratuśca tapastatra varṣāṇāmayutaṃ mune ..
śrīkṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ ca nirjane suprabhātaṭe .. 4.9.20 ..
4.9.d:
चक्रतुश्च तपस्तत्र वर्षाणामयुतं मुने ॥
श्रीकृष्णदर्शनार्थं च निर्जने सुप्रभातटे ॥ 4.9.20 ॥

4.9.s:
na dadarśa hariṃ droṇo dharā caiva tapasvinī ..
kṛtvāgnikuṃḍaṃ vairāgyātpraveṣṭuṃ samupasthitau..21..
4.9.d:
न ददर्श हरिं द्रोणो धरा चैव तपस्विनी ॥
कृत्वाग्निकुंडं वैराग्यात्प्रवेष्टुं समुपस्थितौ॥21॥

4.9.s:
tau martukāmau dṛṣṭvā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ..
drakṣyathaḥ śrīhariṃ pṛthvyāṃ gokule putrarūpiṇam .. 22 ..
4.9.d:
तौ मर्तुकामौ दृष्ट्वा च वाग्बभूवाशरीरिणी ॥
द्रक्ष्यथः श्रीहरिं पृथ्व्यां गोकुले पुत्ररूपिणम् ॥ 22 ॥

4.9.s:
janmāṃtare vasuśreṣṭha durdarśaṃ yogināṃ vibhum..
dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca viduṣāṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vaṃditam .. 23 ..
4.9.d:
जन्मांतरे वसुश्रेष्ठ दुर्दर्शं योगिनां विभुम्॥
ध्यानासाध्यं च विदुषां ब्रह्मादीनां च वंदितम् ॥ 23 ॥

4.9.s:
śrutvaivaṃ taddharādroṇau jagmatuḥ svālayaṃ sukhāt ..
labdhvā tu bhārate janma dṛṣṭaṃ tābhyāṃ harermukham .. 24 ..
4.9.d:
श्रुत्वैवं तद्धराद्रोणौ जग्मतुः स्वालयं सुखात् ॥
लब्ध्वा तु भारते जन्म दृष्टं ताभ्यां हरेर्मुखम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.9.s:
yaśodānaṃdayorevaṃ kathitaṃ caritaṃ tava ..
sugopyaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca rohiṇīcaritaṃ śṛṇu .. 25 ..
4.9.d:
यशोदानंदयोरेवं कथितं चरितं तव ॥
सुगोप्यं त्रिदशानां च रोहिणीचरितं शृणु ॥ 25 ॥

4.9.s:
ekadā devamātā ca puṣpotsavadine satī ..
vijñāpanaṃ caradvārā cakāra kaśyapaṃ mune .. 26 ..
4.9.d:
एकदा देवमाता च पुष्पोत्सवदिने सती ॥
विज्ञापनं चरद्वारा चकार कश्यपं मुने ॥ 26 ॥

4.9.s:
susnātā suṃdarī devī ratnālaṃkāra bhūṣitā ..
cakāra veṣaṃ vividhaṃ dadarśa darpaṇe mukham .. 27 ..
4.9.d:
सुस्नाता सुंदरी देवी रत्नालंकार भूषिता ॥
चकार वेषं विविधं ददर्श दर्पणे मुखम् ॥ 27 ॥

4.9.s:
kastūrībiṃdunā sārddhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdusaṃyutam ..
ratnakuṃḍalaśobhāḍhyaṃ patrābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 28 ..
4.9.d:
कस्तूरीबिंदुना सार्द्धं सिंदूरबिंदुसंयुतम् ॥
रत्नकुंडलशोभाढ्यं पत्राभरणभूषितम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.9.m: abounding in the beauty of jewelled earrings, adorned with leaf-patterns,

4.9.s:
gajamauktikasaṃyuktaṃ nāsāgraṃ sumanoharam ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanam .. 29 ..
4.9.d:
गजमौक्तिकसंयुक्तं नासाग्रं सुमनोहरम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यं शरत्पंकजलोचनम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.9.m:
the tip of her nose charming, fitted with an elephant-pearl,
her face like the autumn full moon, her eyes like autumn lotuses,

4.9.s:
vakrabhrūbhaṃginā yuktaṃ vicitrakajjalojjvalam ..
pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitam .. 4.9.30 ..
4.9.d:
वक्रभ्रूभंगिना युक्तं विचित्रकज्जलोज्ज्वलम् ॥
पक्वदाडिमबीजाभदंतपंक्तिविराजितम् ॥ 4.9.30 ॥
4.9.m:
endowed with curved eyebrows, radiant with wondrous collyrium,
shining with rows of teeth resembling ripe pomegranate seeds,

4.9.s:
pakvabiṃbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca sasmitaṃ suṃdaraṃ sadā ..
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca munīṃdracittamohanam .. 31 ..
4.9.d:
पक्वबिंबाधरौष्ठं च सस्मितं सुंदरं सदा ॥
अतीव कमनीयं च मुनींद्रचित्तमोहनम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.9.m:
her lower lip like a ripe bimba fruit, smiling and always beautiful,
exceedingly lovely, enchanting the minds of the lords of sages.

4.9.s:
evaṃbhūtaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā suṃdarī svagṛhe sthitā ..
paśyaṃtī patimārgaṃ ca kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā .. 32 ..
4.9.d:
एवंभूतं मुखं दृष्ट्वा सुंदरी स्वगृहे स्थिता ॥
पश्यंती पतिमार्गं च कामबाणप्रपीडिता ॥ 32 ॥
4.9.m:
Having looked at such a face, the beautiful woman remained in her house,
watching the path of her husband, afflicted by the arrows of love.

4.9.s:
śuśrāva vārtāmaditiḥ kaśyapaṃ kadrusaṃyutam ..
ratnasārasamāraṃbhe tasyā vakṣasthale sthitam .. 33 ..
4.9.d:
शुश्राव वार्तामदितिः कश्यपं कद्रुसंयुतम् ॥
रत्नसारसमारंभे तस्या वक्षस्थले स्थितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.9.m:
Aditi heard the news that Kaśyapa was together with Kadrū,
resting upon her breast at the inception of exquisite love-making.

4.9.s:
śrutvā cukopa sādhvī sā hatāśā ratikātarā ..
na śaśāpa patiṃ premṇā śaśāpa sarpamātaram .. 34 ..
4.9.d:
श्रुत्वा चुकोप साध्वी सा हताशा रतिकातरा ॥
न शशाप पतिं प्रेम्णा शशाप सर्पमातरम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.9.m:
Hearing this, that virtuous woman, disappointed and distressed by passion, grew angry.
Out of love she did not curse her husband; she cursed the mother of snakes:

4.9.s:
na devālayayogyā sā dharmiṣṭhā dharmanāśinī ..
dūraṃ gacchatu svarlokādātmayoniṃ ca mānavīm .. 35 ..
4.9.d:
न देवालययोग्या सा धर्मिष्ठा धर्मनाशिनी ॥
दूरं गच्छतु स्वर्लोकादात्मयोनिं च मानवीम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.9.m:
“She is not fit for the abode of the gods, this destroyer of virtue posing as virtuous!
Let her go far from heaven into a human womb!”

4.9.s:
śrutvaivaṃ sā caradvārā śaśāpa devamātaram ..
sā caivaṃ mānavīṃ yoniṃ yātu martye jarāyutām .. 36 ..
4.9.d:
श्रुत्वैवं सा चरद्वारा शशाप देवमातरम् ॥
सा चैवं मानवीं योनिं यातु मर्त्ये जरायुताम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.9.m:
Hearing this through a spy, she in turn cursed the mother of the gods:
“Let her also go to a human womb subject to old age in the mortal world!”

4.9.s:
kaśyapo bodhayāmāsa kadruṃ ca sarpamātaram ..
kāle yāsyasi martyaṃ ca mayā saha śucismite .. 37 ..
4.9.d:
कश्यपो बोधयामास कद्रुं च सर्पमातरम् ॥
काले यास्यसि मर्त्यं च मया सह शुचिस्मिते ॥ 37 ॥
4.9.m:
Kaśyapa consoled Kadrū, the mother of snakes:
“In time, O woman of sweet smiles, you shall go to the mortal world with me.

4.9.s:
tyaja bhītiṃ labha sukhaṃ drakṣyasi śrīharermukham..
evamuktvā kaśyapaśca jagāma cāditergṛham ..38..
4.9.d:
त्यज भीतिं लभ सुखं द्रक्ष्यसि श्रीहरेर्मुखम्॥
एवमुक्त्वा कश्यपश्च जगाम चादितेर्गृहम् ॥38॥
4.9.m:
Abandon fear, attain happiness; you will behold the face of Śrī Hari.”
Having spoken thus, Kaśyapa went to Aditi's house.

4.9.s:
vāṃchāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca tasyāśca cakāra bhagavānvibhuḥ ..
ṛtau tatra maheṃdraśca babhūva ca surarṣabhaḥ ..39..
4.9.d:
वांछां पूर्णां च तस्याश्च चकार भगवान्विभुः ॥
ऋतौ तत्र महेंद्रश्च बभूव च सुरर्षभः ॥39॥
4.9.m:
The all-pervading lord fulfilled her desire;
and in that season was born Mahendra, the bull among the gods.

4.9.s:
aditirdevakī caiva sarpamātā ca rohiṇī ..
kaśyapo vasudevaśca śrīkṛṣṇajanako mahān .. 4.9.40 ..
4.9.d:
अदितिर्देवकी चैव सर्पमाता च रोहिणी ॥
कश्यपो वसुदेवश्च श्रीकृष्णजनको महान् ॥ 4.9.40 ॥
4.9.m:
Aditi became Devakī, and the mother of snakes became Rohiṇī;
and Kaśyapa became Vasudeva, the great father of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

4.9.s:
rahasyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca sarvaṃ nigaditaṃ mune ..
adhunā baladevasya janmākhyānaṃ mune śṛṇu .. 41 ..
4.9.d:
रहस्यं गोपनीयं च सर्वं निगदितं मुने ॥
अधुना बलदेवस्य जन्माख्यानं मुने शृणु ॥ 41 ॥
4.9.m:
This secret to be concealed has all been declared to you, O sage.
Now hear the account of the birth of Baladeva, O sage,

4.9.s:
anaṃtasyāprameyasya sahasraśirasaḥ prabhoḥ ..
rohiṇī vasudevasya bhāryāratnaṃ ca preyasī .. 42 ..
4.9.d:
अनंतस्याप्रमेयस्य सहस्रशिरसः प्रभोः ॥
रोहिणी वसुदेवस्य भार्यारत्नं च प्रेयसी ॥ 42 ॥
4.9.m:
the lord with a thousand heads, infinite and immeasurable.
Rohiṇī, that jewel among wives and beloved of Vasudeva,

4.9.s:
jagāma gokulaṃ sādhvī vasudevājñayā mune ..
saṃkarṣaṇasya rakṣārthaṃ kaṃsabhītā palāyitā .. 43 ..
4.9.d:
जगाम गोकुलं साध्वी वसुदेवाज्ञया मुने ॥
संकर्षणस्य रक्षार्थं कंसभीता पलायिता ॥ 43 ॥
4.9.m:
went to Gokula, O sage, by the command of Vasudeva,
fleeing in fear of Kaṃsa to protect Saṃkarṣaṇa.

4.9.s:
devakyāḥ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyā kṛṣṇājñayā tadā ..
rohiṇyā jaṭhare tatra sthāpayāmāsa gokule .. 44 ..
4.9.d:
देवक्याः सप्तमं गर्भं माया कृष्णाज्ञया तदा ॥
रोहिण्या जठरे तत्र स्थापयामास गोकुले ॥ 44 ॥
4.9.m:
Then, by the command of Kṛṣṇa, Māyā placed the seventh embryo of Devakī
into the womb of Rohiṇī there in Gokula.

4.9.s:
saṃsthāpya ca tadā garbhaṃ kailāsaṃ sā jagāma ha ..
dināṃtare katipaye rohiṇī naṃdamaṃdire .. 45 ..
4.9.d:
संस्थाप्य च तदा गर्भं कैलासं सा जगाम ह ॥
दिनांतरे कतिपये रोहिणी नंदमंदिरे ॥ 45 ॥
4.9.m:
Having placed the embryo there, she then went to Kailāsa.
After a few days, in Nanda's house,

4.9.s:
suṣāva putraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ taptaraupyābhamīśvaram ..
īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā .. 46 ..
4.9.d:
सुषाव पुत्रं कृष्णांशं तप्तरौप्याभमीश्वरम् ॥
ईषद्धास्यं प्रसन्नास्यं ज्वलंतं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 46 ॥
4.9.m:
Rohiṇī gave birth to a son, a portion of Kṛṣṇa, the Lord radiant as molten silver,
with a gentle smile and a joyful face, blazing with the splendour of Brahman.

4.9.s:
tasyaiva janmamātreṇa devā mumudire tadā ..
svarge duṃdubhayo nedurānakā murajādayaḥ .. 47 ..
4.9.d:
तस्यैव जन्ममात्रेण देवा मुमुदिरे तदा ॥
स्वर्गे दुंदुभयो नेदुरानका मुरजादयः ॥ 47 ॥
4.9.m:
At his mere birth, the gods then rejoiced;
in heaven kettledrums resounded, as well as drums, tabor-drums, and the like.

4.9.s:
jayaśabdaṃ śaṃkhaśabdaṃ cakrurdevā mudānvitāḥ ..
naṃdo hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dadau .. 48 ..
4.9.d:
जयशब्दं शंखशब्दं चक्रुर्देवा मुदान्विताः ॥
नंदो हृष्टो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं बहुविधं ददौ ॥ 48 ॥
4.9.m: Filled with joy, the gods raised shouts of victory and blew conches.

4.9.s:
ciccheda nāḍīṃ dhātrī ca snāpayāmāsa bālakam ..
jayaśabdaṃ jagurgopyaḥ sarvābha raṇabhūṣitāḥ .. 49 ..
4.9.d:
चिच्छेद नाडीं धात्री च स्नापयामास बालकम् ॥
जयशब्दं जगुर्गोप्यः सर्वाभ रणभूषिताः ॥ 49 ॥

4.9.s:
paraputrotsavaṃ naṃdaścakāra paramādarāt ..
tadā yaśodā gopībhyo brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā .. 4.9.50 ..
4.9.d:
परपुत्रोत्सवं नंदश्चकार परमादरात् ॥
तदा यशोदा गोपीभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ मुदा ॥ 4.9.50 ॥

4.9.s:
dhanāni nānāvastūni tailaṃ siṃdūrameva ca ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa yaśodānaṃdayostapaḥ .. 51 ..
4.9.d:
धनानि नानावस्तूनि तैलं सिंदूरमेव च ॥
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स यशोदानंदयोस्तपः ॥ 51 ॥

4.9.s:
janmākhyānaṃ ca halino rohiṇīcaritaṃ tathā ..
adhunā te vāṃchanīyaṃ naṃdaputrotsavaṃ śṛṇu .. 52 ..
4.9.d:
जन्माख्यानं च हलिनो रोहिणीचरितं तथा ॥
अधुना ते वांछनीयं नंदपुत्रोत्सवं शृणु ॥ 52 ॥

4.9.s:
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ..
maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jīvanam .. 53 ..
4.9.d:
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं जन्ममृत्युजरापहम् ॥
मंगलं कृष्णचरितं वैष्णवानां च जीवनम् ॥ 53 ॥

4.9.s:
sarvāśubhavināśaṃ ca bhaktidāsyapradaṃ hareḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasudevaśca saṃsthāpya naṃdamaṃdire .. 54 ..
4.9.d:
सर्वाशुभविनाशं च भक्तिदास्यप्रदं हरेः ॥
श्रीकृष्णं वसुदेवश्च संस्थाप्य नंदमंदिरे ॥ 54 ॥

4.9.s:
gṛhītvā bālikāṃ hṛṣṭo jagāma nijamaṃdiram ..
kathitaṃ caritaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ saṃmukhato mune .. 55 ..
4.9.d:
गृहीत्वा बालिकां हृष्टो जगाम निजमंदिरम् ॥
कथितं चरितं तस्याः श्रुतं संमुखतो मुने ॥ 55 ॥

4.9.s:
adhunā gokule kṛṣṇacaritaṃ śṛṇu maṃgalam ..
vasudeve gṛhaṃ yāte yaśodā naṃda eva ca .. 56 ..
4.9.d:
अधुना गोकुले कृष्णचरितं शृणु मंगलम् ॥
