वसुदेवे गृहं याते यशोदा नंद एव च ॥ 56 ॥

4.9.s:
maṃgale sūtikāgāre jayāgāre jayānvite ..
dadarśa putraṃ bhūmisthaṃ navīnanīradaprabham ..57..
4.9.d:
मंगले सूतिकागारे जयागारे जयान्विते ॥
ददर्श पुत्रं भूमिस्थं नवीननीरदप्रभम् ॥57॥

4.9.s:
atīva suṃdaraṃ nagnaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ gṛhaśekharam ..
śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ nīleṃdīvaralocanam .. 58 ..
4.9.d:
अतीव सुंदरं नग्नं पश्यंतं गृहशेखरम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचंद्रास्यं नीलेंदीवरलोचनम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.9.m: with a face like the autumn full moon, and eyes like blue water-lilies,

4.9.s:
rudaṃtaṃ ca hasaṃtaṃ c veṇusaṃsaktavigraham ..
hastadvayaṃ suvinyastaṃ premavaṃtaṃ padāṃbujam .. 59 ..
4.9.d:
रुदंतं च हसंतं च् वेणुसंसक्तविग्रहम् ॥
हस्तद्वयं सुविन्यस्तं प्रेमवंतं पदांबुजम् ॥ 59 ॥

4.9.s:
dṛṣṭvā naṃdaḥ striyā sārddhaṃ hariṃ hṛṣṭo babhūva ha ..
dhātrī taṃ snāpayāmāsa śītatoyena bālakam .. 4.9.60 ..
4.9.d:
दृष्ट्वा नंदः स्त्रिया सार्द्धं हरिं हृष्टो बभूव ह ॥
धात्री तं स्नापयामास शीततोयेन बालकम् ॥ 4.9.60 ॥

4.9.s:
ciccheda nāḍīṃ bālasya harṣādgopyo jayaṃ daduḥ ..
ājagmurgopikāḥ sarvā bṛhacchroṇyaścalatkucāḥ .. 61 ..
4.9.d:
चिच्छेद नाडीं बालस्य हर्षाद्गोप्यो जयं ददुः ॥
आजग्मुर्गोपिकाः सर्वा बृहच्छ्रोण्यश्चलत्कुचाः ॥ 61 ॥

4.9.s:
bālikāśca vayasyaśca viprapatnyāśca sūtikām ..
āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarvā dadṛśurbālakaṃ mudā .. 62 ..
4.9.d:
बालिकाश्च वयस्यश्च विप्रपत्न्याश्च सूतिकाम् ॥
आशिषं युयुजुः सर्वा ददृशुर्बालकं मुदा ॥ 62 ॥

4.9.s:
kroḍe cakruḥ praśaṃsaṃtya ūṣustatra ca kāścana ..
naṃdaḥ sacailaḥ snātaśca dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī .. 63 ..
4.9.d:
क्रोडे चक्रुः प्रशंसंत्य ऊषुस्तत्र च काश्चन ॥
नंदः सचैलः स्नातश्च धृत्वा धौते च वाससी ॥ 63 ॥

4.9.s:
pāraṃparyavidhiṃ tatra cakāra hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam .. 64 ..
4.9.d:
पारंपर्यविधिं तत्र चकार हृष्टमानसः ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयामास कारयामास मंगलम् ॥ 64 ॥

4.9.s:
vādyāni vādayāmāsa baṃdibhyaśca dadau dhanam ..
tato naṃdaśca sānaṃdaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam .. 65 ..
4.9.d:
वाद्यानि वादयामास बंदिभ्यश्च ददौ धनम् ॥
ततो नंदश्च सानंदं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ धनम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.9.m: then Nanda joyfully gave wealth to the Brahmins,

4.9.s:
sadratnāni pravālāni hīrakāṇi ca sādaram ..
tilānāṃ parvatānsapta suvarṇaśatakaṃ mune .. 66 ..
4.9.d:
सद्रत्नानि प्रवालानि हीरकाणि च सादरम् ॥
तिलानां पर्वतान्सप्त सुवर्णशतकं मुने ॥ 66 ॥
4.9.m:
respectfully [giving] precious gems, corals, and diamonds,
seven mountains of sesame seeds, and a hundred pieces of gold, O sage,

4.9.s:
raupyaṃ dhānyācalaṃ vastraṃ gosahasraṃ manoharam ..
dadhi dugdhaṃ śarkarāṃ ca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu .. 67 ..
4.9.d:
रौप्यं धान्याचलं वस्त्रं गोसहस्रं मनोहरम् ॥
दधि दुग्धं शर्करां च नवनीतं घृतं मधु ॥ 67 ॥
4.9.m:
silver, a mountain of grain, garments, and a thousand charming cows,
curd, milk, sugar, fresh butter, ghee, honey,

4.9.s:
miṣṭānnaṃ sallaḍḍukaughaṃ svādūni modakāni ca ..
bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ vāyuvegāṃsturaṃgamān .. 68 ..
4.9.d:
मिष्टान्नं सल्लड्डुकौघं स्वादूनि मोदकानि च ॥
भूमिं च सर्वसस्याढ्यां वायुवेगांस्तुरंगमान् ॥ 68 ॥
4.9.m:
sweet foods, heaps of fine laḍḍus, and delicious modakas,
land rich with every crop, and horses swift as the wind;

4.9.s:
tāṃbūlāni ca tailāni dattvā hṛṣṭo babhūva ha ..
rakṣituṃ sūtikāgāraṃ yojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān .. 69 ..
4.9.d:
तांबूलानि च तैलानि दत्त्वा हृष्टो बभूव ह ॥
रक्षितुं सूतिकागारं योजयामास ब्राह्मणान् ॥ 69 ॥
4.9.m:
having given betel-leaves and fragrant oils, he was indeed overjoyed.
To protect the lying-in chamber, he stationed Brahmins,

4.9.s:
tatra maṃtrajñamanujānsthavirāngopikāgaṇān ..
vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa harernāmaikamaṃgalam .. 4.9.70 ..
4.9.d:
तत्र मंत्रज्ञमनुजान्स्थविरान्गोपिकागणान् ॥
वेदांश्च पाठयामास हरेर्नामैकमंगलम् ॥ 4.9.70 ॥
4.9.m:
men knowledgeable in mantras, elders, and groups of cowherd women;
and he had the Vedas recited, as well as the name of Hari, the sole source of auspiciousness.

4.9.s:
bhaktyā ca brāhmaṇadvārā pūjayāmāsa devatāḥ ..
gopālikāśca vṛddhāśca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ .. 71 ..
4.9.d:
भक्त्या च ब्राह्मणद्वारा पूजयामास देवताः ॥
गोपालिकाश्च वृद्धाश्च रत्नालंकारभूषिताः ॥ 71 ॥
4.9.m:
Through the Brahmins, he worshipped the deities with devotion.
Elder cowherd women adorned with gemstone ornaments,

4.9.s:
sasmitā śīghragāminya ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ..
nānāvidhāśca gaṇakā jyotiḥśāstraviśāradāḥ.. 72 ..
4.9.d:
सस्मिता शीघ्रगामिन्य आजग्मुर्नंदमंदिरम् ॥
नानाविधाश्च गणका ज्योतिःशास्त्रविशारदाः॥ 72 ॥
4.9.m:
smiling and walking swiftly, arrived at Nanda's house.
Various astrologers skilled in the science of astrology,

4.9.s:
vāksiddhāḥ pustakakarā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ..
sasmitā viprapatnyaśca vayasyāḥ sthavirā varāḥ .. 73 ..
4.9.d:
वाक्सिद्धाः पुस्तककरा आजग्मुर्नंदमंदिरम् ॥
सस्मिता विप्रपत्न्यश्च वयस्याः स्थविरा वराः ॥ 73 ॥
4.9.m:
whose speech was unerring, holding books in their hands, arrived at Nanda's house.
Smiling wives of Brahmins, peers, venerable elders,

4.9.s:
bālikā bālakayutā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ..
tebhyo'pi pradadau ratnaṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca.. 74 ..
4.9.d:
बालिका बालकयुता आजग्मुर्नंदमंदिरम् ॥
तेभ्योऽपि प्रददौ रत्नं धनानि विविधानि च॥ 74 ॥
4.9.m:
and young girls accompanied by children came to Nanda's house.
To them also he gave jewels and diverse riches,

4.9.s:
varavastrāṇi raupyāṇi gosahasrāṇi sādaram ..
naṃdastebhyo namaskṛtya cakāra vinayaṃ mudā .. 75 ..
4.9.d:
वरवस्त्राणि रौप्याणि गोसहस्राणि सादरम् ॥
नंदस्तेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य चकार विनयं मुदा ॥ 75 ॥
4.9.m:
fine clothes, silver, and thousands of cows with great respect.
Bowing down to them, Nanda joyfully offered his homage;

4.9.s:
āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarve dadṛśurbālakaṃ param ..
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro babhūva vrajapuṃgavaḥ ..76..
4.9.d:
आशिषं युयुजुः सर्वे ददृशुर्बालकं परम् ॥
एवं संभृतसंभारो बभूव व्रजपुंगवः ॥76॥
4.9.m:
all bestowed their blessings and beheld the supreme boy.
Thus the chief of Vraja, having assembled all the provisions,

4.9.s:
gaṇakaiḥ kārayāmāsa yadbhaviṣyaṃ śubhāśubham ..
evaṃ vavardha bālaśca śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī .. 77 ..
4.9.d:
गणकैः कारयामास यद्भविष्यं शुभाशुभम् ॥
एवं ववर्ध बालश्च शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी ॥ 77 ॥
4.9.m:
had the astrologers determine what good and bad fortune lay in the future.
Thus the boy grew, like the moon in the waxing fortnight.

4.9.s:
naṃdālaye halī caiva bhukta mātuḥ payodharam ..
tadā ca rohiṇī hṛṣṭā tatra putrotsave mudā ..78..
4.9.d:
नंदालये हली चैव भुक्त मातुः पयोधरम् ॥
तदा च रोहिणी हृष्टा तत्र पुत्रोत्सवे मुदा ॥78॥
4.9.m:
In Nanda's abode, the plough-wielder [Balarāma] drank his mother's breast-milk;
then Rohiṇī too was joyful with delight during that celebration of the son's birth.

4.9.s:
tailasiṃdūratāṃbūlaṃ dhanaṃ tābhyo dadau mune ..
dattvāśiṣaśca śirasi tāśca te svālayaṃ yayuḥ .. 79 ..
4.9.d:
तैलसिंदूरतांबूलं धनं ताभ्यो ददौ मुने ॥
दत्त्वाशिषश्च शिरसि ताश्च ते स्वालयं ययुः ॥ 79 ॥
4.9.m:
O sage, [Nanda] gave oil, vermilion, betel-leaf, and wealth to the women;
and having placed their blessings upon his head, they went to their own homes.

4.9.s: yaśodārohiṇīnaṃdāstasthurgehe mudānvitāḥ .. 4.9.80 ..
4.9.d: यशोदारोहिणीनंदास्तस्थुर्गेहे मुदान्विताः ॥ 4.9.80 ॥
4.9.m: Yaśodā, Rohiṇī, and Nanda remained in the house, filled with joy.
